And as is explained within the ma'amar — regarding the service of Hashem: that one must begin little by little, and grow and expand in His service each time more and more. So similarly, we find regarding the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — it is written in Parshas Mishpatim: "little by little I will drive them away from before you — until you have increased and inherited the land — and I will set your borders", etc. [Shmos 23:30]. And similarly in Parshas Ekev: "and Hashem your G-d will drive out these nations from before you — little by little — you will not be able to finish them off quickly", etc. [Devarim 7:22]. And in Parshas Ki Sisa it is written: "for I will drive out nations from before you — and I will enlarge your border," etc. [Shmos 34:24].
 

 
 And there is the primary yir'ah, as stated above many times. And Eretz Yisrael is called an ishah yiras Hashem [a G-d-fearing woman], as is brought. And therefore there is the primary holiness of union, as stated above. And there is the primary blessing of rain and the aspect of long breathing [arichas haneshimah] as is explained within the ma'amar — this being the aspect of: "and the breath of Shaddai gives them understanding" [Iyov 32:8]. And the aspect of: "the candle of Hashem is the soul of man" [Mishlei 20:27] — this being the aspect of: "who gives a soul to the people upon it" [Yeshayahu 42:5] — said of Eretz Yisrael. And there is the primary intervention [pekidas akoros] for the barren — as it is written: "there shall be no barren woman among you" [Shmos 23:26] — for the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael is most suited for this, as our Sages of blessed memory said. And through this, awe is revealed — in the aspect of: "trembling seized them there — anguish as of a woman in labor" [Tehillim 48:7] — said in praise of Yerushalayim.
 

 
 And there is the primary tikkun of the awakening from sleep — in the aspect of: "I was sleeping but my heart was awake" [Shir HaShirim 5:2]. For Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim, etc., are the aspect of the heart — where there is the primary vitality and wisdom — as it is written: "and to every wise-hearted man I have given wisdom" [Shmos 31:6]. And therefore: "there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael" — and it is called Eretz HaChayyim. And there is the primary ascent of all prayers and all holy services of Israel — which cannot ascend above unless they have within them vital life-force — the aspect of wisdom — and they are not in the aspect of sleep, which is mochin d'katnus [diminished consciousness]. But there, in Eretz Yisrael, they are in the aspect of mochin d'gadlus [expanded consciousness], as stated above many times — and therefore all the holinesses ascend there in fullness. And there eating is in holiness — as it is written: "and you shall eat there before Hashem your G-d" [Devarim 14:26] — and many like these. And also there, foods are fully clarified — for the primary clarification of foods is through emunah — this being the aspect of: "and tend to faithfulness." And the primary tikkun of this is in Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "dwell in the land and tend to faithfulness" [this phrase is repeated in the original].
 

 
 And this is the aspect of: "my soul longed and also pined for the courts of Hashem — my heart and my flesh sing out to the living G-d" [Tehillim 84:3]. For there the service is in fullness with the vital life-force of holiness — the aspect of: "and wisdom gives life" [Koheles 7:12]. And there is the primary holy radiance of the countenance — in the aspect of: "may He cause His countenance to shine upon us, Selah" [Tehillim 67:2]. And it is written: "and the light of Your countenance — for You favored them" [Tehillim 44:4]. For there all seventy faces of the Torah illuminate — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael."

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחי' שבת כידוע ובחינת תשובה כמו שכתוב רצית ד' ארצך שבת שבות יעקב וכתיב (ישעי' מ"ד) האומר לירושלים תושב וכיוצא בזה הרבה וכתיב ובא לציון גואל ולשבי פשע וכו'. כי התשובה של חו"ל היא בבחינת ששת ימי החול כי אין לו מנוחה עדיין בבחי' כי לא אתם עד עתה אל המנוחה וכו'. אבל א"י היא בבחינת מנוחה כמ"ש וירא מנוחה כי טוב וכו' וכתיב אם יבואון אל מנוחתי וכתיב ועברתם את הירדן והניח לכם מכל אויביכם מסביב וישבתם בטח בחינת מנוחה שלימה. ועיקר המנוחה היתה בימי שלמה שהוא בחינת שבת מלך שהשלום שלו כי שלום הי' בימיו כידוע. והוא זכה לבנות הבית המקדש שעליו האמר קומה ד' למנוחתך וכו' וכתיב זאת מנוחתי עדי עד וכו'. וזה בחינת תשובה שלימה בחינת שדי בחי' (איוב כ"ב) אם תשוב עד שדי תבנה וכו' וזה בחינת (שם) כי אז על שדי תתענג בחינת ענג שבת. ועי"ז זוכין לשפלות בחינת שבו איש תחתיו וזה וענוים יירשו ארץ והתענגו וכו' וזה שכתוב (שמואל ב' ז') ושמתי מקום לעמי ישראל ונטעתיו ושכן תחתיו (בחי' שבו איש תחתיו הנ"ל) ולא ירגז עוד ותרגומו ולא יזועון עוד היינו שלא יטולטל עוד ממוקומו כמו שפירשו המפרשים שזה בחינת שבו איש תחתיו אל יצא איש ממקומו כי אינם יכולים לדחותו ממקומו עי"ז כמבואר בפנים. וגם כפשוטו שיהי' להם מנוחת שלוה והשקט שזה בחינת תשובה שלימה כנ"ל. וזה בטח בה' ועשה טוב בחינת תשובה שלימה כמבואר בפנים שכן אחרץ כפשוטו. כי שם נאמר וישבתם בטח כנ"ל. גם שכן ארץ מרמז על שפלות עד דרך שמרו רז"ל שנעשה שכן לעפר וכו'. וזה ורעה אמונה כי כל זה הוא בחינת משה רעיא מהימנא כמבואר בפנים. וע"כ ביקש משה להכניס את ישראל לא"י ואז היו קבועין שם לעולם כמובא. והשיב לו השי"ת רב לך וכו' כי משה הוא בחינת הארץ שדי בעצמו כביכול ולא יוכלו לסבול האור הגדול כ"כ בקביעות. רק יהושע יכניסם שהוא בחי' נער מט"ט כמבואר בזוה"ק. וכשנמשך קדושת שבת שזה בחינת שדי כמבואר בפנים. וזה שאמר המלאך ליהושע אני שר צבא ד' עתה באתי. וצריכין לבאר עוד כי גם בפנים כתיב רק ברמז:
segments.en:
And there also shine the aspect of the shanim kadmoniyos [the primordial years — a Kabbalistic term for the most elevated supernal levels] — this being the aspect of: "and the offering of Yehudah and Yerushalayim shall be pleasing to Hashem — as in the days of olam" [primordial times — which are the aspect of b'kerev shanim, the seventy faces, as understood in the holy Zohar and among the Kabbalists] "and as in the years of old [kadmoniyos]" [Malachi 3:4] — which are above the aforementioned aspect. And there is what may be alluded to in the masorah [scribal tradition]: two instances of "and you shall lie down and your sleep shall be sweet [v'arvah shenasecha]" [Mishlei 3:24] — for through this, sleep is rectified — that it should not be in the aspect of death, G-d forbid — but rather one should awaken afterwards. And this is: "for You have rejected us greatly," etc. — meaning, because we fell from all the seventy faces, G-d forbid — "return us, Hashem," etc., "renew our days as of old [kedem]" [Eichah 5:22, 21] — meaning the aspect of the shanim kadmoniyos, which are also called yemay kedem, as is known.
 

 
 And this is the aspect of: "the Torah need not have begun except with 'this month shall be for you' — which is the first commandment — and why did it open with Creation? — because of: 'the power of His deeds He declared to His people — to give them the inheritance of nations'" [Tehillim 111:6]. For through the aspect of the story-tales of the holy Torah — and in particular of the story of Creation — which is the aspect of the story-tales of the shanim kadmoniyos — through this specifically one merits to the aspect of the awakening from sleep — the aspect of the mochin — the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael, whose holiness was at first concealed in the aspect of sleep until it was the inheritance of the nations — and now it has awakened from its sleep, and its holiness has been revealed, and it was given to Israel as an inheritance — through the aforementioned aspect of the power of His deeds.
 

 
 And this is what is written: "on that day I will raise up the fallen sukkah of Dovid," etc., "and I will build it as in the days of olam" [Amos 9:11]. And it is written — regarding the consolation of Tzion through the King Mashiach [Michah 5:1]: "and his going forth is from of old — from the days of olam" — meaning, the two aforementioned aspects, for the yemay olam receive their vitality from the aspect of yemay kedem — "therefore He will deliver them until the time when she who is in labor has given birth" — for through this, the aspect of birth is produced, as stated above — see Rashi. And this is what is written: "our fathers told us — of the deeds You performed in their days — in the days of kedem — with Your hand You drove out the nations and planted them," etc., "for not by their sword did they inherit the land," etc., "and the light of Your countenance — for You favored them", etc. [Tehillim 44:2–4]. And he cries out and prays about the exile and concludes: "arouse — why do You sleep, Hashem? Awaken," etc., "why do You hide Your face?", etc., "and redeem us — for the sake of Your lovingkindness" [Tehillim 44:24, 27]. For all of this is the aspect of Chesed, as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: סימן פ'-ה' עוז לעמו יתן
segments.en:
And similarly in Psalm 74: "remember Your congregation that You acquired of old [kedem] — You redeemed the tribe of Your inheritance — Mount Tzion," etc., "and G-d is my King from of old [mikedem] — working salvations in the midst of the earth," etc. [Tehillim 74:2, 12]. And similarly in Psalm 77: "my eyes are held open with watches" — and Rashi explained: constantly my eyes are stuck as a person sunk in slumber from a sealed heart, etc. — "I was overwhelmed and could not speak" [Tehillim 77:5] — for then, in the time of the aspect of sleep, a person is as if mute, unable to speak. And the tikkun for this: "I thought about the days of old [kedem] — the years of ancient times [shnos olamim]" [Tehillim 77:6] — the two aforementioned aspects, through which one is awakened from the sleep. And similarly afterwards: "for I will remember Your wonders from of old [mikedem] — and I will meditate on all Your deeds," etc. [Tehillim 77:12] — the aspect of these story-tales.
 

 
 And similarly in Psalm 143: "and my spirit overwhelms me within me — my heart within me is desolate" — and at the beginning it is written: "for the enemy has pursued my soul — he has crushed my life to the ground — he has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead." Meaning: the vital life-force of holiness was greatly diminished and weakened before him. And the tikkun for this: "I remembered the days of old [kedem] — I meditated on all Your works — I mused on the work of Your hands," etc. [Tehillim 143:5]. And he cries out: "do not hide Your face from me", etc., "and I shall be like those who go down to the pit — cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning" — meaning the aforementioned aspect of Chesed — "Your good spirit will lead me on the level land [eretz mishor]," etc. [Tehillim 143:7–10] — meaning Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.
 

 
 And this is what is written — regarding the praise of the holy Torah [Mishlei 8:22–26]: "Hashem acquired me at the beginning of His way — before His works of old [mikedem] — from eternity I was established — from the beginning [meirosh] — from the earliest times of the earth," etc. For the holy Torah is comprised of all the aspects — from the aspect of b'kerev shanim and from the aspect of shanim kadmoniyos — and concludes: "before He made the earth and the open spaces — and the head of the dust of the world" [Mishlei 8:26] — this refers to Eretz Yisrael and all the other lands. For from there flows the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — which is the holy point of all the lands.
 

 
 And this is what is written regarding the consolations of Tzion [Yeshayahu 51:9]: "awake, awake — put on strength, O Tzion — awake as in the days of old [kimay kedem] — the generations of the world [doros olamim]." And this is what is written [Yechezkel 36:8–12]: "and you, O mountains of Israel, shall give forth your branches," etc. — the aspect of the settlement of Eretz Yisrael — "and I will multiply upon you man and animal — and they shall multiply and be fruitful" — the aspect of birth, to permit the mouth of the barren — "and I will restore you as of old [k'kadmoseichem]," etc., "and I will bring men — My people Israel — upon you — and they shall possess you — and you shall be to them an inheritance."

segments.he: עיקר הברכ והשלום הוא בארץ ישראל כמו שכתוב כי שם צוה ד' את הברכה וכתיב השם גבולך שלום. והשלום הוא בחינת התחברות שני הפכים היינו חסד וגבורה שהם בחינת אהבה ויראה שזוכין בא"י כנ"ל. וכן לענין ירושת א"י נאמר ותחת כי אהב את אבותיך ויבחר בזרעו אחריו וכו'. (שזה בחינת חסד) להוריש גוים גדולים וכו' (שזה בחינת גבורה ודין שעשה בהעכו"ם וגירשם משם) ועוד פסוקים רבים כאלה. והאבות זכו לירושת א"י ע"י שקידשו שם שמים כמ"ש אצל אברהם אני ד' אשר הוצאתיך מאור כשדים (ששם קידש שם שמים כידוע) לתת לך את הארץ וכו'. וכן אצל עקידת יצחק נאמר ויירש זרעך את שער אויביו. ומחמת שאצל יעקב לא מצינו בפירוש שמסר נפשו על קידוש השם ע"כ אמר הנביא (ישעי' כ"ט) כה אמר ד' אל בית יעקב אשר פדה את אברהם (וכמו שדרשו רז"ל שזכותו של יעקב עמדה לו לאברהם באור כשדים) לא עתה יבוש יעקב וכו' (פירש"י מאביו ומאבי אביו) כי בראותו ילדיו וכו' יקדישו שמי (פירש"י אלו חנניה מישאל ועזרי') והקדישו את קדוש יעקב וגו'. וזה שנאמר גם על לעתיד (יחזקאל ל"ו) וקדשתי את שמי הגדול וכו' וקבצתי אתכם מכל הארצות והבאתי אתכם אל אדמתכם. (ושם ל"ט) עתה אשוב את שבות יעקב וכו' וקנאתי לשם קדשי וכו' וקבצתי אותם ארצות אויביהם ונקדשתי בם לעיני הגוים רבים וכו' וכנסתים אל אדמתם וכו'. נמצא שקיבוץ גליות לא"י הוא ע"י בחינת קידוש השם. וזה שכתוב אני חומה ושדי כמגדלותודרשו רז"ל לענין אברהם וחנניה מישאל ועזרי' שמסרו נפשם על קידוש השם. וזה שסיים אז הייתי בעיניו כמוצאת שלום. כי זה בחינת שלום כמבואר בפנים. וזה שכתוב וישב יעקב בארץ מגורי אביו בארץ כנען אלה תולדות יעקב יוסף כי הוא הי' עיקר תולדותיו כי הוא בחינת הוא"ו שניה המבואר בפנים שזה בחינת שלום בחינת קידוש הם שזה מסוגל לירושת א"י כנ"ל. וע"כ עתה בזסמן הגלות שנתרחקנו מעל אדמתינו אי אפשר לבא לא"י ע"פ רוב כי אם ע"י מסירת נפש כמו שמספרים מכמה גדולים ממה שעבר עליהם כמפורסם. וזה בחינת לקדושים אשר בארץ המה וכתיב והנותתר בירושלים קדוש יאמר לו. באמת הנסיעה הרחוקה כזאת עם הוצאות דרך והטלטולים וכיוצא שעוברים על כל אדם הנוסע לשם הוא ג"כ בחינת מסירת נפש כמבואר במ"א. ושם בא"י זוכין לקבל כל ההשפעות והברכות ע"י בחינת הכלי של שלום וזוכין לדבר שם דיבורים קדושים לפני הש"י של תורה ותפלה בחכמה שוכל. כי שם עיקר החכמה והשכל וכן עיקר שלימות התורה והתפלה כנ"ל כמה פעמים:
segments.en:
And this is what is written [Michah 7:14]: "tend Your people with Your staff," etc. — regarding the settlement of Eretz Yisrael, see Rashi there — "let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of olam" [Michah 7:14]. And he concludes: "You will give truth to Yaakov — lovingkindness to Avraham — which You swore to our fathers from the days of old [mimay kedem]" [Michah 7:20] — as stated above.
 

 
 And this is that regarding Yaakov — when he began to leave Eretz Yisrael for the Diaspora — sleep fell upon him. And this is: "and he lodged there — for the sun had set" [Bereishis 28:11]. And specifically there he received tidings of the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael and the birth of children, etc. — through the dream, which is the aspect of the story-tales. And: "and Yaakov awoke from his sleep" [Bereishis 28:16] — for the aspect of the awakening from sleep was drawn upon him. And he was afraid and said: "how awesome is this place!", etc. For through this, awe was revealed — the aspect of: "Hashem, I have heard Your report and I was afraid", etc. [Chavakuk 3:2].
 

 
 And this is what is written in the blessing of the Land: "and you shall eat old grain grown old" — whose Targum is: v'sichlun atiqa d'atik "and you shall eat of the ancient of the ancient". For the abundance of Eretz Yisrael is drawn from the aspect of the shanim kadmoniyos — the aspect of Atik [the Ancient One]. And also there are the primary fitting disciples — as it is written: "and all your children shall be disciples of Hashem," etc. And it is explained within the ma'amar regarding the power of speech that reaches the reproductive organs — which are the millstones of the generation — and that the organs of speech must be adjacent and close to the organs of reproduction, etc. And this is what the prophet rebuked them [Yeshayahu 59:4]: "trust in emptiness and speak falsehood — they conceive toil and give birth to iniquity." For through the blemish of speech and of trust, pregnancy and birth are also blemished. And this is what is also said: "and you shall speak from the ground" [Yeshayahu 29:4]. And it is said: "he was oppressed and afflicted — and like a ewe before its shearers — he was silent and did not open his mouth" [Yeshayahu 53:7]. For they were then like the deaf and the mute. But at the time of the redemption it is said: "then the eyes of the blind shall be opened and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped," etc., "the tongue of the mute shall sing" [Yeshayahu 35:5–6]. And it is written: "raise your voice with strength — O herald of Yerushalayim" [Yeshayahu 40:9] — the aspect of the aforementioned strength. And this strength comes to the reproductive organs which are the millstones of the generation, who await the salvation. And through this they merit the inheritance of the Land — the aspect of: "and the hopeful ones of Hashem — they shall inherit the land" [Tehillim 37:9]. And it is written: "trust in Hashem," etc., "dwell in the land" — and see Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 211. And then birth occurs — the aspect of: "for she travailed — and she gave birth — Tzion bore her children — shall I bring to the brink and not deliver?", etc. [Yeshayahu 66:8–9].

segments.he: סימן פ"א. עלו זה בנגב.
segments.en:
And because all the aforementioned aspects are included in the shofar, as is explained within the ma'amar — therefore the first conquest of Eretz Yisrael — which is the conquest of Yericho — was through the shofar. And now see what our Sages of blessed memory said [Vayikra Rabbah, chapter 34]: "Rabbi Zeira said: even the casual conversation of the people of Eretz Yisrael is Torah," etc. — which is precisely aligned with what is explained within the ma'amar — regarding the casual conversation of Torah scholars, which is the aspect of story-tales — through which one awakens from sleep and draws all the aforementioned tikkunim — which are the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.
 

 
 Siman Samech-Alef · סימן ס"א

 Chadi Rabbi Shimon — "Rabbi Shimon Rejoiced"

 חֲדֵי רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 61

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחינת הדיבור דקדושה של תורה ותפלה וע"כ שם עיקר שלימות התורה ותפלה כנ"ל. אך אפילו השיחת חולין של בני א"י ש זה בחינת פסולת ארץ ישראל ג"כ יקר מאד כמאמר רז"ל (מד"ר ויקרא פ' ל"ד) שיחתן ש בני א"י תורה היא. וע"כ צריכין ליזהר שם ביותר לשמור את הדיבור שיהי' קדושה ואפי' בהשיחת חולין יהי' ג"כ מלובש בהם איזה דברי תורה כמבואר בפנים לענין הצדיק. כי כבר נתבאר שכל היושבים בארץ ישראל הם בבחינת צדיק וכמובא:
segments.en:
The primary tikkun of mishpat [justice] and tikkun of etzah [counsel] is in Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim — as it is written: "and I will restore your judges as at the first — and your counselors as at the beginning" [Yeshayahu 1:26]. For there is the primary perfection of wisdom, as stated above. And also they are the aspect of the heart — where there is the tikkun of counsel — the aspect of: "water that is deep — counsel is in the heart of a man" [Mishlei 20:5]. And there is the primary perfection of emunah b'chachamim — the aspect of: "you shall not deviate from the ruling," etc. — as stated above in Siman 57. And there is the primary semichah by which the Sages are ordained, as stated above.
 

 
 And also there is the primary perfection of kesav [writing] — this being the aspect of what the verse elaborated to tell — regarding the inheritance of the seven tribes that had not yet been conquered in the days of Yehoshua — how he sent men to write out all the cities among them [Yehoshua 18:4–10]: "go and travel through the land and write it," etc. "And the men went and traveled through the land — and they wrote it down by cities into seven portions on a book," etc. "And Yehoshua divided the land there for the children of Israel," etc. For the writing of Israel is in the aspect of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael. And this is what is written regarding the transfer of kingship and leadership to Shaul — which is the aspect of semichah [Shmuel I 10:25]: "and he wrote in a book and placed it before Hashem" — for it is in the same aspect as the writing, as stated above.
 

 
 And this is what is written: "and it shall be — those who remain in Tzion and who remain in Yerushalayim," etc., "everyone who is written for life in Yerushalayim" [Yeshayahu 4:3]. And this is what is written: "write for yourself all these words," etc., "on a book," etc., "and I will restore the captivity of My people Israel," etc., "and I will bring them back to the land — and they shall possess it" [Yirmiyahu 30:2–3]. And this is also what is written: "and I wrote in the book and sealed it," etc., "and I gave the deed of purchase," etc., "and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the book," etc., "take these books," etc., "for so says Hashem: houses and fields and vineyards shall yet be purchased in this land," etc. — "and they shall purchase fields for silver — and it shall be written in the book and sealed," etc., "for I will restore their captivity — says Hashem" [Yirmiyahu 32:10–15, 43–44]. And all of this is because the writing of Israel is in the aspect of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.
 

 
 And there is the primary secret of ibur [the intercalation of the calendar / mystical pregnancy] — as our Sages of blessed memory said, and as is explained within the ma'amar. For bodies are formed there in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael and are able to receive lofty and holy souls — and through this the secret of ibur [impregnation of souls] is transmitted to them. And there are the primary pure waters as is explained within the ma'amar — as it is written: "and I will bring you to your land — and I will sprinkle upon you pure waters," etc., "and I will give you a new heart," etc. [Yechezkel 36:24–26]. And the aforementioned waters are the aspect of: "the channel of G-d is full of water" [Tehillim 65:10] — said also of Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "You have visited the land and watered it," etc. [Tehillim 65:10]. And it is said: "a river — its streams shall gladden the city of G-d", etc. [Tehillim 46:5]. And it is said: "on every high mountain," etc., "streams of water" [Yeshayahu 30:25]. And there is the primary sweetening of all the tzimtzumim [contractions / the aspect of divine concealment] — for all of them are clarified through thought. And there is the primary purification and holiness of thought, as stated above. And there is the Even HaShetiyah [the Foundation Stone]. And there is the primary light of supernal wisdom, as stated above. And there is the primary perfection of Torah — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael" — and it is written: "for from Tzion shall go forth Torah." And this is: "may He send you help from the sanctuary — and from Tzion may He sustain you" [Tehillim 20:3] — in its literal sense.

segments.he: סימן פ"ב-הנעלבים
segments.en:
And there is the primary totality of the twelve stones of Yaakov within the Even HaShetiyah — as it is written: "and he reached the place," etc., "and he took from the stones of the place," etc. [Bereishis 28:11] — and as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. And there he was told: "the land upon which you are lying — to you I will give it," etc. And there is the primary perfection of joy — the aspect of: "the light of the righteous is glad" [Mishlei 13:9]. And it is written: "the righteous shall inherit the land." And this is: "Mount Tzion shall rejoice," etc. [Tehillim 48:12] — and many like these.
 

 
 For there is the primary totality of the souls of Israel — as it is written: "who gives a soul to the people upon it — and a spirit to those who walk in it" [Yeshayahu 42:5] — the aspect of the spirit of wisdom — the sustaining spirit [rucha d'kiyyuma], as is explained within the ma'amar. And there is the primary love and totality among Israel — as it is written: "who makes your borders peace," as stated above. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said [Horios 3b] — regarding: "and if the matter was hidden from the eyes of the congregation" [Vayikra 4:13]: "the inhabitants of Eretz Yisrael are called 'congregation' — and the inhabitants of the Diaspora are not" — and the Rambam ruled accordingly (Chapter 13 of the Laws of Shgagos). For there is the primary totality of the souls of Israel as one — in the aspect of kahal echad [one assembly] — in the aspect of: "and Moshe assembled the entire congregation of Israel" [Shmos 35:1]. And our Sages of blessed memory said [Sanhedrin 24a]: "how beloved they are to one another" — the aspect of: "we are bound up in lovingkindness." And our Sages of blessed memory said: "a city that is joined together" [Tehillim 122:3] — "a city that makes Israel bound to one another" [Ta'anis 5a] — and see Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 43. And there is the primary perfection of the holy books, as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory said [as brought in Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 381]: "one may not take holy books from Eretz Yisrael to the Diaspora" — and in particular if they were written there on condition that they not be taken out. For the writing of Israel — and in particular the writing of holy books — is in the aspect of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.
 

 
 And perhaps this is also the matter of what was commanded in Parshas Ki Savo: "and you shall erect large stones for yourself", etc., "and you shall write upon them all the words of this Torah", etc., "when you cross over to the land," etc. [Devarim 27:2–3] — as stated above. And this is what is written: "and they carried twelve stones", etc., "according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel," etc. [Yehoshua 4:8] — and these are the same stones upon which the Torah was written and from which the altar was made. As it is written in Parshas Ki Savo: "and you shall build there an altar," etc., "and you shall rejoice before Hashem your G-d" [Devarim 27:6–7]. For all of this is the aspect of the twelve stones of Yaakov that were included as one — and through this, joy is produced — the aspect of: "the light of the righteous is glad," as stated above.

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחינת שבת ובחינת ברית כנ"ל כמ"פ. וע"כ לא נכנסו ישראל לא"י עד שהי' להם מילה ופריעה זה בחינת היום גלותי את חרפת וכו'. כי אי אפשר ליכנס לארץ ישראל ולהיות קבוע בקדושתה עד שמכניעין תחלה הבחינת שלש קליפות טמאות שהם בחינת ערלה בחינת חרפה. וע"כ א"י היא אחת מג' דברים שבאים ע"י יסורים. כי גם היסורין הם בחי' חרפה בחי' חרפה שברה לבי וכמובא במאמר חותם בתוך חותם סי' כ"ב שבכל יסורי העוה"ז יש בהם צער הבושה וכשזוכין לקבל היסורין באהבה שזה בחינת הנעלבים וכו' ושמחים ביסורין ועושים מאהבה. אז מאיר עליהם הארת בחינת חשמל ונוגה נכלל בקדושה ויורד שלהובא דאשא (מבחינת אור האהבה הזאת בחי' כי עזה כמות אהבה וכו' רשפיה רשפי אש שלהבת י'ה שזה סוד האי שלהובא דאשא כמבוא' בכתבי האריז"ל) ואז נדחין הג' קליפות טמאות ונכנעין לגמרי שזה בחי' מילה ואז יכולין לזכות לקדושת ארץ ישראל כנ"ל. וזה שכתוב (תהלים ס"ט) אתה ידעת חרפתי ובשתי וכו' חרפה שברה לבי וכו' וסים כי אלקים יושיע ציון ויבנה ערי יהודה וישבו שם וירשו וכו' ואוהבי שמו ישכנו בה. וכן אמרו רז"ל לאוהבי ולשומרי מצותי אלו הדרים בא"י ומוסרים נפשם ל כל המצות וכו' (הובא בשער החצר רפ"ח. ועי' שם גם בסי' כ"ג כ"ד). וזה שמובא בכונת לומר בשעת רחיצת חמין בערב שבת (שזה סוד האי שלהובא דאשא) פסוק והי' הנשאר בציון והנותר בירושלים וכו' וכן אם רחץ ד' את צואת בנות ציון וכו. כי כ"ז שייך גם לקדושת א"י כנ"ל. ואולי י"ל שזה סוד מה שמבואר (יהושע יו"ד) ויהי כשמוע וכו' כי השלימו יובי גבעון את ישראל ויהיו בקרבם וכו' ויאספו ויעלו חמשת מלכי האמורי וכו' ויחנו על גבעון וכו' ויעל יהושע וכו' ויכס מכה גדולה בגבעון וכו' וד' השליך עליהם אבנים גדולות מן השמים (ואמרו רז"ל שהם מאבני הברד שהיו במצרים בימי משה ושם נאמר ואש מתלקחת בתוך הברד וכו') זה בחינת השלהובא דאשא היורד מן השמים להכניע הקליפות. אז ידבר יהושע וכו' ויאמר לעיני ישראל שמש בגבעון דום וכו'. וידום השמש וכו' עד יקום גוי אויביו וכו'. כי זה בחינת ואוהביו כצאת השמש בגבורתו המבואר בפנים. ויתכן עוד יותר לפי מה שארז"ל בפרקי דר"א שזאת המלחמה היתה בערב שבת שאז הוא הזמן שיורד השלהובא דאשא הנ"ל. ואז אמר יהושע שמש בגבעון דום כנ"ל:
segments.en:
And this is: "the words of Koheles, son of Dovid, king in Yerushalayim" [Koheles 1:1] — Rashi explained: that he said his words when he gathered the people as king in Yerushalayim — the city of wisdom. For Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of wisdom — and Yerushalayim is the city of wisdom — and there all the souls of Israel were gathered to be included within the all-encompassing intellect — which is the aspect of Shlomo — of whom it is written: "and he was wiser than all men" [Melachim I 5:11] — and he is called Koheles [the Gatherer] because within him all the congregation is included. And therefore Koheles concluded regarding the making of many books: "of making many books there is no end, and much study is a weariness of the flesh" [Koheles 12:12] — meaning: to be careful not to mock the words of the Sages and the multitude of their books; rather, on the contrary — to believe in them, etc. For through this, the Torah is completed — and the particular intellects can receive power from the supernal wisdom — until through this all the tzimtzumim and stern judgments are sweetened — and our judgment shall go forth to light, as stated above, and as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is: "the conclusion of the matter — all has been heard: fear G-d and observe His commandments" [Koheles 12:13] — and Rashi explained: "for this purpose was the entire human being created." Meaning: every human being is obligated in this — to sweeten through his own particular intellect all the aspects of tzimtzum that come upon him, and to fear G-d and observe His commandments. But because these particular intellects must receive the power of sweetening from the aspect of the supernal wisdom — the all-encompassing intellect — which is the aspect of the true Tzaddik of the generation — therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "for this purpose was the entire human being created — the entire world was created only to accompany this one" — meaning, to speak with him and to be included within him. And this is what concludes: "for G-d will bring every deed into judgment," etc. Therefore one must be very careful in emunah b'chachamim and in their holy books. For through this all the aspects of tzimtzum and stern judgments are sweetened — and our judgment shall go forth to light, as stated above.
 

 
 Siman Samech-Bais · סימן ס"ב

 Vayasev — "And He Turned Around" [Aramaic: Vayisov]

 וַיַּסֵּב · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 62

segments.he: סימן פ"ג. מתן בסתר.
segments.en:
The primary perfection of the holy intellect and da'as is in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above many times. And also there is the primary perfection of emunah — as it is written: "dwell in the land and tend to faithfulness." And also there is the primary perfection of the true, decided halachic rulings — which are the aspect of shalom and the resolution of the disputes of the Tannaim and Amoraim. As it is written: "when a matter is too wondrous for you for judgment," etc., "matters of dispute in your gates" — and Rashi explained there: that the scholars of the city will disagree on the matter — this one declaring impure and that one declaring pure, etc. — "and you shall arise and go up," etc., "and you shall act according to the ruling they will direct you," etc. And it is written: "judges and officers you shall appoint for yourself in all your gates," etc. And therefore there is the primary shalom — the aspect of: "who makes your borders peace."
 

 
 And there is the primary aspect of: "and know what to answer the heretic [apikoros]" — as our Sages of blessed memory said [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Noach; and Midrash Rabbah, Parshas Ekev]: "there shall not be among you barren man or barren woman — or among your animals" [Devarim 7:14]: "even the animals among you will know how to answer responses," etc. — see there the story of Rabbi Yonasan, etc. And there is the primary perfection of prayer — in the aspect of: "I will praise You with an upright heart," etc., as is explained within the ma'amar. For there, both the aforementioned aspects are in their fullness. For that which can be settled through intellect — one settles, for there there is no concealment of knowledge — which is the aspect of: "their heart is divided" [Hoshea 10:2] — but rather the aspect of uprightness of heart, as stated above. And for that which one must strengthen oneself solely through emunah and simplicity — without any investigation or knowledge — one merits this too in Eretz Yisrael in its fullness.
 

 
 This is the aspect of: "for the upright shall dwell in the land — and the wholehearted shall remain in it" [Mishlei 2:21] — the two aforementioned aspects. Through this, emunah is there in its fullness. And this is what is placed adjacent in Parshas Shoftim: "when you come to the land," etc., "you shall be wholehearted [tamim] with Hashem your G-d" [Devarim 18:9, 13]. And similarly: "and I gave you a land which you did not toil for," etc., "and now — fear Hashem and serve Him in sincerity and truth," etc. [Yehoshua 24:13–14] — as stated above.

segments.he: ידוע כי א"י היא בחי' תיקון הברית. וע"כ כשפגמו בקדושת א"י ע"י המרגים כתיב בפ' מטות ויחר אף ד' ביום בבוא וכו' ושם ויחר אף ד' בישראל וכו'. וכן בפ' נצבים כתיב ויתשם ד' מעל אדמם באף וכו'. ובפ' האזינו כי אש קדתי באפי וכו'בחינת אש ואף הנ"ל. ושם אמרתי אפאיהם וכו'. וזה שנאמר בשעת החורבן עריכם שרופות אש. וכן ממרום שלח אש וכו' וכיוצא בזה הרבה. וע"כ על שעת הנחמה כתיב אודך ד' כי אנפתבי ישוב אפך ותנחמני. היינו שמשיב אפו ועושה מאותיות "אף" "פא". וזה שכתוב ג"+כ אף אש צריך תאכלם. כי אז ישוב אפו ואשו על העכו"ם צוררי ישראל. ומחמת שעיקר תיקון זה נעשה ע"י צדקה ע"כ אמרו רז"ל אין ירושלים נפדית אלא בצדקה. וזה שכתוב (ישעיה ל"ג) מי יגור לנו אש אוכלה וכו' הולך צדקות וכו'. וזה שנאמר (שם ט')ויאכלו את ישראל בכל פה. (היינו שינקו מכל ה"פא"ין הנ"ל. בכל זאת לא שב אפי וכו' (היינו בחינת אף הנ"ל) כי בערה כאש רשעה (בחינת אש הנ"ל) ויהי העם כמאכולת אש וכו' בכל זאת לא שב אפו וכו'. וזה שנאמר בקינות ג"כ פצו עליך פיהם וכו'. וכן פצו עלינו פיהם וכו' אבל לעתיד כתיב (ישעי' נ"ב) עליו יקפצו מלכים פיהם וכו'. וכן (מיכה ז') ישימו יד לפה וכו':
segments.en:
And also there is the primary drawing near of converts — the aspect of: "peoples will call out upon the mountain" — and it is written: "and all the nations shall be called in the Name of Hashem to it" [Devarim 28:10] — and many like these. And our Sages of blessed memory said: "beloved is Eretz Yisrael, for it renders converts fit." And this is what is written: "and it shall be in the end of days — the mountain of the house of Hashem shall be established," etc., "and all the nations shall flow to it," etc. [Yeshayahu 2:2–3]. And it concludes: "on that day a man shall cast away his silver idols," etc. — meaning: they shall cast away their faith and draw near to the faith of Israel, as is explained within the ma'amar.
 

 
 And through all of this one merits to the clarification of foods and the tikkun of eating in great holiness — until through their eating, the union of the Holy One Blessed be He and His Shechinah is produced — which is the aspect of הוי"ה אלקי"ם face to face. This is the aspect of: "and you shall eat there before Hashem your G-d" — and similarly: "and you shall eat there before Hashem your G-d." Meaning: that the eating should be in the aspect of the union of הוי"ה אלקים face to face — specifically lifnay [before / face to face]. For there one merits the breaking of the desire for eating — the aspect of: "which you will not eat in poverty", as is explained in Siman 47, in the ma'amar of V'achaltem.
 

 
 And behold — it is explained within the ma'amar that it is impossible to merit eating of such holiness except through fasting — for through this the klippos are subdued — which are the aspect of the three officers of Pharaoh who wish to suckle from speech. And also because through this one cleaves to the back of holiness — in the aspect of: "and there was famine in the land" [Bereishis 12:10]. Famine is the aspect of הוי"ה אלקים in the aspect of achorim [the back]. And it is explained within the ma'amar that in fasting one must return each time to receive strength from the beginning, etc. And this is the aspect of what the Torah warned them many times to remember the Exodus from Egypt and their walking in the wilderness and the beginning of their entry into Eretz Yisrael through great miracles and wonders. And all of this is because one must return each time and receive strength from the beginning — for this reason one must begin anew each time in the service of Hashem, as is explained within the ma'amar.
 

 
 And this is: "when you will have children," etc., "and you have grown old in the land," etc., "I call heaven and earth to witness against you," etc. [Devarim 4:25–26] — for through becoming old [noshantem] in the matter of the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — and they forgot the first beginning — through this they fell to what they fell to, until they were exiled from there. And afterwards indeed they established — for they enacted a fast for the exile. And so when they returned to Eretz Yisrael, the fasts were nullified — for there even eating is in holiness, as stated above. And this is what Moshe said to them in Parshas Ki Savo: "and I led you," etc., "bread you did not eat and wine and strong drink you did not drink," etc. [Devarim 29:4–5]. For then the eating had not yet been clarified in its fullness — since they had not yet entered the Land. Therefore they needed to eat manna — which is a spiritual food, bread from heaven. And immediately when they entered Eretz Yisrael: "and the manna ceased on the morrow — in their eating of the produce of the land" [Yehoshua 5:12]. For there, the clarification of foods and the eating are in such great holiness that they have no need for the manna.

segments.he: סימן פ"ד-במה הארכת ימים
segments.en:
And this is what Moshe said to them in Parshas Ekev: "all the commandment," etc., "and you shall come and inherit the land," etc., "and you shall remember all the way," etc., "in order to afflict you," etc., "and He afflicted you and let you hunger and fed you with manna," etc., "in order to make you know that not by bread alone does man live — but by everything that goes forth from the mouth of Hashem does man live," etc., "for Hashem your G-d brings you to a good land," etc., "a land in which you will not eat bread in poverty — and you shall eat and be satisfied — and you shall bless Hashem your G-d", etc., "beware lest you forget," etc., "lest you eat and be satisfied," etc., "and your heart will be lifted up and you will forget Hashem your G-d who brought you out of the land of Egypt," etc., "who led you through the wilderness," etc., "who fed you with manna," etc., "in order to afflict you and to test you — to benefit you in your end," etc. [Devarim 8:1–16] — meaning: He warned them, as stated above, to remember each time the power of the first beginning. For this is the aspect of the fasting — through which one cleaves to the back of holiness — which is the aspect of: "and He afflicted you and let you hunger and fed you with manna" — and similarly: "in order to afflict you," etc., "to benefit you in your end."
 

 (And perhaps it alludes to the aspect of the holy union of the aspect of the back of holiness, as stated above.)

 
 And this is: "for not by bread alone does man live," etc. — meaning, the aspect of the letters of holy speech that are clothed within every thing — and through the desire for eating, G-d forbid, the chitzonim [external negative forces] wish to suckle from there. Therefore one must draw the aspect of the tikkun through the fast — through which one cleaves as it were to the back of holiness — and it is impossible for them to suckle from there. And through the revelation of the holy panim [face / presence] — through this the klippos are entirely subdued — and the holy sparks come out from among them. And then is drawn the aspect of: "for then I will transform for all peoples a clear language — to call all of them in the Name of Hashem" [Tzefaniyah 3:9] — which is the primary perfection of the adornments of holy faith. And then eating is completed in such great holiness that through it the union of the Holy One Blessed be He is produced — the aspect of הוי"ה אלקים face to face — which union has the gematria of שָׁבַע [seventy / satiation — gematria 372] — the opposite of the aspect of famine, as is explained in the writings of the Ari, of blessed memory. And this is what concludes: "and you shall eat and be satisfied." Meaning: that the eating should be in such holiness that the holy union — whose gematria is sheva — is produced through it. And: "and you shall bless Hashem your G-d" — meaning, הוי"ה אלקים stated above — "for the good land," etc. For the primary tikkun of this is in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחינת ימין בחינת אהבה כנ"ל ומסטרא דימינא מותא חוורא ככספא. ע"כ שם עיקר שלימות זכות המחשבה והמוחין וזוכים להשיג עי"ז בכל יום רזין דאורייתא השייך לאותו היום שזה עיקר בחינת אריכת ימים כמבואר בפנים. ועיקר אריכת ימים הוא בא"י כמפורש במקראות הרבה. וע"כ אברהם שמדתו אהבה הי' הראשון לירושת א"תּי ונאמר בו זקן בא בימים. וע"כ בא"י צריכים ליזהר ביותר במדת הוותרנות שהיא מדתו של אברהם:
segments.en:
And this is what He warned them — not to forget, G-d forbid, the first beginning. Rather, even in Eretz Yisrael where the eating was permitted to them — even so they should draw each time also the aspect of the segulah of the fast — through the remembrance each time of the power of the beginning — so that through this the chitzonim should have no hold whatsoever, G-d forbid, in their eating. And this is what is also warned there: "lest you eat," etc., "and you say in your heart: my strength and the power of my hand has done this wealth for me," etc. — meaning: that one should, G-d forbid, attach great importance to the intermediate causes — which is the primary blemish of emunah, as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is: "and you shall remember Hashem your G-d — for it is He who gives you strength to achieve wealth." Meaning: that everything is only from Him, blessed be He. And therefore: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." For eating there is in the aspect of sacrifices — in the aspect of a table that resembles an altar, which atones. And this is: "this is the table that is before Hashem" — specifically lifnay — the aspect of the union face to face. And it is explained within the ma'amar that then the Shechinah intercedes before the Holy One Blessed be He for those who are distant — to draw them near. And that the Holy One Blessed be He will perform wonders — in order that they may know, from the revealed, of the concealed — that everything is conducted only through the will and the Providence of the Holy One Blessed be He.
 

 
 And this is: "for the land which you are coming to inherit is not like the land of Egypt", etc., "which you watered with your foot," etc. — meaning: it requires many intermediate means through human effort. But in Eretz Yisrael: "it drinks water from the rain of heaven" [Devarim 11:10–11] — meaning through the Holy One Blessed be He Himself. And this too is the aspect of miracles and wonders in Eretz Yisrael — which are the aspect of rain — as is explained in the ma'amar of Mishpatim Emunah, Siman 7. And this is what concludes: "the eyes of Hashem your G-d are upon it always" — for there the light of His Providence, blessed be He, shines — which is the aspect of wonders.
 

 
 And this is what is written: "blow a shofar in Tzion — sanctify a fast," etc. [Yoel 2:15] — meaning: to draw also the aspect of the tikkun of the fast stated above — and afterwards: "and Hashem was zealous for His land," etc. — specifically for His land, as stated above. And it concludes: "and you shall eat — eat and be satisfied," etc. — meaning: that eating should be in the aspect of the holy union whose gematria is sheva [seventy / satiation]. And this is: "and praise the Name of Hashem your G-d — Who has performed wondrous things for you." Meaning the aforementioned wonders. And this is: "and you shall know that I am in the midst of Israel" — in the manner of what our Sages of blessed memory said [Ta'anis 11a]: "a person should always consider himself as if the Holy One dwells within his innards" — Rashi explained: for it is forbidden to afflict oneself in fasting, etc. — as it is said: "for in your midst is the Holy One." And this is: "for I am in your midst, O Israel" — that I am in your midst literally — and your eating is so precious that through it such a holy union is made. And this is: "and I am Hashem your G-d — and there is none other." For the Shechinah intercedes then in her prayer until she brings it about that all the intermediate causes are nullified — and all will see that only the Holy One Blessed be He watches over Israel and guides them with His great mercies and awesome wonders. And this is: "and My people shall never be put to shame."
 

 
 For it is explained in the holy books regarding the verse: "he will be filled with shame" [Chavakuk 2:16] — that even shame and embarrassment have the segulah of fasting. And this is the aspect of the shame of famine — for both are one aspect. And this is what is said there in the aforementioned verses — first: "sanctify a fast," etc., "spare Your people, Hashem — and do not give Your inheritance to shame," etc. But afterwards they received good tidings that they would not need to fast and would not be ashamed either. And to explain somewhat: shame is also the aspect of concealment of the face — and the aspect of achorim [back / reverse side] — as our Sages of blessed memory said [Pesachim, chapter 7]: "and the bride turns her face away" — and the explanation is: out of shame. And similarly it is said: "they shall retreat backwards and be put to great shame" [Yeshayahu 42:17]. And similarly: "I was ashamed and embarrassed to lift my face toward You", etc. [Ezra 9:6]. And therefore sometimes even through shame, the tikkun of the fast is drawn. But they received the good tidings that they would not need shame or fast, as stated above.

segments.he: סימן פ"ה-פוסעים בו
segments.en:
Regarding the matter of how through fasting, speech is completed and emunah is rectified — one may say that this is what Dovid said: "I have believed, therefore I speak — I am greatly afflicted [anisi me'od]" [Tehillim 116:10] — the three aforementioned aspects. And it is said: "and faithfulness answers me [ve'emunah anisani]" [Tehillim 119:75]. And this is: "remember, Hashem, all of Dovid's afflictions," etc. [Tehillim 132:1]. For when he wished to establish the place of the Bais HaMikdash — where the primary holy union is in the aspect of face to face — he was first required to draw the aspect of the tikkun through fasting. And this is what he said: "and I — in my poverty I prepared" [Divray HaYomim I 22:14] — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: from the language of fasting — as stated above. And see in Etz Chayyim, the gate of the diminishing of the moon — how in the generation of the wilderness the union was during the weekdays in the aspect of back-to-back — this being the aspect of: "have I been a wilderness to Israel?", etc. [Yirmiyahu 2:31]. And at the building of the First Temple the union was in the aspect of face to face. And this is somewhat aligned with our words above.
 

 
 Siman Samech-Gimel · סימן ס"ג

 Sod Kavanas HaMilah — "The Secret of the Intention of Circumcision"

 סוֹד כַּוָּנַת הַמִּילָה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 63

segments.he: ידוע כי א"י בפרט הבית המקדש היא בחינת המלכות דקדושה ועיקר שלימות בנינה הוא ע"י המוחין שהם בחינת אור שבעת הימים. וע"כ נאמר בכיבוש יריחו שהוא כיבוש הראשון של א"י ושבעה כהנים ישאו שבעה שופרות וכו'. כי ע"י תקיעת שופר ממשיכין המוחין הנ"ל כמבואר בכוונת שופר. וזהו שנאמר על לעתיד והי' אור הלבנה כאור החמה ואור החמה יהי' שבעתים כאור שבעת הימים וכו'. כי כל בחינת כלולה מכל השבעה. וזה שכתוב (זכרי' ג') כי הנה האבן וכו'. ופירש"י יסוד הביהמ"ק על אבן אחת שבעה עינים וכו'. וכן (שם ד') ראיתי מנור זהב וכו'ושבעה נרותיה עליה וכו'.ושם כי מי בז יום קטנות וכו' עי' רש"י שבעה אלה עיני ד' וכו':
segments.en:
This matter is connected with the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "and this is the matter [ha-davar] that Yehoshua circumcised" [Yehoshua 5:4] — and as Rashi explained there. For the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of bris — as it is written: "and I will give you the land," etc., "and you shall guard My covenant" [Bereishis 17:8–9]. And it is written: "and He cut a covenant with him — to give the land of Kena'an" [Nechemiah 9:8]. And it is written: "to Israel — an eternal covenant — saying: to you I will give the land of Kena'an" [Tehillim 105:10–11]. And bris is the aspect of the seventh day — which is Shabbos — which is comprised of all the six days — which are the aspect of six tefachim [handbreadths].
 

 
 And this is the fact that the conquest of Yericho — which was through the circling of the city for six days, once each day, and on the seventh day — which was Shabbos — they circled seven times and the wall fell and the conquest of the Land began. And the Tzaddikim — who are the aspect of bris — of them it is written: "the righteous shall inherit the land."
 

 
 And just as in the aspect of bris there is the aspect of revealing a handbreadth and concealing a handbreadth — so too regarding the sanctity of the Land. For there is also an Eretz Yisrael above — in concealment — as is understood in the holy Zohar — and in particular regarding Yerushalayim, it is stated explicitly: "built as a city that is joined together" [Tehillim 122:3]. And regarding the Bais HaMikdash it is written: "the place of Your dwelling that You made, Hashem" [Shmos 15:17]. And it is explained in the Zohar [Vayikra 21] regarding the final Temple — that it will be comprised of the two prior Temples — the First Temple in concealment and the Second Temple in revelation. And also: sometimes its holiness is in revelation and now in concealment — and similarly all the aspects of revealing and concealing that exist with the Tzaddik exist similarly also in Eretz Yisrael.

segments.he: סימן פ"ו-פוסעים בו פסיעה קטנה
segments.en:
Namely: sometimes the Land reveals to a person some sparkling of the pleasantness of its holiness — to the extent that: "if a man would give all the wealth of his house for love — he would be utterly scorned" [Shir HaShirim 8:7]. And sometimes — for the sake of the test of the person and his free choice — it conceals somewhat the pleasantness of its holiness — until doubts and great questions fall regarding it, as is known to those who are experienced in this. And for the most part, the very concealment and hiddenness is itself also for the sake of revelation and drawing near. For if it were to reveal the full intensity of its holiness — then not every person would merit to dwell therein. And this is similar to what our Sages of blessed memory said regarding: "a land that devours its inhabitants" — the Holy One Blessed be He said: "I thought of it for good — and they thought of it for evil", etc. [Sotah 35a]. For one who does not merit, G-d forbid, is distanced through the partial concealment and covering — which is truly for his benefit — for the sake of drawing near, as stated above.
 

 
 And similarly what exists with the Tzaddik — the aspect of revealing and concealing — relative to the Holy One Blessed be He: the more one draws close to Him, blessed be He, the more one knows that one is still distant from Him, blessed be He. And in truth this is the primary perfection of the service. And as is explained elsewhere. This is the aspect of: "I said: I will become wise — but it is distant from me" [Koheles 7:23]. And to this one merits in Eretz Yisrael — which is called eretz merachakayim [the land of distances], as stated above many times. And it is written: "on the third day, Avraham lifted his eyes and saw the place from afar" [Bereishis 22:4]. And it is written: "I raise my knowledge afar [lemerachok]" [Iyov 36:3] — which refers to the Bais HaMikdash, as is brought in the Sefer HaMidos, letter Da'as. And it is written — regarding the consolation of Yerushalayim: "counsels from afar [merachok] — faithful faithfulness" [Yeshayahu 25:1]. And it is said: "for behold — I am saving you from afar [merachok]" [Yirmiyahu 30:10]. And it is written: "from afar Hashem appeared to me," etc. [Yirmiyahu 31:3]. And it is written: "remember Hashem from afar [merachok] — and let Yerushalayim come up upon your heart" [Yirmiyahu 51:50]. And as is explained in several verses explicitly — that specifically because of the greatness of the closeness and their imagining that they are already close to Him, blessed be He, and of His household — this specifically caused the distancing and the exile. And as Rashi explained on the verse: "turn away your eyes from me — for they overwhelm me" [Shir HaShirim 6:5]. For in truth, the closer one is to the palace of the King — the more one must be in awe — and know that one is still distant. And similarly the opposite — even in the intensity of the distancing and the strengthening of the exile — one must also remember Him, blessed be He, and anticipate and hope for the building of Yerushalayim and the revelation of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — in the aspect of: "remember Hashem from afar — and let Yerushalayim come up upon your heart," as stated above.
 

 
 And similarly what exists with the Tzaddik — the aspect of revealing and concealing — relative to himself: sometimes he reveals a face of will and watchfulness, etc., and sometimes he covers and accepts suffering, etc. — this is also true of Eretz Yisrael. For there is the primary revelation of the light of will and Providence — and even so it is one of the three things given through suffering, as our Sages of blessed memory said. And there are those who bear suffering in Eretz Yisrael — and this is only for the good of the world — in the aspect of: "yet it was our sicknesses that he bore" [Yeshayahu 53:4]. And as is brought in the holy books — and see Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 15. And also Eretz Yisrael accepts everything upon itself for the benefit of Israel — in the manner of: "He poured out His fury upon the stones" [alluding to the teaching that the stones of the Temple bore the divine wrath in place of Israel].
 

 
 And because Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of bris — which is comprised of the aspect of wings [kanafayim], as is explained within the ma'amar — therefore we find in it also the language of kanafayim — such as: "to seize the corners [kanfos] of the earth" — and such as: "from the wing [miknaf] of the earth we have heard songs" — all of which our Sages of blessed memory expounded regarding Eretz Yisrael.

segments.he: א"י היא בחינת שבת כנ"ל וע"כ שם עיקר תיקון רגלי הקדושה כמו שכתוב עומדות היו רגלינו בשעריך ירושלים. וכן לעתיד לבא נאמר ועמדו רגליו ביום ההוא על הר הזיתים וע"כ כשנתבשר יעקב אבינו ע"ה על ירושת הארץ נאמר אחר כך וישא יעקב רגליו. וע"כ ע"י קדושת א"י זוכין לילך ממדריגה למדריגה בעבודת ד' כמבואר במקום אחר. גם שם בא"י עיקר שימות בחינת האמת כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וכשמדבר את עצמו במדה זו היא סעד לתמכו. אך עדיין צריכין ליתן כח להרגלים כדי שיוכלו לילך היטב. וזה ע"י צדקה של א"יּ שהיא בחינת עוה"ב כנ"ל כמ"פ. ושם עיקר שלימות אור הצדקה כנ"ל. וזה מי יגור באהלך וכו' הולך תמים ופועל צדק ודובר אמת וכו'. וזה אהלך באמתך וכתיב אתהלך לפני ד' בארצות החיים.
segments.en:
And behold — the primary tikkun of the holy wings — the aspect of the wings of the keruvim [cherubs] — is in Eretz Yisrael. For there the holy keruvim were in the Bais HaMikdash — in the aspect of: "and the keruvim were spreading wings upward," etc. [Shmos 25:20]. And through holy words the aforementioned wings are given strength. And then the researchers have no great power to spread their evil wisdom, G-d forbid. But through evil words — and in particular if one speaks, G-d forbid, disparagingly of the Tzaddik or disparagingly of Eretz Yisrael, G-d forbid — in the aspect of those who bring forth evil reports of the Land — through this one makes wings for the serpent — until it flies with its wisdom, G-d forbid.
 

 
 And behold — Eretz Yisrael itself is the aspect of holy wisdom — for there is the source of wisdom, as stated above. And it teaches knowledge and wisdom to all Israel who merit to dwell therein — in the aspect of: "and all your children shall be disciples of Hashem." But because the aforementioned researchers overpower with their evil wisdom — therefore the holiness of Eretz Yisrael suffers greatly from this — for through this certain confusions fall even there — which is the aspect of mivtach boged [treacherous trust]. And from this, sometimes jealousy and hatred arise between one person and another in Eretz Yisrael, G-d forbid. And all of this is because of the overpowering of mivtach boged — namely, trust that is not full and true as it should be. Therefore one must strengthen and fortify oneself there even more — in strong and complete trust as is appropriate. For the primary perfection of trust is according to the perfection of the intellect, as is explained elsewhere. And the primary perfection of the intellect is in Eretz Yisrael. And when one merits to strengthen oneself there in full and true trust — through this the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael is drawn upon him even more — as it is written: "one who takes refuge in Him shall inherit the land and possess My holy mountain" [Yeshayahu 57:13]. And through this itself one subdues the aforementioned evil wisdoms and draws complete faith and trust into the world.
 

 
 Siman Samech-Daled · סימן ס"ד

segments.he: סימן פ"ז-תתן אמת
segments.en:
Bo El Par'oh — "Come to Pharaoh"

 בֹּא אֶל פַּרְעֹה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 64

 
 In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary perfection of wisdom and intellect. And through this one is able to settle the difficulties that arise from the aspect of the breaking of the vessels [shviyas hakeilim — the Kabbalistic concept of the shattering of primordial divine "vessels" prior to the current world order]. And also in Eretz Yisrael there is the primary perfection of emunah — through which one passes over even all the difficulties drawn from the aspect of the challal hapanuy [the empty space / void — the Kabbalistic concept of the space within which creation was formed, which is beyond rational comprehension]. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is called Eretz HaIvrim [the land of the Hebrews]. For there one merits such complete emunah that one passes [over] through it over everything. And as is also explained within the ma'amar — regarding the reason Israel are called Ivrim [Hebrews — from the root avar, to cross / to pass over], etc.
 

 
 And this is what is written: "sing to Hashem — who dwells in Tzion — declare His deeds among the peoples" [Tehillim 9:12] — this being the aspect of speech, which is the aspect of intellect and wisdom, as is explained within the ma'amar. And it is written: "to You, silence is praise — O G-d, in Tzion" [Tehillim 65:2] — meaning: the aspect of silence, through which one passes over the difficulties that come from the challal hapanuy — the aspect of: "be silent — for thus it arose in thought", as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחי' יראה כנ"ל. ומחמת שתחלת היראה נקראת צדק כי היא רק בחינת יראת העונש שהיא בחינת ינים ויסורין ע"כ אמרו רז"ל כי א"י היא אחת מג' דברים שנתנו ע"י יסורין. אך אמרו רז"ל צדק כד אתחבר בה אמת איקרי אמונה וכל טיבו וכל נהירו שרייא בה. וע"כ אחר כך כשזוכין נשלמת היראה ואז היא בבחינת יראת הרוממות בחי' אמונה כמו שכתוב שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה. ואז נמתקין כל הדינים וזוכין לכל טוב גם בגשמיות כנ"ל. וע"כ א"י נקראת נחלת יעקב בחינת תתן אמת ליעקב כמבואר בפנים:
segments.en:
And behold — it is explained in Parshas Shoftim that from the other cities that are not from Eretz Yisrael, when one fights against them — it is permitted to spare their women and children, etc. For they are from the aspect of the klippos that come from the aspect of the breaking of the vessels — within which there are some holy sparks. And therefore one can settle those difficulties that come from there. And therefore regarding the aforementioned cities it is also permitted to make peace — and: "they shall be for you as tribute and shall serve you" [Devarim 20:11]. But regarding the peoples who are in Eretz Yisrael, it is written regarding them: "you shall not allow any soul to live" [Devarim 20:16]. For they are from the aspect of the heresy and the difficulties that come from the aspect of the challal hapanuy — about which it is said: "all who come to her do not return — and they do not reach the paths of life" [Mishlei 2:19].
 

 
 And one may say that this was the sin of the spies — who said: "we came to the land, and indeed it flows with milk and honey," etc., "however — the people are strong," etc. [Bamidbar 13:27–28]. And similarly afterwards it is written: "for it is stronger than we [mimenu]" [ibid. 13:31] — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: as if to say, as it were — the Master of the house is unable to remove His vessels from there. For since they drew sustenance from the aspect of the challal hapanuy — where, as it were, the Holy One Blessed be He Himself contracted and cleared His G-dliness from there — therefore they are exceedingly strong, and it is impossible to overcome them through any intellect or letters. And this is: "and Calev silenced the people toward Moshe [vayahas Calev es ha'am el Moshe]" [Bamidbar 13:30] — and Rashi explained: an expression of silence. Meaning: he hinted to them that even though in truth it is impossible to settle these difficulties through any intellect — nevertheless Moshe Rabbainu merited such a level of silence that through it he would be able to elevate even those souls that had fallen into these confusions and bewilderments — and to instill in them such complete emunah that through this they would pass over all the aforementioned, as stated above. And this is: "and Calev silenced the people toward Moshe" — meaning: he shone upon them the aspect of the silence of Moshe. And this is: "and he said: we shall surely go up and inherit it — for we can surely do it" [Bamidbar 13:30]. For through this we will be able to overpower even these seven nations — and to destroy them entirely — and all through the power and the merit of Moshe.
 

 
 And because the primary creation of the world was through the challal hapanuy — into which it is impossible to enter through any intellect — but only through emunah. And this is the aspect of: "and all His deeds in faithfulness" [Tehillim 33:4]. And Eretz Yisrael is the primordial point of Creation — as it is written: "out of Tzion — the perfection of beauty," etc. — the aspect of the Even HaShetiyah — from which everything was founded. For it arose first in thought — for it is the ultimate point of the desire that arose in His simple will, blessed be He, for the totality of Creation — in the aspect of: "You favored, Hashem, Your land," etc. Therefore it is most closely positioned to the aspect of the challal hapanuy — which was for the sake of Creation.
 

 
 And this is what is written: "and the earth will be formed and the world will be created [v'sucholal eretz vatevel]" [Tehillim 90:2] — the aspect of the aforementioned challal [void / space — cognate with sucholal]. And it is explained within the ma'amar that this is the aspect of dispute — where each one separates from the other and pulls toward a different side. And this is the aspect of the division of the Land — as it is written: "to these shall the land be divided" [Bamidbar 26:53]. And it is written: "and Yehoshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel — according to their divisions by their tribes" [Yehoshua 11:23]. And there: "as an inheritance according to their divisions". And there: "and Yehoshua divided the land there for the children of Israel — according to their divisions" [Yehoshua 18:10]. And because for such a division and dispute — which is the aspect of the challal hapanuy — it is impossible to enter through any intellect — therefore it is written: "only by lot shall the land be divided" [Bamidbar 26:55]. And this is: "the lot settles disputes" [Mishlei 18:18]. For the lot — which is only the aspect of emunah — this nullifies all the difficulties that come from the aspect of the challal hapanuy, which is the aspect of dispute. And this is why in Parshas Mas'ay — adjacent to the matter of inheriting the land by lot — is placed the warning to drive out all the inhabitants of the Land, etc. — for it is one matter, as stated above.

segments.he: סימן פ"ח-המכסה שמים
segments.en:
And therefore the reward of the Tzaddikim in the future — which is their attainment of the secret of the challal hapanuy, as is explained within the ma'amar — is also called by the name goral [lot] — as it is written: "and you shall rest and stand to your portion [goralecha] at the end of days" [Daniel 12:13]. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the World to Come — and a portion in Eretz Yisrael is like a portion in the World to Come, as is brought — as stated above.
 

 
 And behold — in Eretz Yisrael is rooted the entirety of the sacred songs and melodies — this being the aspect of the song that the Levites would sing in the Bais HaMikdash. And this is the aspect of: "sing to Hashem — who dwells in Tzion" — and many like these. And this is: "from the wing of the earth we have heard songs." And there is the primary illumination of the holy melody — the aspect of rosh emunah [the beginning of faith / the head of faith — a peak of Eretz Yisrael]. As it is written: "come with me from Levanon — my bride — come with me from Levanon — look from the peak of emunah [rosh emunah]" [Shir HaShirim 4:8] — and as Rashi explained there: when the exiles are gathered to this mountain whose name is Emunah [Faith] — which is at the northern border of Eretz Yisrael — they look from there and see the border of Eretz Yisrael and the air of Eretz Yisrael — and they rejoice and say thanks, etc. Meaning: for there this song shines most.
 

 
 And behold — if Moshe had brought Israel into the Land — then all the difficulties drawn from the challal hapanuy would also have been nullified. And Israel would have remained there permanently. But because of the sin of the spies — who sinned in this, as stated above — through this all of them remained in the wilderness, and Moshe too was compelled to remain there with them, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. And this is what is written in Parshas Vayeilech: "behold — you will lie with your fathers", etc. [Devarim 31:16]. For through the klippos and the difficulties drawn from there — through this Israel afterwards came to idolatry — until many troubles came upon them, G-d forbid. And this is: "because my G-d is not in my midst — these evils have found me — and I will surely hide My face," etc. [Devarim 31:17]. For in truth even then the Holy One Blessed be He was with them — only in the aspect of concealment of the face, G-d forbid. And now: "and now — write for yourselves this song," etc. [Devarim 31:19]. And: "and this song shall testify before Him as a witness — for it shall not be forgotten from the mouth of his descendants," etc. [Devarim 31:21]. For this song is from the aspect of the melody and the song of the future — through which one elevates the souls even from the aspect of the difficulties of the challal hapanuy, as stated above.

segments.he: עיקר אהבה ויראה דקדושה הוא בא"י כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וע"כ שם עיקר ירידת השפע לכל העולם כי אהבה ויראה הם הידים לקבל בהם כל ההשפעות וברכות. אך מחת שיש בעוה"ר מקטריגים שאינם מניחים להוריד השפע ע"י ארץ ישראל שמפורסים לכל ששם ירידת השפע ע"י אהבה ויראה כנ"ל. ע"כ נמצאים בכל דור בחינת מוציאי דבר הארץ שמעלימין ומכסין את האהבה ויראה שבא"י. ולפעמים נותן השי"ת גם בלב צדיקים וכשרים ומנוע מא"י כנראה בחוש גם בכל דור ודור והכל מחמת הנ"ל. הגם כי סברתם היא מחמת סכנת הדרכים ושאר מניעות. והיא ע"ד שכתבו התוס' (כתובות ק"י:) ד"ה הוא עי"ש. אבל הא גופא יש לומר שנמשך ג"כ מזה ואפי' חסרון הפרנסה שבא"י וכיוצא הכל הוא מחמת ששם שושר ירידת השפע. ע"כ מעלימין ומכסין אורה בכוונה מלמעלה מפני המקטריגים כנ"ל.ואפשר שעל דרך זה אמרו רז"ל ג"כ צדיקים מהני זכותייהו אעלמא אדידהו לא והוא במכוון כנ"ל:
segments.en:
And this is what is written: "I will mention Rahav and Bavel among those who know Me — behold Philistia and Tyre with Kush — this one was born there," etc. [Tehillim 87:4] — and Rashi explained there: that the entire Psalm revolves around the fact that in the future all the nations will bring all the souls of Israel that became absorbed and lost among them. And this is what concludes: "Hashem shall count, in the writing of peoples" — meaning, in the future, when all the nations will be written [for their punishment] — then Hashem will count all the souls of Israel that were swallowed among them and bring them out from among them. It follows that it speaks of the souls of Israel that are destined to ascend from all the falls into which they fell — even though there are nations such that their sustenance is from the aspect of the concealments and the difficulties of the challal — they will ascend even from there.
 

 
 And this is what concludes: "and singers like dancers — all my wellsprings [ma'ayanay] are in you" [Tehillim 87:7]. Meaning: they will then sing this song — through which even all the bewilderments of the challal hapanuy are nullified — this being the aspect of: "and singers like dancers — all my thoughts and reflections are cleaved to You." The aspect of: "then Moshe shall sing [yashir]" [spelled as if imperfect — future / active] — for the name Yud — regarding the thought — was said. For to this song merit those Tzaddikim who are the aspect of silence — the aspect of thought. Through which they are able to enter even into those bewilderments — and to elevate the souls that fell there — until they too merit the aspect of the holiness of thought — to cleave themselves in their thought to the Ohr Ayin Sof [the Infinite Light] Himself, blessed be He — which is the aspect of sovev kol almin [that which surrounds all the worlds] — for He surrounds and encompasses even over the challal hapanuy, etc., as is explained within the ma'amar.
 

 
 And see in the Midrash [Shocher Tov on Tehillim 87] that our Sages of blessed memory also brought this very verse: "look from the peak of emunah" — regarding the future — that the nations will bring the souls of Israel as a gift and offering to the King Mashiach — aligned with our matter. For because there are bewilderments of the aspect of the challal hapanuy into which it is forbidden to enter, as stated above — only through the aspect of the melody and the aforementioned song will the souls that fell there ascend of themselves — for they themselves will bring them and return them to holiness — in the aspect of: "and they shall bring all your brothers as an offering to Hashem" [Yeshayahu 66:20] — and as is also explained in the ma'amar of Amtza'isa, Siman 24.
 

 
 And according to the above it is explained what our Sages of blessed memory said [Megillah 14a]: "once Israel entered the Land — no other lands were found worthy of saying song." For the primary songs and melodies are in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above. And this is: "how shall we sing," etc., "on foreign soil?" And therefore the full completion of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael was through King Dovid, may peace be upon him — who merited to be ne'im zemiros Yisrael "the sweet singer of Israel". And this is: "the utterance of the man raised on high — who established the yoke of repentance — and the sweet singer of Israel" [Shmuel II 23:1]. For through these songs and melodies — which are from the aspect of the melody and song of the future — through which one elevates even all the souls of Israel that fell into the bewilderments of the aspect of the challal hapanuy — through this one can return all the souls of Israel in complete teshuvah. And therefore in truth it is explained in the words of our Sages of blessed memory that Tehillim is suited for teshuvah. And therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory said [Shocher Tov on Tehillim 18]: "when Israel said song — their transgressions were forgiven."

segments.he: סימן פ"ט-וסי' צ'
segments.en:
And therefore in Eretz Yisrael — where the sacred songs and melodies are precious — in the aspect of: "the time of song has arrived — and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land" [Shir HaShirim 2:12]. And it is said: "take from the zimras ha-aretz," etc. — therefore: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." And therefore when Shlomo built the Bais HaMikdash — which is the innermost dimension of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — he composed Shir HaShirim. And this is what is also said regarding the future: "this song shall be for you — like the night when a holy feast is prepared" — meaning, the night of Pesach, which symbolizes two aspects of the aforementioned bewilderments, as is understood within the ma'amar — "and gladness of heart like one who walks with a flute — to come to the mountain of Hashem," etc. [Yeshayahu 30:29] — specifically: "like one who walks with a flute" — for through this song one merits to attain the secret of the challal hapanuy, as stated above — which is the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — the mountain of Hashem, etc.
 

 
 And see in Mishlei [Mishlei 25:19 — but the author cites it as Mishlei 27]: "the great One formed all [rav mechollel kol] — and He pays the fool — and He pays the one who passes over [overim]" [Mishlei 25:19] — see Rashi there: the Holy One Blessed be He created everything, etc., we have no need of any wisdom, etc. And according to the above, the matter is explained in this way: the Holy One Blessed be He created the entire Creation through the secret of the challal hapanuy — and this is the aspect of: "the great One formed all" — specifically mechollel [from the same root as challal — void]. And even though all of Creation was through wisdom — nonetheless the wisdom that exists in the aspect of the challal hapanuy is impossible for any human being to attain. And therefore all are there as fools — and the Holy One Blessed be He gives reward to the person for this — that he knows the truth: that he is a fool there — for it is impossible to attain the wisdom that is there. And this is: "and He pays the fool [sachreu kesil]." But Israel — through their holy emunah — pass over even the aspect of the challal hapanuy — and merit to cleave to the Ohr Ayin Sof Himself — which is the aspect of sovev kol almin — for He surrounds and encompasses even over the challal hapanuy. And therefore they are called Ivrim [those who pass over] — for they pass over everything with their emunah, as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is: "and He pays the ones who pass over [overim]." For He, blessed be He, gives reward to Israel who pass over — for their emunah also passes over the aspect of the challal hapanuy, as stated above.
 

 
 And in truth there is no greater reward than this itself — when one merits to ascend and pass all the levels of wisdom that exist throughout the entirety of Creation — until the beginning of the Atzilus [the world of Emanation — the highest of the four spiritual worlds] — which is the primordial point of Creation. And afterwards one ascends and passes even further — until one passes even over the aspect of the challal hapanuy — and cleaves to the Ohr Ayin Sof Himself. But even one who does not yet merit to this in its fullness — only that when bewilderments and confusions come upon him such that he cannot overpower them in any way — he makes himself into a fool and strengthens himself in complete emunah. Even for this there is great hope and great reward, as stated above.

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחינת השכינה כידוע. ושם עיקר השלימות בחי' כולך יפה רעיתי ומום אין בך בחי' לא תחסר כל בה. והיושבים בה שהם מבני היכלא דמלכא כשיש להם איזה חסרון ח"ו בודאי החסרון הוא בהשכינה כביכול. ונמצא שכצער גדול עוד יותר עי"ז כשמעלה זאת על לבו. אך אעפ"כ כשמיישב את עצמו אדרבה כמה יש לי לשמוח על שזכיתי להיות מבני היכלא דמלכא והמלך בעצמו מספר לי החסרון שלו. עי"ז נתמלא שמחה ונתחדשין המוחין שלו. ועי"ז בעצמו נמתקין הדינים ונתמלא החסרון כי כלהו במחשבה אתברירו כידוע. גם בא"י שם מקון השמחה בבחינת ישמח ישראל בעושיו בני ציון במלכם. ועי"ז נשלמין כל החסרונו' כמבוא' בפנים:
segments.en:
And see Rashi there — who explained: "and He pays the ones who pass over [overim]" — wayfarers who are idle from all work. For in truth, the primary work of the human being in this world is to bring out his holy wisdom from potential to actual. This is the aspect of: "and I have filled him with the spirit of G-d," etc., "in wisdom and understanding and knowledge — and in all manner of workmanship" [Shmos 31:3]. And for this he will receive great reward — each one according to his level. But even so, he will also receive reward for this: that when he reaches such aspects that come from the challal hapanuy — where, as it were, there is the aspect of bitul [nullification] — which is nullified and vacant of everything, as is explained within the ma'amar — and it is impossible to attain the wisdom that is there — therefore they too nullify themselves completely — and cleave to Him, blessed be He, in complete bitul — and through this they pass over everything. And this is included in his words, of blessed memory, who said: "az iz es gar shlechts, iz men zich gar mevatel" [Yiddish: "when things are very bad — one should completely nullify oneself"] — as stated above. When bewilderments and confusions overpower him — such that he cannot overpower them in any way — let him know that perhaps these confusions are drawn from the aspect of the challal hapanuy, according to his level. Therefore there is no wisdom and no counsel, etc. — but only to nullify oneself completely to Him, blessed be He, in complete bitul, as stated above. And there are still several more aspects to this — and to this is also relevant what our Sages of blessed memory said: "sometimes the nullification of Torah — that itself is its fulfillment." And then he will certainly also receive reward for the aspect of the bitul. And the peg upon which everything depends is to continually strengthen oneself — to speak with Him, blessed be He, in complete emunah. And then one will merit to pass in peace over everything — for it is written: "the faithful — Hashem preserves" [Tehillim 31:24]. And therefore also in the general sanctity of Eretz Yisrael it is said: "dwell in the land and tend to faithfulness." And similarly for the future — at the time of the ingathering of the exiles to Eretz Yisrael — when the holy song stated above will be sung — this being the aspect of: "on that day this song shall be sung in the land of Yehudah", etc. [Yeshayahu 26:1] — it is written there also: "open the gates — and let the righteous nation enter — the keeper of faithfulness", etc. [Yeshayahu 26:2]. For the primary thing is emunah, as stated above.
 

 
 Siman Samech-Hay · סימן ס"ה

 Va'Yomer Boaz — "And Boaz Said"

 וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 65

segments.he: סימן צ"א-ויהי ידיו אמונה
segments.en:
Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of ishah yiras Hashem [a woman who fears G-d], as is known. And from it branches spread — which are the aspect of money and wealth. And upon these branches grow fruits — the children — the aspect of: "precious children of Tzion — comparable to fine gold." And: "your silver and gold they took," etc., "and the children of Yehudah and Yerushalayim you sold." And therefore in the future: "to bring your sons from afar — their silver and gold with them."
