And: "the silver is Mine and the gold is Mine" — for in truth they belong only to Him and are fitting for Israel. But the non-Jews — besides stealing from Israel — accumulated silver and gold through their desire for Israel's wealth. Therefore in the future all will be stirred to return it to its root — the Bais HaMikdash — from which all wealth flows.

 And this is the golden tree of Shlomo — with branches and fruits of gold — alluding to all of the above. And: "and no man shall covet your land when you go up to appear before Me." And: "and they shall not appear before Me empty-handed." For there is the root of all abundance for everyone. And: "to a good field, to many waters — it was planted, to put forth a branch and to bear fruit." And: "you, O mountains of Israel, you shall give your branches and bear your fruit."

 And: "Shlomo had a vineyard in Ba'al Hamon" — Rashi: in Yerushalayim — "each one bringing for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver" — for these are very precious fruits — the precious children of Tzion comparable to fine gold. And: "my own vineyard is before me — the thousand is for you, Shlomo" — for they were compelled to return branches and fruits and all the wealth. And there in Eretz Yisrael is the primary wisdom — "the heart of the wise man is to his right" — which is Torah — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And there is the primary love and peace — "who makes your borders peace." And: "come and see how much they love one another."

 And there is the primary nullification of enemies — who draw from the hairs — the surplus of the brain — the aspect of gates on the right side — the aspect of: "the heart of the wise man is to his right." And: "your offspring shall possess the gate of their enemies." For when a gate of the left — from which enemies draw — becomes a gate of the right — through this enemies are subdued and we inherit their gates. And: "Hashem loves the gates of Tzion" — not only Tzion itself — the city of wisdom — but even the gates of Tzion — the aspects that are the introductions to wisdom — the surplus of the brain — even these are very good. For they are the gates of the right side — through them one can enter into true wisdom. And even the dispute in halachah — which appears as hatred flowing from hairs of the left side — through this very thing the halachah is clarified to its truth and they become lovers of one another — the aspect of: "Vahev in Sufah" — love at the end. It follows that this too is a gate of the right — the gates of Tzion — gates distinguished by halachah.

segments.he: בארץ ישראל שם עיקר שלימות האמונה ושלימות השכל. וע"כ שם זוכין לעלות בכל פעם ממדריגה למדריגה בענין זה ולבא מן האמונה אל השכל. ועי"ז באר לאמונה יותר גדולה וכן לשכל יותר גדול וכן להלך ממדריגה למדריגה בכל פעם:
segments.en:
And this is: "behold — the inheritance of Hashem is children" — in the reward of dwelling in Eretz Yisrael one merits worthy children — the aspect of: "and all your children shall be disciples of Hashem" — specifically in Eretz Yisrael — and: "great peace have your children" — they are in the aspect of peace and love — the opposite of hatred and strife. And: "the fruit of the womb is a reward" — the aspect of one who takes a worthy wife not for the sake of money but to study Torah in purity and beget worthy children — who are the fruit itself — not merely the branches. And: "they shall not be ashamed — when they speak with enemies in the gate" — the Torah scholars who defeat one another in halachah and appear as enemies — through this the halachah is clarified — gate of the right side — gates of Tzion.

 And: "praise Hashem, O Yerushalayim," etc. — "He has strengthened the bars of your gates — He has blessed your children within you — He makes your borders peace." And therefore in the future the nations will return to us the children together with silver and gold — and: "and foreigners shall build your walls." And: "your gates shall be open continually — day and night they shall not be shut" — for the subduing of enemies will be so complete that the gates will be open for them to come in submission. And: "to bring to you the wealth of nations and their kings under escort — for the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish." That is: literally the aspect of: "the wicked bow before the good, and the evil at the gates of the righteous."

 End of Installment Five. This completes the full, word-for-word translation of Simanim 56–65 of Likutay Kama. Every word of the Hebrew source has been rendered, including all Talmudic, Zoharic, and Biblical cross-references.

segments.he: סימן צ"ב-ע"י נע ונד
segments.en:
Notable in this installment: Siman 60 (Pasach Rabbi Shimon) contains the extensive teaching on the shanim kadmoniyos and yemay kedem — the primordial years and the awakening from sleep — with citations from Psalms 44, 74, 77, 143, and from Mishlei, Amos, Michah, Yechezkel, Yeshayahu, and Eichah — all translated in full. Siman 62 (Vayasev) contains the full teaching on fasting, the holy union face to face, and the rectification of eating — all translated completely. Siman 64 (Bo El Par'oh) contains the profound teaching on the challal hapanuy, the Ivrim, the sin of the spies, the sacred song, and Rabbainu's teaching on complete bitul — all translated in full, including his Yiddish teaching preserved in the text.
 

 The next installment continues with Siman 66.

segments.he: א"י היא בחי' לב כנ"ל שהיא בחי' יוסף. גם שם עיקר שלימות התורה שהיא בחינת כנפי ריאה דנשבי על לבא שעי"ז יכולין הצדיקים להחיות מתים כמבואר בפנים. וע"כ עיקר תחית המתים תהי' בא"י. ואמרו רז"ל עתידין צדיקים להחיות מתים וכו'. שנאמר עוד ישבו זקנים וזקנות ברחובות ירושלים ואיש משענתו בידו וכו'. וילפי לה מתחיית המתים דאלישע שהי' ע"י בחינה זו כמבואר בפנים. וזה וישב יעקב בארץ מגורי אביו בארץ כנען אלה תולדות יעקב יוסף וכו'. כי זה שייך לישיבת א"י כמבואר בפנים וכנ"ל:
segments.en:

 Siman Ayin · סימן ע'

 Vayehi B'Yom HaShemini — "And It Was on the Eighth Day"

 וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 70

segments.he: בארץ ישראל כתיב ואוהבי שמו ישכנו בה וכנ"ל כמה פעמים ומצות אהבה שקולה כנגד כל המצות. וע"כ אמרו רז"ל ישיבת א"י שקולה כנגד כל המצות. גם שם זוכין למוחין דגדלות ויכולים להתפלל בשכל צח. וע"כ שם עיקר מקום התפילה כנ"ל כמה פעמים:
segments.en:
Tzion and Yerushalayim are the aspect of Tzaddik yesod olam [the Righteous One — Foundation of the World], as is known. And as it is written: "from Tzion — the perfection of beauty — G-d shines forth" [Tehillim 50:2] — for from there is the foundation stone of the world. And in particular from the Even HaShetiyah — from which the sinews go out and spread through the entire world, as our Sages of blessed memory said. And from there holiness is drawn to all of Eretz Yisrael. And therefore it is written: "the righteous shall inherit the land — and they shall dwell upon it forever" [Tehillim 37:29] — for they are of one aspect.

 And just as the Tzaddik yesod olam is humble and lowly and makes himself as dust — and from him all the influences flow to the world — and if one gives him tzedakah it is like actual planting and he is immediately blessed — and also he has the drawing power to draw the entire world toward him — only there is the compelling force that impedes — and he is in the aspect of the mishkan [Sanctuary / dwelling-place] — for he has the drawing power to draw the Shechinah of His G-dliness, blessed be He, to the place where he stands — and near him is all the honor and greatness of the entire world — the aspect of: "in the place of His greatness — there you find His humility" — all of this stated above is also included in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim.

 For the dust of the Diaspora is impure dust — and within it there is the grip of arrogance greatly. And therefore it is designated for the dwelling of the non-Jews — who are most arrogant. And therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory said: "one who dwells in the Diaspora is like one who has no G-d," as it is written: "for they have driven me out," etc., "go serve other gods" [Shmuel I 26:19] — for all who are arrogant are as if they serve idolatry — and the Holy One Blessed be He says: he and I cannot dwell together, etc., as our Sages of blessed memory said. But Eretz Yisrael — its dust is holy soil — for it is the aspect of humility and lowliness. And therefore it is also called even now Eretz Kena'an — from the language of submission and lowliness, as is brought. And therefore it is uniquely suited for the settlement of Israel — a holy people who are humble and lowly — as it is written: "for you are the fewest of all peoples" [Devarim 7:7] — who diminish themselves, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded.

 And this is the aspect of: "and the humble shall inherit the land" — specifically. And our Sages of blessed memory said [Megillah 28a, Ta'anis 23a, Chulin 122b]: "come and see the difference between the forceful ones of Eretz Yisrael and the pious ones of Bavel — how much they love one another" — meaning: even the forceful ones of Eretz Yisrael are discreet and humble very greatly. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is specifically higher than all the lands — for: "whoever diminishes himself — he is great" — and: "I exalted and elevated the humble," as our Sages of blessed memory said. And therefore Eretz Yisrael and the Bais HaMikdash are called ga'on Yaakov [the pride / grandeur of Yaakov] — as it is written: "He chooses our inheritance for us" [Tehillim 47:5], etc. — and many like these. And the Bais HaMikdash is called ge'on uzechem [the pride of your strength]. For in the place of humility and lowliness — there is the primary grandeur and greatness. And therefore there the Shechinah of His G-dliness dwells — the aspect of: "I dwell with the contrite and lowly of spirit" [Yeshayahu 57:15]. And from there all influences flow to the entire world, as our Sages said. And there is the primary perfection of tzedakah — the aspect of: "and righteousness shall dwell in the orchard," as stated above. And tzedakah produces fruit — the aspect of: "tithe you shall tithe — tithe [asser] so that you may become wealthy [tit'asher]," etc. — and: "test Me now in this," etc. [Malachi 3:10].

segments.he: סימן צ"ד-זכר חסדו
segments.en:
And this is what is written: "and Yitzchak sowed in that land — and he found in that year a hundredfold — and Hashem blessed him" [Bereishis 26:12]. And our Sages of blessed memory said in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer: did Yitzchak actually sow grain? Rather — he took his money and gave tzedakah to the poor — as it is written: "sow for yourselves in righteousness" [Hoshea 10:12] — as is brought in Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 114 — as stated above.

 And Eretz Yisrael has the drawing power to draw the entire world toward it — for it is yefeh nof — sos kol ha'aretz [beautiful in situation — the joy of all the earth]. And it is called eretz tzvi tzva'os goyim [a land of desire — the deer of the nations] — for all the kings of the non-Jews desired it — to have a dwelling within it, as our Sages of blessed memory said. And it is called chemdas kol hagoyim [the desired thing of all the nations]. And furthermore — it has the drawing power to draw the Shechinah of His G-dliness, blessed be He, within it — the aspect of: "the mountain that G-d desired for His dwelling" [Tehillim 68:17]. And it is written: "for Hashem has chosen Tzion — He desired it for His dwelling" [Tehillim 132:13]. And it is written: "this is My resting-place forever." And it is written: "the land which Hashem your G-d seeks out — always are the eyes of Hashem your G-d upon it." And there is the primary honor and greatness — the aspect of: "that glory may dwell in our land." And it is written: "glorious things are spoken of you," etc. For the primary greatness is in the place of humility and lowliness.

 And this is what is written in the praise of Eretz Yisrael: "a land of mountains and valleys" [Devarim 11:11] — for there is contained together the greatness — which is the aspect of the mountain — with the lowliness — which is the aspect of the valley. And this is what is written regarding Yerushalayim: "and it shall be raised up and settled in its place" [Zechariyah 14:10] — for it will be at a very high and exalted level — and even so: "and it shall be settled in its place" — the aspect of lowliness — the aspect of: "let each man remain in his place", as is explained elsewhere. For: "in the place of His greatness — there you find His humility."

segments.he: עיקר עליית הנצוצות הק' הוא בא"י בחי' ושם תעלה עולותיך כי ארץ ישראל גבוה מכל הארצות וזה שער השמים שדרך שם עולין כל עבודותישראל וכל הקדושות ולשם נתקבצין כל שברי הנצוצות הנפולין והנדחין בבחי' אם יהי' נדחך וכו' והביאך אל הארץ וכו'. ושם עיקר שלימות האמונה ושלימות החכמה שעי"ז עולין הנצוצות. מחמת שהאמונה היא בחי' ז' והחמה היא בחי' יו"ד. ועיקר שלימות החכמה יהי' לעתיד בבחי' כי תמלא הארץ דעה וכו'. ע"כ לא כבשו רק שבעה עממין היינו ע"י בחי' אמונה שלימה שהיא בחי' ז'. אבל לעתיד יכבשו ג"כ הג' עממין ויהיו סה"כ יו"ד כמו שאמרו רז"ל. כי אז יזכו לשלימות החכמה שהיא בחי' יו"ד. ומחמת שכשנכללין הז' והי' נעשה עי"ן ע"כ אמרו רז"ל עתידה א"י שתתפשט בכל העולם כולו שיש בו ע' עממין. גם החכמה בעצמה היא בחי' ע' כמבואר בפנים. וע"כ נקראת ירושלים עיר עז לנו ישועה וכו'. כי היא כלולה מבחי' החכמה שהיא בחי' ע' והאמונה שהיא בחי' ז'. ועי"ז עיקר הישועה היינו שעולין הנצוצות הק' למקומם. והנה מבואר בפנים שעיקר בריאת כל העולמות הי' בשביל ישראל כדי להשפיע להם רב טוב. אך אינם יכולין לקבל ההשפעה כ"א על ידי שמעלין נצוצי אותיות הדיבור וכו'. כי גם הדיבור הוא בגלות עם ישראל וכו'. וזה שכתוב לענין מה שהנביאים קראו תגר על אורך הגלות של ישראל (ישעי' מ"ה) כה אמר ד' קדוש ישראל ויוצרו האותיות שאלוני על בני ועל פועל ידי תצוונו וכו' פירש"י ישראל שבשבילם יצרתי את הכל אתם באים לצוותי ולקרוא לפני תגר וכו'. אני כבר בראתי להם ישועה וכו'. האותיותדיקא. כי בזה תלוי עיקר הגאולה והישועה כנ"ל. כי עי"ז יכולים לקבל כל ההשפעות טובות כנ"ל שזה בחי' ישועות אלקינו כמבואר בפנים וע"כ בא"י ששם עיקר תיקון כל הנ"ל. ע"כ שם עיקר ירידת השפע לכל העולם כנ"ל:
segments.en:
And therefore the primary resurrection of the dead will be in Eretz Yisrael — as our Sages of blessed memory said — for there is the primary humility and lowliness — through which the resurrection of the dead will occur — as it is written: "awake and sing, O you who dwell in the dust" [Yeshayahu 26:19] — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one who made himself a neighbor of the dust in his lifetime. And this is the aspect of the honor and greatness that will come to Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim in the future — as explained in many verses — until all the kings of the non-Jews will bow before them. For then it will become known to all that there is the root of all greatness and honor — until all the heads and governors of the world must receive their honor from there. And this is what is written: "arise, shine — for your light has come, and the glory of Hashem shines upon you," etc. [Yeshayahu 60:1], "and nations shall walk by your light, and kings by the brightness of your rising," etc., "and foreigners shall build your walls, and their kings shall serve you," etc. — and the entire matter there — until: "and your people are all righteous — forever shall they inherit the land," etc., "the smallest shall become a thousand," etc. And similarly after: "because Hashem has anointed me to bring tidings to the humble," etc. [Yeshayahu 61:1] — and all the matter there. And similarly: "and nations shall see your righteousness, and all kings your glory," etc. [Yeshayahu 62:2] — and many more such verses.

 And to all this honor and greatness one will merit only through humility and lowliness — the aspect of: "before honor comes humility." Until even the overpowering of the compelling force — which overpowered greatly, to our great sorrow, until it caused the exile of Israel and Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim and the Bais HaMikdash — this came to a still greater aspect of lowliness and humility. And through this their drawing power will overpower even more — until all the compelling forces fall and are nullified — and the crown returns to its former place — with even greater splendor — as it is written: "for it has sunk into the dust," etc., "arise and help us," etc. [Tehillim 44:26]. And this is what is explained in many verses — that specifically through the shames and humiliations and lowliness they endure in the time of exile — through this very means they will merit in the future to great honor — the aspect of: "instead of your being forsaken and hated and with none passing through — I will make you an everlasting grandeur — the joy of generation after generation" [Yeshayahu 60:15] — and many more such verses.

 And this is: "remembering I will remember — and my soul is bowed down upon me" — meaning: it is greatly humbled through this — "this [precisely] I will return to my heart — therefore I will hope," etc. [Eichah 3:21]. And therefore: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven" — the aspect of: "who bears iniquity," etc., "for the remnant of His inheritance" [Michah 7:18]. And our Sages of blessed memory expounded: for one who makes himself like remnants — that is, the aspect of true humility and lowliness that one merits in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory said — in the Talmud and in the holy Zohar — that through Eretz Yisrael one merits the World to Come. In the manner of what our Sages of blessed memory said [Sanhedrin 88]: "they sent from there [from Eretz Yisrael]: who is a son of the World to Come? One who is humble and lowly of spirit, who bends when entering and bending when exiting," etc. — as stated above. For all of this one merits in Eretz Yisrael.

 
 Siman Ayin-Alef · סימן ע"א

segments.he: סימן צ"ה-כשפרנסי הדור
segments.en:
[No opening word given — the siman is untitled in source]

 סִימָן ע"א · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 71

 Our Sages of blessed memory said: "there are no sufferings without sin." And they also said: "one who dwells in Eretz Yisrael lives without sin — as it is written: 'the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven.'" If so, it would be fitting that those who dwell in Eretz Yisrael should have no sufferings whatsoever — in the aspect of: "and the inhabitant shall not say: I am sick," etc. But just as we find that truly righteous individuals have sufferings for the purpose of atoning for all of Israel — in the aspect of: "indeed our illnesses — he bore them", etc. [Yeshayahu 53:4], "and through his wounds we were healed," etc. — and: "and their iniquities — he shall carry" — and see there in Rashi: all the nations gain atonement through the sufferings of Israel, etc. — so too, Eretz Yisrael — since it is the foundation of everything and all who dwell in it are in the aspect of Tzaddikim, as is brought — therefore they carry it all, as stated above. And therefore in truth they will have great reward also for this — as it is written: "therefore I will divide him a portion among the many," etc. [Yeshayahu 53:12].

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחי' ענוה ושפלות בחי' "מה" כמו שכתוב וראיתם אךת הארץ מה היא. וע"כ כתיב וענווים יירשו ארץ וכו'. וע"כ צוה ד' ליעקב סביביו צריו ואמרו רז"ל כגון חליש לנוה קסטרא לחיפה סוסיתא לטברי' וכו'. וכתיב זאת ירושלים שמתיה בתוך הבוים וכו' בכדי שאם תזוח דעתם עליהם ורם לבבך ושכחת וכו' יקימו עליהם הצוררים ח"ו בבחי' תסיר מה היינו בחי'ענוה הנ"ל אזי נשאר פה בחי' ויאכלו את ישראל בכל פה רח"ל וכתיב פצו עלינו פיהם כל אובינו וכו':
segments.en:
And similarly, the primary abundance is received by Eretz Yisrael, as is known. Only sometimes it prefers the spiritual — and the material abundance goes and disperses through the entire world — in the manner of what our Sages of blessed memory said: "the Tzaddikim — their merit benefits the world, but not their own possession." And similarly our Sages of blessed memory said: "it is not enough for the Tzaddikim what is prepared for them for the World to Come," etc.

 
 Siman Ayin-Bais · סימן ע"ב

 L'Hischazek B'Chol Pa'am — "To Strengthen Oneself Each and Every Time"

 לְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל פַּעַם · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 72

segments.he: סימן צ"ו-זומם
segments.en:
It has already been explained many times that Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of the Tzaddik yesod olam. And just as in the matter of drawing close to the Tzaddikim — we find that sometimes the evil inclination overpowers one more greatly then — for: "whoever is greater than his fellow — his evil inclination is greater," etc. — as is explained within the ma'amar. So too in truth — through the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael the yetzer hara [evil inclination] is certainly subdued and nullified. For a person does not transgress unless a spirit of foolishness has entered him. But Avira d'Eretz Yisrael machkim — and therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory said [Nedarim 22]: "and He gave you there a trembling heart — it is written specifically regarding Bavel" — and see there in Chidushay Agados — where it is explained that in the Diaspora the evil inclination overpowers more than in Eretz Yisrael, etc.

 And in particular — as is explained within the ma'amar — the primary root of the evil inclination is from the aspect of anger and stern judgments. And of Eretz Yisrael it is written: "and I will establish a place for My people Israel — and they shall be disturbed no more" [Shmuel II 7:10]. For there all types of anger and judgment are sweetened. But even so — due to the greatness of free choice — the evil inclination can overpower, G-d forbid, there as well. And sometimes it appears to a person as though it overpowers him more greatly there. And in truth it is a mistake — either because at first he was in the aspect of: "a fool does not feel" — for the spirit of foolishness had so overpowered him that he did not feel at all the extent of the yetzer hara's overpowering of him.

 (And if a particular desire or character trait seems to him to have been easier to break in the Diaspora — and it did not overpower him as much in this matter — but who knows how he was regarding his other traits and matters? And it has already been explained about this elsewhere. And it is possible that due to the foolishness of his mind he did not consider this at all and did not take it to heart — and who knows what would have happened to him had he not merited to come to Eretz Yisrael? And in particular — regarding the overpowering of the evil inclination — one day is in no way similar to another, as our Sages of blessed memory said: "a person's evil inclination overpowers and renews itself against him every day," etc. — and who can know what would have happened to him on this very day if he were dwelling in the Diaspora?)

 But now — because Avira d'Eretz Yisrael machkim — he feels and perceives more. And therefore it seems to him that the yetzer hara overpowers him more greatly here. And sometimes it is in the aspect of: "whoever is greater than his fellow — his evil inclination is greater," as stated above. Therefore in truth now he needs a new and greater overpowering of himself. And the primary overpowering is in the matter of sweetening the judgments and anger — meaning: that through this he should not have, G-d forbid, the aspect of a troubled heart — as is found with some who are deficient in da'as — that when they see that they drew close to the Tzaddik or came to Eretz Yisrael with great obstacles — and yet even now the yetzer hara still overpowers them — through this they become most angry with themselves — until they harbor doubts about the Tzaddik and about the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — until they almost regret their earlier decisions, G-d forbid. And this is the hardest of all — and it is the aspect of: "lest the people regret when they see war — and return to Egypt" [Shmos 13:17], G-d forbid.

segments.he: בארץ ישראל שם עיקר עליית הנצוצות הק' ותיקון המחשבות זרות ושלימות התפלה כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וצריכים לבאר עוד איך כל המאמרים יש להם שייכות לענין א"י:
segments.en:
And therefore one must be very careful about this — to sweeten the anger within oneself — and to consider well in one's mind the nature of the yetzer hara that is now overpowering him. For there are several aspects of the yetzer hara, as is explained within the ma'amar. And in any case — if what overpowers him is the coarse and low yetzer hara — which is the literal spirit of foolishness and madness — coming purely from the darkening of the blood — then who owes him anything in this matter? He is so deficient in da'as that sometimes he almost provokes the yetzer hara himself through such filthy and coarse foolishness — until one who has even a minimal clear intellect has no need to overpower himself at all against such an evil inclination — only his deficiency of da'as and the darkening of his blood causes all this for him — and who owes him anything? But even such a person must be careful not to become too angry with himself — to the point of completely despairing, G-d forbid. Rather: let him break his heart and pour out his speech each time before the Holy One Blessed be He — and see to overpower his inclination as much as possible. And at the very least — not to come to an evil act, G-d forbid. And let him see to purify his blood by whatever means possible — through minimizing pleasures, etc. And let him greatly strengthen himself — and trust in the power of the Tzaddik and his merit — and similarly in the power and merit of the holy mitzvah of dwelling in Eretz Yisrael — which our Sages of blessed memory said is equivalent to all the mitzvos — and in the power of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael itself. And let him believe with all his heart that certainly everything will be rectified — G-d willing — and the descent will become the ultimate ascent, as is explained about this elsewhere.

 In particular — if he sees that on the contrary, the coarse yetzer hara is subdued before him in Eretz Yisrael more — and now only some yetzer hara from a different, more subtle and spiritual aspect overpowers him — then this is certainly only from the aspect of: "whoever is greater than his fellow," etc., as stated above. Then — even though one must flee greatly from such a yetzer hara as well — and if one does not overpower it, G-d forbid, then who knows what will unfold from this — for today it says to him: do this, etc. — even so, one must be careful not to have a troubled heart from this. For the root of the yetzer hara is from the aspect of anger and judgment. Rather — on the contrary — let him pour out his speech before Him, blessed be He, with mercy and supplication — and believe in the power of the sanctity of the Tzaddik and similarly in the power of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — that certainly the judgment will be sweetened with compassion — in the aspect of: "in anger — remember to have compassion" [Chavakuk 3:2].

 And this is what is written: "for Hashem will have compassion upon Yaakov," etc., "and will rest them upon their soil," etc., "and it shall come to pass on the day Hashem gives you rest from your suffering and from your anger," etc. [Yeshayahu 14:1–3]. For the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael is from the aspect of chesed and compassion — and the nullification of sadness and anger, as stated above.

segments.he: סימן צ"ז-אל דמי
segments.en:
And perhaps the sin of the spies also flowed from this — for they were at first great Tzaddikim, as is explained in the words of our Sages of blessed memory. Only when they came to Eretz Yisrael, a new yetzer hara — of a different and new kind — overpowered them — in the aspect of: "whoever is greater than his fellow," etc. — and they did not merit to sweeten it properly — until they fell greatly. And they also brought a bad report about Eretz Yisrael in this very matter: "however, the people that dwells in the land is powerful — and Amalek dwells in the Negev," etc., "we are unable to go up," etc., "for it is stronger than us" — as if — as our Sages of blessed memory said. That is: they said that there — the yetzer hara overpowers so greatly that it is impossible to overcome it — even with the help and assistance of the Holy One Blessed be He. And Yehoshua and Calev strengthened them — saying: we need not fear this at all — for Hashem is with us and will stand to help us, selah. And see the Zohar, Parshas Shelach — which also explains it in this way.

 And this is what is said in Parshas Vayeilech: "when I bring him to the land," etc., "and it shall come to pass when many evils and troubles find him — then this song will testify before him as a witness," etc., "for I know his inclination that he is practicing today — before I have brought him to the land," etc. [Devarim 31:21] — that is: He warned them in advance — that when they come to the Land and a new yetzer hara overpowers them in the aspect of: "whoever is greater than his fellow" — and the root of the yetzer hara is from anger and fierce judgment — and when they do not sweeten it properly — through this they will come to what they will come to — until the fierce anger truly arouses against them, G-d forbid — and many evils and troubles find them, etc. And at the time of the overpowering of the troubles and sufferings that flow from the aspect of fierce anger and judgments — then certainly the yetzer hara has the power to overpower even more, as is explained within the ma'amar. "But this song shall testify before him as a witness" — for when they take to heart that He already warned them and informed them of all this in advance — through this they will have the power to overpower their inclination — until it is sweetened and all is rectified.

 And this is: "for I know his inclination that he is practicing today," etc. For when they come there and the yetzer hara begins to overpower — sometimes a person forgets what passed over him before he came to Eretz Yisrael — and it appears to him as though there he had no such great yetzer hara — only here in Eretz Yisrael has it grown and overpowered him so greatly. And through this his heart fills with anger and frustration — and he harbors doubts about the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael, G-d forbid — until he comes to what he comes to through this. Therefore He warned them — and explained this to them as well — that He knows even the great yetzer hara that they have now — before their coming to Eretz Yisrael. For on the contrary — in the Diaspora the yetzer hara overpowers more — only even so, also there in Eretz Yisrael there is free choice for the person. And sometimes one stumbles, G-d forbid, through the coarse yetzer hara — which comes only from the darkening of the blood — that darkened greatly through the bodily desires. This is the aspect of: "and he ate and was satisfied and became fat — and turned to other gods" [Devarim 31:20] — the aspect of: "and Yeshurun grew fat and kicked" [Devarim 32:15] — and through this they stumble into actual foolishness — which everyone can recognize as great foolishness — and they are mute idols, etc., as is explained within the ma'amar. But even so — this yetzer hara also has a root above it — and so further still — until the root of all of them draws sustenance from the aspect of gevuros [stern powers] and judgments that are not sweetened — which is the aspect of the yetzer hara of the great ones — the aspect of: "whoever is greater than his fellow," etc. And from this it flows that sometimes it appears to a person that the yetzer hara overpowers him more greatly there. But when he takes to heart that this was already spoken of — then it is easy for him to overpower his inclination each and every time anew — until all is rectified, as stated above.

 
 Siman Ayin-Gimel · סימן ע"ג

segments.he: בארץ ישראל שם עיקר הענוה והיראה ושלימות התפלה ותיקון בחינת ה"הא" כי ארעא דישראל מותבא דאות הא כנ"ל. וע"כ משם עיקר השפע בחינת הא לכם זרע:
segments.en:
Ki Sa'avor — "When You Pass Through"

 כִּי תַעֲבוֹר · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 73

 The primary perfection of prayer is in Eretz Yisrael, as is known. And there is the primary tikkun of the vessel called ani [I / the self — the vessel of the soul that receives holiness]. For every one of the inhabitants of Eretz Yisrael is called Tzaddik, as is brought. And similarly there is the primary perfection of speech, as stated above many times. And Eretz Yisrael itself is the aspect of Malchus peh [the Kingship of the mouth]. And similarly there is the primary purification of thought — that it be bound to speech at the time of prayer. And there is the primary descent of abundance, as is explained in the holy Zohar. And this is what is written: "You desired, Hashem, Your land" [Tehillim 85:2]. For this is His primary will and desire, blessed be He. And there is the primary revelation of the inner dimension of the Torah — which is the hidden aspects of Torah, as is brought.

segments.he: סימן צ"ח-נתן עיניו בו
segments.en:
Siman Ayin-Daled · סימן ע"ד

 Rumah — "Rise Up"

 רוּמָה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 74

 Eretz Yisrael is one of three things given through suffering — and the sufferings are the aspect of yisurin shel ahavah [sufferings of love] — as it is written: "and you shall know with your heart — for as a man chastises his son," etc. [Devarim 8:5] — which is the aspect of: "Avraham begot Yitzchak" [Bereishis 25:19] — and therefore Yitzchak was the first one upon whom sufferings came — as it is said: "and it came to pass when Yitzchak grew old — and his eyes became too dim to see" [Bereishis 27:1] — as our Sages of blessed memory said [Bereishis Rabbah, chapter 65]. And therefore they — Avraham and Yitzchak — were the first ones to receive the promise of the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. And Yitzchak was born from Sarah — who is the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of dina d'malchusa — the aspect of tzedek — which is Yerushalayim — as it is written: "and Malkitzedek — king of Shalem" [Bereishis 14:18].

segments.he: בארץ ישראל כל היושבים בה הם בבחינת צדיקים כנ"ל כמה פעמים.ועיני ד' אל צדיקים כמבואר בפנים. ע"כ שם בנקל יותר להאדם לפקוח את עיניו ולהתבונן על דרכיו ולפשפש היטב במעשיו בבחינת נחפשה דרכינו ונחקורה ונשובה עד ד':
segments.en:
But all of this is still the aspect of mochin d'katnus [diminished consciousness] — and then it is the aspect of the thirsting of the soul, as is understood below in the ma'amar of Vayehi Achar, Siman 76. And this is the aspect of: "my soul thirsts for You," etc., and: "my soul is like a weary land to You, Selah" [Tehillim 143:6]. And it needs to be healed. And this is through the wisdom and the Torah of Eretz Yisrael — for: "there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael — and there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And there one merits to elevate the soul from katnus [smallness] to gadlus [greatness] — for there is the primary mochin d'gadlus, as is known.

 And therefore Eretz Yisrael is called the inheritance of Yaakov — for Yaakov is the aspect of speech with da'as [knowledge / consciousness] — which is the primary perfection. For the soul, speech, and Eretz Yisrael are all one aspect — the aspect of Malchus. And when they are in the aspect of katnus — they are in the aspect of tzedek. And when they come to the aspect of wisdom — which is the aspect of Yaakov — then they are in the aspect of tzedakah. And then is their primary perfection — for they rise to their root — which is the aspect of wisdom — as it is written: "Hashem — through wisdom He founded the earth." And therefore there in Eretz Yisrael is the primary perfection of the service of Hashem and the revelation of His glory, blessed be He — which is through the aspect of wisdom, as is explained within the ma'amar.

 And behold — it is explained here that speech without da'as is the aspect of aravah [willow — the species associated with lips and speech without taste] — and within it there is still the grip of the dross. This is the aspect of: "these are the generations of," etc., "Yaakov — and Esav." And the joy of Torah is the aspect of speech with da'as. And therefore at the time of the destruction it is written: "upon the willows within it we hung our harps" [Tehillim 137:2] — for there etc. — "and those who led us captive asked us for joy — how shall we sing the song of Hashem upon foreign soil?" For there the soul has no joy. And therefore of the future it is written: "the wilderness and the dry land shall be glad, and the Aravah shall rejoice," etc., "the glory of Lebanon is given to it," etc., "they shall see the glory of Hashem" [Yeshayahu 35:1–2]. For then the aspect of Aravah will be rectified — and joy will be drawn — and the glory of Hashem will be revealed. And it is written: "for Hashem has comforted Tzion," etc., "and He has made her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of Hashem — joy and gladness shall be found in her," etc. [Yeshayahu 51:3] — "give ear to Me, My people," etc. — "for Torah shall go forth from Me," etc. — the aspect of the aforementioned wisdom of Torah.

segments.he: סימן צ"ט-ואתחנן
segments.en:
Siman Ayin-Hay · סימן ע"ה

 Yivarechenu — "He Will Bless Us"

 יְבָרְכֵנוּ · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 75

 The primary speech of Creation was solely for the sake of Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "G-d, the Elokim, Hashem, spoke — and called to the earth," etc., "from Tzion — the perfection of beauty — G-d shines forth" [Tehillim 50:1–2]. Therefore the primary tikkun of the broken letters is also through the Torah and prayer of Eretz Yisrael. For there is the primary perfection of Torah and prayer, as stated above. And the tikkun of the broken letters is the aspect of shalom. And this is: "and I will place peace in the land" — in its literal sense. And similarly: "and to say to Tzion: you are My people" — as is explained within the ma'amar — also in its literal sense — specifically Tzion. And similarly: "and His feet shall stand on that day upon the Mount of Olives" [Zechariyah 14:4] — in its literal sense — on this very Mount of Olives in Yerushalayim, opposite the Temple Mount to its east.

segments.he: ועל כן אמרו רז"ל המתפלל צריך שיכוון לבו נגד א"י וירושלים וכו'. כי שם מסוגל ביותר לזכות לתפלה הגונה בדביקות אמתי כי שם עיקר מקום הדביקות ושלמות התפלה כנ"ל.וע"י שמכוון לבו לזם זוכה בחו"ל גם כן לאיזה דביקות. ועי"ז יש לתפלות שלנו שייכות והתחברות להתפלות שבא"י ובעלייתן למעלה עולי גם הם עמהם. וזה שמסיימין אחר התפלה יה"ר שיבנה בית המקדש ב"ב וכו'. כי שם תהי' עבודת התפלה בשליות גדול ועי"ז יתעלו ויושלמו גם התפלות של עכשיו עי"ז בעצמו שגם עכשו מתפללין ומצפין לבנין בית המקדש. ואפשר שזה ג"כ בכלל ואתחנן אל ד' וכו'. כי חשש מרע"ה אולי לא תתקבל תפלתו מחמת שהוא בחו"ל עדיין. ע"כ התפלל בטענה ובחי' זו הלא אני רוצה ומתפלל ליכנס לא"י ששם שלימות התפלה בדביקות גדול כראוי. וא"כ גם התפלה שאני מתפלל עכשיו תתקבל ע"י כח קדושת א"י שאני מקשר א"ע לשם וכל תפלתי לזכות לבוא לשם כנ"ל. וזה שאמרו רז"ל ואתחנן אל ד' למה כדי שיכנס לא"י היינו הנ"ל:
segments.en:
There is the primary awe, as stated above many times. And the primary blessing — for: "there Hashem commanded the blessing." And therefore the primary ingathering of the dispersed ones — who are the aspect of the sparks that were scattered — will all be there — as it is written: "even if your dispersed ones be at the end of heaven," etc., "and Hashem your G-d will bring you to the land," etc. [Devarim 30:4–5].

 
 Siman Ayin-Vav · סימן ע"ו

 Vayehi Achar — "And It Was Afterwards"

 וַיְהִי אַחַר · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 76

segments.he: סימן ק'-ענין כעס
segments.en:
In Eretz Yisrael it is written: "always — the eyes of Hashem your G-d are upon it," etc. [Devarim 11:12]. And in the act of gazing there is direct light and returning light — and from this one understands the great excellence of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — that the Holy One Blessed be He gazes upon it always with direct light — and it reflects back and is portrayed in His eyes, blessed be He, as it were — in the aspect of returning light. In particular regarding the place of the Bais HaMikdash — as it is written: "My eyes and My heart shall be there," etc. [Melachim I 9:3].

 And there one must most greatly strengthen oneself with complete and true trust — and lift one's eyes only to the Holy One Blessed be He alone at all times — for everything that one needs. For since the Holy One Blessed be He gazes upon it at all times — to know what it needs — then how can a person avert his attention even for a moment from his trust in the Holy One Blessed be He — and think thoughts to fill his needs through some cause or effort with human beings, etc.? And this is what He took great offense at — as it is written: "cursed is the man who trusts in human beings and makes flesh his strength — and whose heart turns away from Hashem," etc., "blessed is the man who trusts in Hashem — and Hashem is his security", etc. [Yirmiyahu 17:5, 7].

 And also — because the abundance of the entire world first descends to Eretz Yisrael — and one must make for it a vessel and a time — that the abundance descend and come at the time and moment when it is needed. Therefore one must at all times strengthen oneself with great trust — and look toward Him, blessed be He — for through this one makes a vessel and a limit and a time for the abundance to come in its season and at its appointed time. And this is the aspect of: "and I will give your rains in their season" [Vayikra 26:4], and: "to give the rain of your land in its season" [Devarim 11:14] — said of Eretz Yisrael when Israel merits it. And this is the aspect of what they ask a person: "did you hope for the salvation?" [one of the six questions asked in the World to Come — Shabbos 31a] For through this one draws closer the time of salvation — that it come in its season. And this is: "and your people are all righteous — forever shall they inherit the land," etc., "the smallest shall become a thousand," etc. — "I am Hashem — in its time I will hasten it" [Yeshayahu 60:21–22]. For the primary thing depends upon the making of the vessel — and the Holy One Blessed be He is able to make such a vessel that through it He hastens the time and moment of the redemption and salvation. And this is: "and the faithfulness of your times shall be the strength of your salvations," etc. [Yeshayahu 33:6] — and Rashi explained: that you faithfully trusted in Me and hoped for My salvation at the times that passed over you — this shall be for you a source of strength for salvations, etc.

segments.he: ועל כן התלמידי חכמים שבא"י מזגם וטבעם להיות צנועים וטובים מאד כמאמר רז"ל מה בין תקיפי דא"י לחסידי דבבל. כמה מחבבין זה את זה. וכ"ז ע"י שיש להם מעשים טובים הרבה ע"י כמה מצות הנוהגות רק בא"י. וגם ישיבת א"י בעצמה אמרו רז"ל ששקול ככל מצות נמצא שמקיימין בכל עת כל המצות עי ישיבת א"י. אמרו רז"ל לאוהבי ולשומרי מצותי אלו היושבים בא"י וכו'. ומחמת כ"ז הגם שהם בני תורה הרבה כי אין תורה כתורת א"י. מ"מ תורתם וצדקתם שניהם מתיישבים בשובה ונחת. וע"כ דעתם נוחה עם הבריות:
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of: "and those who hope for Hashem — they shall inherit the land." And similarly it is written: "and one who trusts in Him shall inherit the land." For as it were — as waters reflect face to face. And through gazing there truly only toward the Holy One Blessed be He alone — with strong and complete trust — through this one draws even more the aspect of the illumination of: "the eyes of Hashem your G-d are upon it always" — which is the primary sanctity of Eretz Yisrael. And therefore the primary perfection of the service of Hashem is only there in Eretz Yisrael. For in the Diaspora the service is mostly in the aspect of katnus and in the aspect of the thirsting of the soul. And this is the aspect of: "my soul thirsts for You," etc., "in a dry and weary land without water," etc. — "so in the sanctuary I have beheld You — to see Your strength and Your glory."

 For there in Eretz Yisrael the service is in the aspect of sight and gazing — and in the aspect of the renewal of the mochin each time — in the aspect of mochin d'gadlus. And even the aspect of the departure of the mochin in the aspect of sleep — which is there — when the sight is only in the aspect of vision — the aspect of a dream, as is known — this too is for the good — for the renewal of the mochin afterwards in the aspect of: "new every morning," etc. [Eichah 3:23] — this being the aspect of: "so in the sanctuary I have beheld You — to see Your strength and Your glory." And this itself is also in the aspect of: "at times the nullification of Torah is its fulfillment," as is explained within the ma'amar. And there one merits teshuvah me'ahavah [repentance from love], as stated above in Siman 58 — through which one merits the purification of the mochin — the aspect of: "from the right side — a white brain like silver." Which is itself the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of yemin [right] — the aspect of love — the aspect of Avraham. And therefore Avraham our father was the first to inherit Eretz Yisrael.

 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said: "man and man were born in her — one who was born in her and one who looks forward to seeing her." For through looking forward to seeing her — which is the aspect of gazing at the light of her holiness — through this he makes a vessel to draw also to his own place some sparkling from the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — until he is considered as though he were born in her. And this is what Moshe prayed: "that I may see the land" [Devarim 3:25]. And regarding Daniyel it is said: "and his windows were open," etc. [Daniyel 6:11]. And this is what our Sages said: "one should direct his heart toward Eretz Yisrael." For "the sinew of the eye depends upon the heart" — and when one directs and binds his heart well toward there — it is truly the aspect of sight and gazing — the aspect of: "and my heart saw," etc. [Koheles 1:16] — and through this his prayer is rectified.

 Note: This siman continues with a second section bearing the heading: Vayihad Hashem l'Melech — "And Hashem shall be King":

segments.he: סימן ק"א-בקרוב
segments.en:
The primary perfection of the revelation of His Kingship, blessed be He, is in Tzion and Yerushalayim — as is explained in many verses. And therefore the primary perfection of Torah and prayer — through which His Kingship, blessed be He, is revealed — is also only there in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "for from Tzion shall go forth Torah — and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim." And there the Name הוי"ה is completed through Torah and prayer. For the breath and voice that goes out in the Diaspora is immediately coarsened by the impure air — and needs clarification and purification. But there — the air is holy — and therefore there the breath and voice of holiness are the aspect of the vav and heh of the Name. And similarly there is the primary perfection of love and awe — which are the aspect of the letters yud and heh of the Name — this being the aspect of: yud-heh — specifically in the land of the living, as is brought. And therefore there the Name of Hashem is completed through Torah and prayer. And this is what is written: "to tell of the Name of Hashem in Tzion and His praise in Yerushalayim." And others like these. And this is the aspect of: "in every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned," etc. And: "to place His Name there — to cause His Name to dwell there."

 
 Siman Ayin-Ches · סימן ע"ח

 Vayiten Oz L'Malko — "And He Gives Strength to His King"

segments.he: עיקר המוחין שהם בחינת י"ה הם בא"י בחינתי"ה בארץ החיים ואמרו בתיקונים אוירא דא"י מחכים מהסטרא דחכמה דראיהו אות יו"ד. וכן אמרו ארעא דישראל מותבא דאת ה"א. ושם עיקר התורה כי אין תורה כתורת א"י. ושם מאירין כל הע' פנים לתורה כמו שכתוב כי יפלא ממך דבר וכו' וקמת ועלית וכו'. ושם שורש כל המדות טובות כמו שכתוב טובה הארץ מאד מאד על דרך שאמרו ז"ל כל מאדך בכל מדה ומדה. וכן שם עיקר הכנעת כל המדות רעות בחינת ארץ אוכלת יושביה שמהפך את האדם מרע לטוב גמור וכו'. וכמבואר במקום אחר. וכתיב ובערת הרע מקרבך. ושם נקראים אדם בחינת והארץ נתן לבני אדם וכנ"ל בסי' ו'. וכתיב אנכי עשיתי ארץ ואדם עליה בראתי. וזה שכתוב להדוף את כל אויביך מפניך וכן ויגרש מפניך אויב וכיוצא בזה הרבה מפניך דייקא. כי האויבים שאחיזתם בבחינת האנפין חשוכין נופלין ונתבטלין בבחי' צרי ואויבי לי המה כשלו ונפלו ע"י שישראל מבטלין כל המדות רעות. וזוכין להשיג בתורה בחינת אנפין נהורין שהם בחינת י"ה שעל שם זה נקראים אדם כמבואר בפנים:
segments.en:
וַיִּתֵּן עוֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 78

 It has already been explained many times that Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of speech — the aspect of Malchus peh — the aspect of Shechinah. And when the Holy One Blessed be He dwells in it — as it were — the aspect of: "and Hashem dwells in Tzion" [Yoel 4:21] — that is the aspect of the union of the Holy One Blessed be He with the Shechinah. And there is the primary revelation of His Kingship, blessed be He, as stated above. And therefore it is called Eretz HaChayyim — for from there every person draws the vital life-force of holiness. And there is the primary aspect of Ruach HaKodesh [holy spirit / inspiration], as is explained in the holy Zohar.

 And therefore there is the primary perfection of Torah and prayer — for when one speaks there words of Torah and prayer — and breathes in and breathes out — one receives each time a new life-force and new breath from the holy air of Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of Shechinah — the aspect of Ruach HaKodesh. And therefore one's words — together with all one's breaths — are in the aspect of actual Ruach HaKodesh — as it is written: "who gives a soul to the people upon it — and spirit to those who walk in it" [Yeshayahu 42:5] — which is the aspect of resurrection of the dead, as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore one must be especially careful there to guard the holy speech. But to our great sorrow — now in the time of exile it is in the aspect of mute — as it is written: "and like a sheep before its shearers — mute — and it does not open its mouth", etc. [Yeshayahu 53:7]. Therefore one must be especially careful there in vidduy devarim [verbal confession] — to confess everything each time before the Holy One Blessed be He — and to tell before Him, blessed be He, everything that is on one's heart — in the aspect of: "take with you words — and return to Hashem" [Hoshea 14:3], as is explained within the ma'amar.

 
 Siman Ayin-Tes · סימן ע"ט

segments.he: עיקר שלימות הדעת והמוחין הוא בא"י ושם עיקר שלימות התורה ושלימות התשובה. ועי"ז נמשך רחמנות עד שנתעורר עי"ז בחינת תפלת ד' שהוא ג"כ בא"י בבחינת ושמחתים בבית תפלתי שנאמר על הבית המקדש. ומשם למדו רז"ל שהקב"ה מתפלל. עד שזוכין עי"ז לרחמים גדולים כמבואר בפנים.וזה בחי' מה שהתפלל דניאל ואמר כי לא על צדקותינו וכו' כי על רחמיך הרבים. היינו בחינת רחמים גדולים הנ"ל. וזה בחי' (ישעי' י"ד) כי ירחם ד' את יעקב וכו' והניחם על אדמתם וכו' (שם ל') לכן יחכה ד' לחננכם ולכן ירום לרחמכם וכו' כי עם בציון ישב בירושלים וכו'. כי עיקר החורבן לגלות ישראל מא"י הי' מחמת שנתעלם הרחמנות ולא היו יכולים לעורר רחמים כמו שכתוב (שם ס"ג) המון מעיך ורחמיך אלי התאפקו. וכתיב (הושע א') כי לא אוסיף עוד ארחם וכו'. וכן (שם ב') וסיים ורחמתי את לא רוחמה. כי ע"י תשובה זוכים לחזור ולעורר רחמים בחינת וישוב אל ד' וירחמהו. וזה שכתוב (זכרי' א') שבתי לירושלים ברחמים ביתי יבנה בה וכו'. כי עיקר התיקון ע"י בחינת רחמים בחינת וברחמים גדולים אקבצך. וזה בחינת ע"כ המו מעי לו רחם ארחמנו וכו'. היינו שני מיני רחמנות הנ"ל כי הרחמים פשוטים מעוררים הרחמנים גדולים:
segments.en:
Betach BaHashem — "Trust in Hashem"

 בְּטַח בַּה' · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 79

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of Shabbos, as is known — and the aspect of teshuvah [repentance] — as it is written: "You desired, Hashem, Your land — You restored the captivity of Yaakov" [Tehillim 85:2]. And it is written: "He says to Yerushalayim — you shall be inhabited" [Yeshayahu 44:26], etc. — and many like these. And it is written: "and a redeemer shall come to Tzion — and to those who return from transgression," etc. [Yeshayahu 59:20]. For the teshuvah of the Diaspora is in the aspect of the six weekdays — for there is still no rest — in the aspect of: "for you have not yet come to the resting-place," etc. [Devarim 12:9]. But Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of menuchah [rest / tranquility] — as it is written: "and he saw the resting-place — for it was good" [Bereishis 49:15], etc. And it is written: "they shall not enter My resting-place." And it is written: "and you shall cross the Jordan — and He will give you rest from all your enemies around — and you shall dwell securely" [Devarim 12:10] — the aspect of complete menuchah.

 And the primary menuchah was in the days of Shlomo — who is the aspect of Shabbos — the king whose peace was his own [Shloymoh — from shalom] — for there was peace in his days, as is known. And he merited to build the Bais HaMikdash — regarding which it is said: "arise, Hashem, to Your resting-place," etc. [Tehillim 132:8]. And it is written: "this is My resting-place forever," etc. And this is the aspect of complete teshuvah — the aspect of Shaddai — the aspect of: "if you return to Shaddai — you will be built up," etc. [Iyov 22:23]. And this is the aspect of: "then shall you delight in Shaddai" [Iyov 22:26] — the aspect of the delight of Shabbos. And through this one merits lowliness — the aspect of: "let each man remain in his place". And this is: "and the humble shall inherit the land — and they shall delight," etc.

segments.he: סימן ק"ט-יש הבל
segments.en:
And this is what is written: "and I will appoint a place for My people Israel — and I will plant them — and they shall dwell beneath it" [Shmuel II 7:10] — the aspect of: "let each man remain in his place" stated above — "and they shall be disturbed no more" — and its Targum: "and they shall be displaced no more" — meaning, they shall not be dragged from their place again, as the commentators explained. This is the aspect of: "let each man remain in his place — let no man go out from his place" [Shmos 16:29] — for they cannot be pushed from their place through this, as is explained within the ma'amar. And also in its literal sense: that they shall have peaceful, quiet, and tranquil rest — which is the aspect of complete teshuvah, as stated above. And this is: "trust in Hashem and do good" — the aspect of complete teshuvah, as is explained within the ma'amar — "dwell in the land" — in its literal sense. For there it is said: "and you shall dwell securely," as stated above. And also: "dwell in the land" alludes to lowliness — in the manner of what our Sages of blessed memory said: one who made himself a neighbor of the dust, etc. And this is: "and tend to faithfulness" — for all of this is the aspect of Moshe Ra'ya Mehaimna [Aramaic: the Faithful Shepherd], as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore Moshe asked to bring Israel into Eretz Yisrael — and then they would have been fixed there forever, as is brought. And the Holy One Blessed be He answered him: "it is too much for you," etc. — for Moshe himself is the aspect of the land of Shaddai as it were — and they would not be able to bear so great a light permanently. Only Yehoshua should bring them in — who is the aspect of na'ar [youth] — Matatron [the great angelic minister] — as is explained in the holy Zohar. And when the holiness of Shabbos is drawn — which is the aspect of Shaddai, as is explained within the ma'amar — and this is what the angel said to Yehoshua: "I am the minister of the host of Hashem — now I have come" [Yehoshua 5:14]. And there is more to explain — for also within the ma'amar it is written only in allusion.

 
 Siman Peh · סימן פ'

 Hashem Oz L'Amo Yiten — "Hashem Will Give Strength to His People"

segments.he: בארץ ישראל שם עיקר ההבל דקדושה כמבואר בספר מגלה עמוקות אופן רי"ג. וכמבואר לעיל בסי' ל"ז. שכבל של א"י הוא הבל הקדוש שאין בו חטא. וע"כ שם עיקר שלימות האנחה דקדושה. כי כשמתאנח על עונותיו אזי נכנס בו הבל חדש דקדושה שהוא ג"כ העיקר בא"י. כמו שכתוב לך אתן את ארץ כנען חבל נחלתכם ונאמר חבלים נפלו לי בנעימים הינו מבחינת מוחין של א"י שנקראים נועם כמו שאמרו ז"ל. וזה שכתוב (ישעי' ל"ג) חזה ציון קרית מועדנו עיניך תראנה ירושלים נוה שאנן וכו' וכל חבליו בל ינתקו וכו'. ועל העכו"ם נאמר שם נעשו חבליך בל יחזקו וכו' וסיים ובל יאמר שכן חליתי העם היושב בה נשוא עון. כי ע"י שמקושרין שם אל החבל דקדושה היפוך החבל דסט"א שנאמר עליו ובחבלי חטאתו יתמך ונאמר הוי מושכי העון בחבלי השוא וכו' והם בחינת חבלי שאול ומות. אבל א"י היא ארץ החיים ושם מקושרין אל החבל דקדושה שעי"ז זוכין לנשוא עון:
segments.en:
ה' עוֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 80

 The primary blessing and shalom is in Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "for there Hashem commanded the blessing" [Tehillim 133:3]. And it is written: "who makes your borders peace." And shalom is the aspect of the joining together of two opposites — namely Chesed [lovingkindness] and Gevurah [strength] — which are the aspects of love and awe that one merits in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above. And similarly regarding the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael it is said: "because He loved your fathers and chose their offspring after them" — which is the aspect of Chesed — "to dispossess nations greater than you", etc. — which is the aspect of Gevurah and judgment that He performed against the non-Jews and drove them from there. And many more such verses.

 And the Patriarchs merited the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael through their sanctification of the Name of Heaven. As it is written regarding Avraham: "I am Hashem who brought you out from Ur Kasdim" — where he sanctified the Name of Heaven, as is known — "to give you this land," etc. [Bereishis 15:7]. And similarly regarding the Akeidah of Yitzchak it is said: "and your offspring shall inherit the gate of their enemies" [Bereishis 22:17]. And because we do not find explicitly stated regarding Yaakov that he gave his life for the sanctification of the Name — therefore the prophet said: "thus says Hashem regarding the house of Yaakov — who redeemed Avraham" — and as our Sages of blessed memory expounded: the merit of Yaakov stood for Avraham in Ur Kasdim — "Yaakov shall not now be ashamed", etc. — Rashi explained: because of his father and his father's father — "when he sees his children," etc., "they shall sanctify My Name" — Rashi explained: these are Chananiyah, Mishael, and Azariyah — "and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov," etc. [Yeshayahu 29:22–23].

 And this is what is said also of the future: "and I will sanctify My great Name," etc., "and I will gather you from all the lands and bring you to your soil" [Yechezkel 36:23–24]. And there [ibid. 39:25]: "now I will restore the captivity of Yaakov," etc., "and I will be zealous for My holy Name," etc., "and I will gather them into their enemies' lands — and I will be sanctified through them before the eyes of many nations," etc., "and I will gather them to their soil," etc. It follows that the ingathering of the exiles to Eretz Yisrael is through the aspect of the sanctification of the Name. And this is what is written: "I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers" [Shir HaShirim 8:10] — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded this regarding Avraham and Chananiyah, Mishael, and Azariyah — who gave their lives for the sanctification of the Name. And this is what it concludes: "then I was in His eyes like one who finds peace." For this is the aspect of shalom, as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: סימן קי"ז-מוצאי שבת
segments.en:
And this is what is written: "and Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings — in the land of Kena'an — these are the generations of Yaakov — Yosef" [Bereishis 37:1–2] — for he was the primary offspring — for he is the aspect of the second vav as is explained within the ma'amar — which is the aspect of shalom — the aspect of the sanctification of the Name — which is suited for the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above. And therefore now in the time of exile — when we have been distanced from our soil — for the most part it is impossible to come to Eretz Yisrael except through mesiras nefesh [self-sacrifice] — as many great ones have told of what passed over them — as is well known. And this is the aspect of: "to the holy ones who are in the land" [Tehillim 16:3]. And it is written: "and what remains in Yerushalayim shall be called holy."

 In truth — the long journey with travel expenses and the ordeals and the like that pass over every person who travels there — this is also the aspect of mesiras nefesh, as is explained elsewhere. And there in Eretz Yisrael one merits to receive all the influences and blessings through the vessel of shalom — and one merits to speak holy words before the Holy One Blessed be He — of Torah and prayer — with wisdom and clear intellect. For there is the primary wisdom and intellect — and similarly the primary perfection of Torah and prayer, as stated above many times.

 
 Siman Peh-Alef · סימן פ"א

segments.he: היושבים בא"י הם נקראים בנים למקום כמובא. ועי' מגלה עמוקות אופן רכ"ד. כי שם עיקר האמת כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וע"כ נקראת ארץ מרחקים כי אמת מרחקין מיליה. וזה שמובא ויר'א א'ת המקו'ם ס"ת "אמת" וזה מרחוק היינו כנ"ל. וע"כ כשזוכין שם לבחינת אמת נקראים בנים כמבואר בפנים. וגם שם עיקר שלימות הדעת כנ"ל.וע"כ נכון שם למעט בשינה. ודוד המע"ה כשרצה למצוא את מקום הבית המקדש שמשם שורש קדושת א"י אמר אם אתן שנת לעיני לעפעפי תומה עד אמצא מקום לד'. ויעקב אע"ה אמר אכן יש ד' במקום הזה ואנכי לא ידעתי ופירש"י שאם ידעתי לא ישנתי היינו כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Alu Zeh BaNegev — "Go Up There in the Negev"

 עֲלוּ זֶה בַּנֶּגֶב · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 81

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the holy speech of Torah and prayer — and therefore there is the primary perfection of Torah and prayer, as stated above. But even the casual conversation of the people of Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of the residue of Eretz Yisrael — is also very precious. As our Sages of blessed memory said [Midrash Rabbah, Vayikra, chapter 34]: "the casual conversation of the people of Eretz Yisrael is Torah." And therefore one must be especially careful there to guard the speech — that it should be holy — and even in casual conversation one should clothe within it some words of Torah, as is explained within the ma'amar regarding the Tzaddik. For it has already been explained that all who dwell in Eretz Yisrael are in the aspect of Tzaddik, as is brought.

 
 Siman Peh-Bais · סימן פ"ב

segments.he: סימן קכ"ט-ארץ אוכלת יושביה
segments.en:
HaNe'elavim — "Those Who Are Insulted"

 הַנֶּעֱלָבִים · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 82

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of Shabbos and the aspect of bris [covenant], as stated above many times. And therefore Israel did not enter Eretz Yisrael until they had milah [circumcision] and peri'ah [the uncovering of the corona — the second stage of circumcision] — this being the aspect of: "today I have rolled away the disgrace," etc. [Yehoshua 5:9]. For it is impossible to enter Eretz Yisrael and be fixed in its holiness — until one first subdues the aspect of the three impure klippos — which are the aspect of orlah — the aspect of disgrace. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is one of three things that come through suffering. For the sufferings too are the aspect of disgrace — the aspect of: "disgrace has broken my heart" [Tehillim 69:21] — as is brought in the ma'amar of Chosum b'soch Chosum, Siman 22: in all the sufferings of this world there is within them the pain of shame.

 And when one merits to accept the sufferings with love — which is the aspect of those who are insulted and do not insult, etc. — and who rejoice in their sufferings and act out of love — then the illumination of the aspect of chashmal and nogah [a luminous substance and a glow — mystical terms] is included within holiness — and a flame of fire descends [from the aspect of this light of love — the aspect of: "for love is as strong as death," etc., "its flames are flames of fire — a flame of G-d" — which is the mystery of the shalheiva d'asha [the flame of fire] as is brought in the writings of the Ari, of blessed memory] — and then the three impure klippos are pushed aside and completely subdued — which is the aspect of milah. And then one can merit the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.

segments.he: מבואר בפנים שא"י היא בחינת אמונה ויש לה כח להפך את האדם היושב בה למהות קדושתה מש. וע"כ העם היושב בה נשוא עון. אך אעפ"כ הכל תלוי ברצון כי ח"ו אם אינו רוצה כלל לעבוד את ד' אזי לא יועיל לו שום דבר. כי אז אדרבא קדושת א"י אינה יכולה לסובלו ומקויאה אותו בבחינת כאשר קאה את הגוי וכו'. אך אם רוצונו חזק מאד להקרב להשי"ת ולעבוד אותו אזי מועיל לו לזה קדושת א"י מאד כנ"ל. עד שזוכה עי"ז לשבר כל תאות גופו ולהתפך למהותה הקדוש ממש כנ"ל:
segments.en:
And this is what is written: "You know my disgrace and my shame," etc. [Tehillim 69:20], "disgrace has broken my heart," etc. — and it concludes: "for G-d will save Tzion — and build the cities of Yehudah — and they shall settle there and inherit it," etc., "and those who love His Name shall dwell in it." And similarly our Sages of blessed memory said: "for those who love Me and observe My commandments — these are those who dwell in Eretz Yisrael and give their lives for all the mitzvos," etc. — as is brought in Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 288 — and see there also in Simanim 23 and 24.

 And this is what is brought in the kavanah [mystical intention] to say when washing in hot water on Erev Shabbos — which is the mystery of the shalheiva d'asha — the verse: "and those who remain in Tzion — and those who are left in Yerushalayim," etc. [Yeshayahu 4:3], and: "when Hashem has washed away the filth of the daughters of Tzion," etc. [Yeshayahu 4:4] — for all of this is also connected to the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael, as stated above.

 And perhaps one may say that this is the mystery of what is explained in Yehoshua: "and it came to pass when they heard," etc., "that the Giv'onim had made peace with Israel and were among them," etc., "and five kings of the Emori gathered against them and encamped against Giv'on," etc., "and Yehoshua went up," etc., "and He struck them with a great blow at Giv'on", etc. [Yehoshua 10:1–10]. And: "and Hashem cast upon them great stones from heaven" — and our Sages of blessed memory said that these were the hailstones from Egypt in the days of Moshe — and there it is said: "and fire flaming within the hail," etc. — this is the aspect of the shalheiva d'asha that descends from heaven to subdue the klippos. Then: "Yehoshua spoke," etc., "and he said before the eyes of Israel: sun, stand still at Giv'on," etc. — "and the sun stood still," etc., "until the nation avenged itself of its enemies," etc. [Yehoshua 10:12–13]. For this is the aspect of: "and those who love Him — as the sun going forth in its strength" [Shoftim 5:31], as is explained within the ma'amar. And it seems even more fitting — according to what our Sages of blessed memory said in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer — that this battle was on Erev Shabbos — for that is the time when the shalheiva d'asha stated above descends. And then Yehoshua said: "sun, stand still at Giv'on," as stated above.

segments.he: סימן קל"ה-כי אקח מועד
segments.en:
Siman Peh-Gimel · סימן פ"ג

 Matan B'Seter — "A Gift in Secret"

 מַתָּן בְּסֵתֶר · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 83

 It is known that Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the tikkun ha-bris. And therefore when they blemished the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael through the spies — it is written in Parshas Matos: "and the anger of Hashem was kindled on that day — when they came," etc. [Bamidbar 32:10, 13]. And there: "and the anger of Hashem was kindled against Israel," etc. And similarly in Parshas Nitzavim it is written: "and Hashem uprooted them from their soil — in anger," etc. [Devarim 29:27]. And in Parshas Ha'azinu: "for a fire has been kindled in My anger," etc. [Devarim 32:22] — the aspects of fire and anger mentioned above. And there: "I said I will scatter them," etc. [Devarim 32:26]. And this is what is said at the time of the destruction: "your cities are burned with fire" [Yeshayahu 1:7]. And similarly: "from above He has sent fire", etc. [Eichah 1:13] — and many like these.

segments.he: ירושלים של מטה מכון כנגד ירושלים של מעלה שהיא בחינת בינה אימא עילאה. וע"כ שם בא"י זוכים לענוה בחי' וענוים יירשו ארץ וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם שם עיקר שורש קדושת יום טוב שהוא רק ע"פ בית דין הגדול שבא"י בחינת אשר תקראו אתם. כי שם עיקר קדושת א"י תלוי בצדיקים כמו שכתוב צדיקים יירשו ארץ וכמובן גם בזוהר הק'. וע"כ כל מה שמקושר האדם ביותר לצדיקי האמת זוכה להרגיש ביותר קדושת א"י. וכן ע"י קדושת א"י זוכים לקבל ביותר האר הצדיקי אמת. וע"י כ"ז הקטנות בטל לגבי הגדלות וזוכין לענוה אמתיית. גם שם עיקר התשובה ועיקר היראה והכנעת מלכות עמלק ועליית המלכות דקדושה וכו' כנ"ל כמ"פ:
segments.en:
And therefore regarding the time of consolation it is written: "I will thank You, Hashem — for You were angry with me — Your anger turned away and You consoled me" [Yeshayahu 12:1] — meaning: He turns His anger away — and makes from the letters of אַף [af — anger] the letters פֶּה [peh — mouth]. And this too is written: "even fire will consume them" [Yeshayahu 26:11] — for then His anger and fire will turn against the oppressors of Israel. And because the primary tikkun of this is made through tzedakah — therefore our Sages of blessed memory said: "Yerushalayim is redeemed only through tzedakah" [Shabbos 139a]. And this is what is written: "who can live with the devouring fire?", etc. [Yeshayahu 33:14] — "one who walks in righteousness," etc. [Yeshayahu 33:15].

 And this is what is said: "and they devoured Israel with every mouth [b'chol peh]" [Yeshayahu 9:11] — meaning: they sucked from all the aforementioned pahs — "in all this His anger has not turned away," etc. — the aspect of the aforementioned anger — "for wickedness burned like fire" — the aspect of the aforementioned fire — "and the people became as fuel for fire," etc. — "in all this His anger has not turned away," etc. And this is what is also said in the Kinot [Lamentations]: "they opened their mouths against you," etc. And similarly: "they opened their mouths against us," etc. But in the future it is written: "kings shall shut their mouths at him", etc. [Yeshayahu 52:15]. And similarly: "they place hand upon mouth", etc. [Michah 7:16].

 
 Siman Peh-Daled · סימן פ"ד

segments.he: סימן קמ"ב-מי שאי אפשר לו ללמוד
segments.en:
BaMah He'erachtah Yamim — "Through What Did You Lengthen Days?"

 בַּמָּה הֶאֱרַכְתָּ יָמִים · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 84

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of yemin [right] — the aspect of love, as stated above. And: "from the right side — death is white like silver." [Aramaic: u'mista d'iminah mosa chavra k'kasfa — a Zoharic formulation indicating that the right side transforms death into purity]. Therefore there is the primary perfection of the merit of thought and mochin [expanded consciousness] — and through this one merits to attain each day the mysteries of the Torah relevant to that day. And this is the primary aspect of arichas yamim [length of days], as is explained within the ma'amar. And the primary arichas yamim is in Eretz Yisrael — as is explicitly stated in many verses. And therefore Avraham — whose attribute was love — was the first to inherit Eretz Yisrael. And it is said of him: "old — he had come in days" [Bereishis 24:1]. And therefore in Eretz Yisrael one must be especially careful regarding the trait of generosity — which is the trait of Avraham.

 
 Siman Peh-Hay · סימן פ"ה

segments.he: מובא לעיל בסי' כ' מאמר ט' תיקונין שהלב העליון נקרא ירושלים בחינת דברו על לב ירושלים ושם נכתבין כל דברי התורה בחינת כתבם על לוח לבך. וזה בחינת כי מציון תצא תורה ודבר ד' מירושלים.ומבואר בפנים שהחשק שיש להאדם ללימוד או לדבר מצוה הוא מקבל חשקו מהלב של מעלה והוא כלומד מתוך הספר ממש. וזה שאמרו רז"ל. אחד הנולד בה ואחד המצפה לראותה כי זה החשק שיש לו ומצפה לראותה הוא מקבל ממנה בעצמה. וע"כ נקרא גם הוא על שמה כאילו נולד בה. וזהו שאמרו שם וחד מנייהו כתרי מינן. כי מאחר שמי שאינו שם רק שחושק להיות שם הוא מקבל ולומד משם מכל שכן מי שזכה להיות שם ממש בדאי שמקבל הארה גדולה ביותר וזה וחד מינן כי סליק להתם הוא כתרי מנייהו. כי מאחר שהי' בוער בלבו החשק כ"כ עד שכה לעבור על כל האונסים והמניעות ולבא לשם ע"כ בודאי יש לו עי"ז שייכות ביותר להלב העלון עד שמקבל משם הארה יתירה ביותר עד שהוא כתרי מנייהו. וע"כ אמר השי"ת לאברהם אבינו ע"ה לך לך וגו' אל הארץ אשר אראך פיר"י ולא גילה לו מיד כדי לחבבה בעיניו וגו' כיוצא בו על אחד ההרים אשר אומר אליך וגו'. כי מאר שלא גילה לו לו מיד ע"כ הי' בוער החשק מאד בלבו של אברהם שיזכה לידע את הארץ ולבא לשם וכן על אחד ההרים שהוא הר המוריה. וע"י החשק הזה קיבל כבר הארה גדולה משם. וגם כי עי"ז כשבא אחר כך לשם קיבל הארה גדולה ביותר כנ"ל. וזה שאמרו רז"ל שהקב"ה אמר לאברהם אבינו שילך לא"י ויראנה ויחזור ואח"כ לא נתן לו רשות לחזור לשם עד חמש שנים ואותן החמש שנים הי' אברהם משתוקק לחזור לא"י. והוא שאמר הפסוק מי יתן לי אבר כיונה אעופה ואשכונה וגו' היינו כנ"ל. כי ע"י הכיסופין והחשק הזה זכה אחר כך לקבל קדושת א"י ביותר. וזה אתה תקום תרחם ציון כי עת לחננה וגו' כי רצו עבדיך את אבניה וגו' היינו שיש להם רצונות וחשק וכיסופים חזקי מאד אליה ועי"ז הם מקבלים באמת הארה משם עד נחשב כאילו הם שם ממש. וא"ע מהנכון לרחם ציון ולהשיב נדחי ישראל לשם בפועל ממש. וע"כ עיקר התקרבות הגרים הוא משם. כמו שכתוב עמם הר יקראו ואמרו רז"ל חביבה ארץ ישראל שמכשרת את הגרים כי הגרים הם נדיבי לב. וכל חשקם ונדבת לבם הם מקבלים מא"י וירושלים שהם בחי' הלב העליון הנ"ל:
segments.en:
Pos'im Bo — "Those Who Step in It"

 פּוֹסְעִים בּוֹ · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 85

 It is known that Eretz Yisrael — and in particular the Bais HaMikdash — is the aspect of holy Malchus. And the primary perfection of its building is through the mochin — which are the aspect of the light of the seven days. And therefore it is said in the conquest of Yericho — which is the first conquest of Eretz Yisrael: "and seven priests shall carry seven shofars", etc. [Yehoshua 6:4]. For through the sounding of the shofar one draws down the aforementioned mochin, as is explained in the kavanah of the shofar.

 And this is what is said of the future: "and the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun — and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold — like the light of the seven days", etc. [Yeshayahu 30:26]. For every aspect is comprised of all seven. And this is what is written: "for behold the stone", etc. — and Rashi explained: the foundation of the Bais HaMikdash — on one stone — with seven eyes, etc. [Zechariyah 3:9]. And similarly: "and I saw a golden menorah," etc., "and its seven lamps upon it," etc. [Zechariyah 4:2]. And there: "for who has despised the day of small things?", etc. — see Rashi — "these seven — they are the eyes of Hashem," etc. [Zechariyah 4:10].

segments.he: סימן קנ"ב-כשבא נשמה
segments.en:
Siman Peh-Vav · סימן פ"ו

 Pos'im Bo Pesi'ah Ketanah — "Those Who Step in It with a Small Step"

 פּוֹסְעִים בּוֹ פְּסִיעָה קְטַנָּה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 86

segments.he: מבואר בפנים מענין קדושת א"י בשם הזוהר הק' כתיב זאת ירושלים שמתיה בתוך הגוים וגו'. והנה מחמת הקליפות שמסבבין את הקדושה בבחינת סביב רשעים יתהלכון וגו' לא הי' אפשר ליכנוס לקדושת א"י רק שנשאר פתח כנגד אמונה בבחינת פתחו שערים ויבא גוי צדיק שומר אמונים וזה שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה. אך לפעמים גוברים הפגמים כ"כ עד שמדחין אותו וסותמין לפניו הפתח של אמונה ולפעמים מעמידין שם בהפתח הנ"ל איזה ירא שמים שעומד לשמור שלא יכנס לשם. ומזה נשתלשל מה שלפעמים גם איזה איש כשר וירא שמים מונע את האדם מליסע לא"י. אך אם רצונו חזק בענין זה אז צריך לידע כי כל זה הוא רק בשביל נסיונו וצריך להתחזק ולהתגבר על הכל בבחינת מסירת נפש ממש. ועי"ז זוכה לעבור על הכל וליכנס לא"י. אך גם אח"כ כשבא לשם צריך להתגבר מאוד ברחמים ותחנונים לפני השי"ת שיזכה לקבל קדושת הארת החכמה והמוחין של א"י:
segments.en:
Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of Shabbos, as stated above. And therefore there is the primary tikkun of the holy feet — as it is written: "our feet were standing in your gates, O Yerushalayim." And similarly of the future it is said: "and His feet shall stand on that day upon the Mount of Olives" [Zechariyah 14:4]. And therefore when Yaakov our father received tidings of the inheritance of the Land — it is written afterwards: "and Yaakov lifted his feet" [Bereishis 29:1]. And therefore through the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael one merits to go from level to level in the service of Hashem, as is explained elsewhere. And also there in Eretz Yisrael is the primary guarding of the aspect of truth, as stated above many times. And when one speaks to himself in this trait — it is a support to sustain him. But one still needs to give strength to the feet — in order that they be able to walk well. And this is through the tzedakah of Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of the World to Come, as stated above many times. And there is the primary perfection of the light of tzedakah, as stated above. And this is: "who shall sojourn in Your tent?", etc., "one who walks blamelessly and acts righteously and speaks truth," etc. [Tehillim 15:1–2]. And this is: "I will walk before Hashem in the lands of the living."

 
 Siman Peh-Zayin · סימן פ"ז

 Titen Emes — "Give Truth [to Yaakov]"

 תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 87

segments.he: סימן קנ"ה-אריכת אפים
segments.en:
Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of yir'ah [awe], as stated above. And because the beginning of awe is called tzedek — for it is only the aspect of fear of punishment — which is the aspect of strict judgment and suffering — therefore our Sages of blessed memory said that Eretz Yisrael is one of three things given through suffering. But our Sages of blessed memory said: "when tzedek is joined with emes [truth] — it is called emunah [faith] — and all goodness and all light dwells in it." [Aramaic: tzedek kad ischar beih emes itkri emunah v'chol tivo v'chol nehiru shrayah beih] And therefore afterwards — when one merits — the awe is completed — and then it is in the aspect of yiras haromemut [awe of G-d's exaltedness] — the aspect of emunah — as it is written: "dwell in the land and tend to faithfulness." And then all the judgments are sweetened — and one merits to all goodness — even in physical matters, as stated above. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is called the inheritance of Yaakov — the aspect of: "give truth to Yaakov" [Michah 7:20], as is explained within the ma'amar.

 
 Siman Peh-Ches · סימן פ"ח

 HaMechaseh Shamayim — "The One Who Covers the Heavens"

segments.he: מבואר בפנים שעיקר עבודת איש הישראלי זוכים ע"י א"י שהיא בחינת אמונה בחי' אריכת אפים בחי' כח הגידול וכל הצומח שעי"ז זוכים להתחזק בעבודת ד' ולבלי להסתכל על שום מונע ומעכב ומבלבל וכו'. ושזה הי' גודל ההשתוקקות של משה רבינו ע"ה שהי' משתוקק ומתלהב לא"י כל כך. גם א"י היא בחי' אמת וצריך כל אדם לבקש מהשי"ת שיהיו לו כיסופין וגיעגועים לא"יּ. וגם שיהי' גיעגועים לכל הצדיקים לא"י. והיא סדולה לכעס ולעצבות כי כל הכוע כאילו עובד עכו"ם וכו' וע"י שמבקשים ומתגעגעים לא"י זוכים לאמונה וכו':
segments.en:
הַמְכַסֶּה שָׁמַיִם · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 88

 The primary holy love and awe is in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above many times. And therefore there is the primary descent of abundance to the entire world — for love and awe are the hands to receive all the influences and blessings. But because there are, to our great sorrow, accusers [mekitrigim] who do not allow the abundance to descend through Eretz Yisrael — which is known to all to be the place where abundance descends through love and awe, as stated above — therefore there are found in every generation those in the aspect of those who spread a bad report about the land — who conceal and cover the love and awe in Eretz Yisrael. And sometimes the Holy One Blessed be He also places this in the hearts of Tzaddikim and worthy people — to be prevented from Eretz Yisrael — as is also plainly visible in every generation. And all of this is because of the aforementioned reason. Although their reasoning is because of the danger of the roads and other obstacles — see what the Tosafos wrote [Ksubos 110b, s.v. hu] — see there. But this itself, one may say, also flows from this — and even the lack of livelihood in Eretz Yisrael — and similar things — all of this is because there is the root of the descent of abundance. Therefore the Holy One Blessed be He conceals and covers its light intentionally — because of the accusers, as stated above.
