And perhaps our Sages of blessed memory also said regarding this: "the merit of the Tzaddikim benefits the world — but not their own possession" — and it is intentional, as stated above.

 
 Siman Peh-Tes and Tsaddik · סימן פ"ט וסי' צ'

 V'Siman Tsaddik — [Two simanim combined]

segments.he: סימן קנ"ו-לב טהור
segments.en:
סִימָן פ"ט וְסִימָן צ' · Likutay Moharan I, Simanim 89 and 90

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the Shechinah, as is known. And there is the primary perfection — the aspect of: "you are all beautiful, my beloved — and there is no blemish in you" [Shir HaShirim 4:7] — the aspect of: "it lacks nothing." And those who dwell in it — who are of the household of the King's palace — when there is some lack for them, G-d forbid — the lack is certainly in the Shechinah Herself, as it were. And it follows that it is an even greater pain through this — when one takes it to heart. But even so — when one settles oneself — on the contrary: how much I have to rejoice — that I merited to be of the King's palace household — and the King Himself tells me of His own lack. Through this one fills with joy — and his mochin are renewed. And through this very thing the judgments are sweetened — and the lack is filled — for: "all of them are clarified in thought," as is known. And also in Eretz Yisrael there is the source of joy — in the aspect of: "Israel shall rejoice in its Maker — the children of Tzion shall exult in their King" [Tehillim 149:2]. And through this all the deficiencies are completed, as is explained within the ma'amar.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Alef · סימן צ"א

 Vayehi Yadav Emunah — "And His Hands Were Faithfulness"

segments.he: אמרו רז"ל כי עיקר נבואה ורוח הקודה הוא בארץ ישראל וע"כ שם בנקל יותר לזכות לדבר דיבורים חדשים לפני השי"ת ברחמים ותחנונים עד שיהיו בבחי' רוה"ק. גם א"י ובפרט ירושלים הם בחי' לב. ושם עיקר אור ההתלהבות דקדושה כמו שכתוב נאום ד' אשר אור לו בציון ותנור לו בירושלים. ושם עיקר טהרת הלב כמו שכתוב והביאך ד' אלקיך אל הארץ וגו' ומל ד' אלקיך את לבבך וגו'. גם מחמ שאוירא דא"י מחכים וזוכין להשיג שכליות חדשים בכל פעם וע"י תנועות השכל נולד התלהבות בלב ובוער לבו להשי"ת ועי"ז זוכים לטהרת הלב. גם א"י היא בבחי' מצדיקי הרבים כי כל היושבים בה נקראים צדיקים כנ"ל. וכתבי העם היושב בה נשוא עון ומצדיקי הרבים ככוכבים. ועי"ז מקבלין מלמעלה חמימות והתלהבות דקדושה כמובאר בפנים:
segments.en:
וַיְהִי יָדָיו אֱמוּנָה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 91

 In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary perfection of emunah [faith] and the primary perfection of seichel [intellect]. And therefore there one merits to ascend each time from level to level in this matter — and to progress from faith to intellect — and through this to an even greater faith — and then to a still greater intellect — and so to go from level to level at each and every time.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Bais · סימן צ"ב

segments.he: סימן קנ"ט. דע שיש אמצעי.
segments.en:
Al Yedey Na V'Nad — "Through Wandering and Roaming"

 עַל יְדֵי נָע וָנָד · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 92

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of the heart, as stated above — which is the aspect of Yosef. And also there is the primary perfection of Torah — which is the aspect of the lobes of the lung that blow upon the heart — through which the Tzaddikim are able to revive the dead, as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore the primary resurrection of the dead will be in Eretz Yisrael. And our Sages of blessed memory said: "the Tzaddikim are destined to revive the dead," etc. — as it is written: "yet there shall dwell old men and old women in the squares of Yerushalayim — and each with his staff in his hand," etc. [Zechariyah 8:4]. And this is derived from the resurrection of the dead by Elisha — which occurred through this very aspect, as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is: "and Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings — in the land of Kena'an — these are the generations of Yaakov — Yosef," etc. For this is connected to the dwelling of Eretz Yisrael, as is explained within the ma'amar — and as stated above.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Gimel · סימן צ"ג

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא מקום השכינ כביכול כידוע ושם עיקר שלימות לימוד התורה בחינת וכל בניך לימודי ד' ואין תורה כתורת א"י. ושם בנקל יותר שיעלה הלימוד להשכינה ושיהי' נעשה ממנו שפע רוחניות ושפע גשמיות גחינת אורך ימים ועושר וכבוד שזוכין לזה בשלימות בארץ ישראל כנ"ל. ואפי' מלימוד כזה שאינו עולה תיכף להשכינה נעשה ממנו טל תורה טל של ברכה וחיים בחי' כי טל אורות טליך הנאמר בא"י. וזה שכתוב וישכון ישראל בטח בדד וגו' אל ארץ וגו' אף שמיו יערפו טל ונאמר כטל חרמון שיורד על הררי ציון כי שם צוה ד' את הברכה חיים:
segments.en:
Mumas U'Matan B'Emunah — "Business Dealings with Faith"

 מוּמַ"ס וּמַתַּן בֶּאֱמוּנָה · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 93

 In Eretz Yisrael it is written: "and those who love His Name shall dwell in it" — as stated above many times. And the mitzvah of love is equivalent to all the mitzvos. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory said: "the dwelling of Eretz Yisrael is equivalent to all the mitzvos." And also there one merits mochin d'gadlus — and one is able to pray with a clear intellect. And therefore there is the primary place of prayer, as stated above many times.

segments.he: סימן קע"ה-בכיה מתוך שמחה
segments.en:
Siman Tsaddik-Daled · סימן צ"ד

 Zecher Chasdo — "The Memory of His Lovingkindness"

 זֵכֶר חַסְדּוֹ · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 94

 The primary elevation of the holy sparks is in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "and there you shall bring your burnt offerings" [Devarim 12:13]. For Eretz Yisrael is higher than all the lands — and this is the gate of heaven — through which all the services of Israel and all the holinesses ascend. And there all the fragments of the holy sparks that have fallen and been scattered gather together — in the aspect of: "even if your dispersed ones be at the end of heaven," etc., "and Hashem your G-d will bring you to the land," etc. And there is the primary perfection of emunah and the primary perfection of wisdom — through which the sparks ascend. Because emunah is the aspect of ז' — seven — and wisdom is the aspect of yud — ten. And the primary perfection of wisdom will be in the future — in the aspect of: "for the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of Hashem," etc. Therefore they only conquered seven nations — through the aspect of complete emunah — which is the aspect of seven. But in the future they will also conquer the three nations — and together there will be ten — as our Sages of blessed memory said. For then they will merit the perfection of wisdom — which is the aspect of yud.

segments.he: מבואר במגלה עמוקות אופן רי"ג כי יניקת ארץ ישראל מן ה"א ראשונה של השם דמתמן מתפשט שם של ס"ג וכו' ומבואר כאן בפנים שהבכי' מתעורר משם ס"ג וכו'. על כן בארץ ישראל בנקל יותר לזכות לבכיה מתוך שמחה המבואר בפנים:
segments.en:
And because when seven and ten are combined they form ayin [70 — also the word for "eye"] — therefore our Sages of blessed memory said: "in the future, Eretz Yisrael shall spread across the entire world" — which has seventy nations. And also wisdom itself is the aspect of seventy, as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore Yerushalayim is called: "a city of strength for us — salvation," etc. [Yeshayahu 26:1] — for it is comprised of the wisdom which is the aspect of ayin — and the emunah which is the aspect of zayin — and through this is the primary salvation — meaning: the holy sparks ascend to their place.

 And behold — it is explained within the ma'amar that the primary creation of all the worlds was for the sake of Israel — in order to bestow upon them great good. But they cannot receive the influence except through elevating the sparks of the letters of speech, etc. For speech is also in exile with Israel, etc. And this is what is written regarding what the prophets protested about the length of Israel's exile: "thus says Hashem — the Holy One of Israel and its Maker: osiyos [letters] — ask Me about My children — and the work of My hands — command Me" [Yeshayahu 45:11] — and Rashi explained: Israel — for whose sake I created everything — you come to protest before Me and raise complaints, etc. — I have already created their salvation, etc. — specifically osiyos. For upon this depends the primary redemption and salvation, as stated above. For through this they can receive all the good influences, as stated above — this being the aspect of: yeshuos Elokainu [the salvations of our G-d], as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore in Eretz Yisrael — where there is the primary tikkun of all the above — there is the primary descent of abundance to the entire world, as stated above.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Hay · סימן צ"ה

segments.he: סימן קע"ז-סלחתי כדבריך
segments.en:
Kshefarnesay HaDor — "When the Leaders of the Generation"

 כְּשֶׁפַּרְנְסֵי הַדּוֹר · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 95

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of humility and lowliness — the aspect of mah [what / nothing — the aspect of total self-nullification] — as it is written: "and you shall see the land — what it is [mah hi]" [Bamidbar 13:18]. And therefore it is written: "and the humble shall inherit the land," etc. And therefore Hashem commanded — surrounding tzarim [enemies / adversaries] for Yaakov — as our Sages of blessed memory said: such as Chalish alongside Naveh, Kastrah alongside Haifa, Susiyta alongside Tiveriyah, etc. [Midrash: surrounding foreign cities placed alongside Israelite ones]. And it is written: "this is Yerushalayim — I have placed her in the midst of the nations", etc. [Yechezkel 5:5] — so that if their heart becomes arrogant — and their heart becomes haughty and forgets, etc. — the oppressors will arise against them, G-d forbid — in the aspect of: "remove mah" — meaning the aspect of the aforementioned humility — then there remains only the aspect of: "and they devour Israel with every mouth," G-d forbid. And it is written: "they opened their mouths against us — all our enemies," etc.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Vav · סימן צ"ו

segments.he: בארץ ישראל עיקר החכמה כנ"ל ואישׁ חכם יכפרנה. וע"כ העם היושב בה נשוא עון. גם שם עיקר הארץ שם י"ה שהם המוחין בחי'י"ה בארץ החיים. וכתיב ששם עלו שבטים שבטי י"ה. ושם עיקר תיקון הברית ושם עיקר התגלות המלכות שהיא בחי' כבודו ית' והוא בחי' רצון בחי' רצית ד' ארצך וגו':
segments.en:
Zomem — "The Schemer"

 זוֹמֵם · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 96

 In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary elevation of the holy sparks — and the tikkun of extraneous thoughts — and the perfection of prayer — as stated above many times. And it remains to explain further how every one of the ma'amarim has a connection to the matter of Eretz Yisrael.

 
 Siman Tsaddik-Zayin · סימן צ"ז

segments.he: סימן קע"ח-ווידוי דברים
segments.en:
Al Domi — "Give Yourself No Rest"

 אַל דֳּמִי · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 97

 In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary humility and awe — and the perfection of prayer — and the tikkun of the aspect of the heh — for: ar'a d'Yisrael mosava d'as heh [Aramaic: the land of Israel is the dwelling-place of the letter heh] — as stated above. And therefore from there is the primary descent of abundance — in the aspect of: "behold, I give you [heh lachem] seed" [Bereishis 1:29 / 47:23].

segments.he: אמרו רז"ל ישיבת א"י שקולה נגד כל המצות והנה שורש נקודת כל המצות היא שמחה ומזה נוכל להתבונן גודל השמחה שיש להאדם לשמוח כשזוכה לישב בא"י ולקים בכל עת מצוה כזו ששקולה כנגד כל המצות ששורש נקודתם היא השמחה. וזה כי ניחם ד' ציון וגו' ששון ושמחה ימצא בה תודה וקול זמרה. כי כל הענן הזה בשלימות כמבואר בפנים הוא שם בא"י בפרט בציון וירושלים ששם מקור השמחה בחינת עוז וחדוה במקומו וכתיב ישמח הר ציון וגו':
segments.en:
Siman Tsaddik-Ches · סימן צ"ח

 Nasan Einav Bo — "He Set His Eyes Upon Him"

 נָתַן עֵינָיו בּוֹ · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 98

 In Eretz Yisrael all who dwell in it are in the aspect of Tzaddikim, as stated above many times. And: "the eyes of Hashem are toward the righteous" [Tehillim 34:16] — as is explained within the ma'amar. Therefore there it is easier for the person to open his own eyes — and to contemplate his ways — and to examine his deeds carefully — in the aspect of: "let us search and examine our ways — and return to Hashem" [Eichah 3:40].

segments.he: סימן קע"ט-ענין תענית
segments.en:
Siman Tsaddik-Tes · סימן צ"ט

 Va'Eschanan — "And I Pleaded [with Hashem]"

 וָאֶתְחַנַּן · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 99

segments.he: עיקר שלימות השלום הוא בא"י כמו שכתוב ונתתי שלום בארץ וכתיב השם גבולך שלום. כי שם עיקר שלימות הצדקה כמ"ש וצדקה בכרמל תשב. כי שם זוכין בשלימות לאתכנע לבא ולאדבקא רעותא דלבא בקוב"ה. כי שם עיקר הדביקות וביטול כל הרצונות נגד רצונו ית'. וע"כ גם רצונו ית' קשור ודבוק שם כמ"ש ארץ אשר ד' אלקיך דורש אותה תמיד וגו'. וכתיב רצית ד' ארצך וגו'. וע"כ היא בבחינת יום כיפור כי העם היושב בה נשוא עון. וזה שכתוב רצית ד' וגו' נשאת עון עמך וגו'. וע"כ אחר חורבן ירושלים גזרו צום ותענית. כי אז צריכין לזה. אבל בזמן ישוב א"י אין צריכים לצום אדרבא ששון ושמחה כי שם מקור השמחה והחיות וע"כ נקראת ארץ החיים:
segments.en:
And therefore our Sages of blessed memory said: "one who prays must direct his heart toward Eretz Yisrael — and toward Yerushalayim," etc. For there it is most suited to merit a proper prayer with true devekus [attachment to G-d] — for there is the primary place of devekus and the perfection of prayer, as stated above. And through directing his heart there — he merits in the Diaspora also some devekus. And through this — our prayers have a connection and attachment to the prayers of Eretz Yisrael — and in their ascent above they ascend together with them. And this is why we conclude after the prayer: "may it be His will that the Bais HaMikdash be rebuilt speedily," etc. For there — the service of prayer will be in great completeness. And through this very thing — those prayers of now will also be elevated and completed — through the very fact that even now we pray and hope for the building of the Bais HaMikdash.

 And perhaps this is also included in: "and I pleaded [va'eschanan] to Hashem," etc. For Moshe our teacher was concerned: perhaps his prayer would not be accepted — because he was still in the Diaspora. Therefore he prayed with this reasoning and argument: am I not wishing and praying to enter Eretz Yisrael — where there is the perfection of prayer with great devekus as is fitting? Then — even the prayer I am praying now will also be accepted — through the power of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — to which I bind myself — since all my prayer is for the sake of meriting to come there, as stated above. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said: "va'eschanan — why? In order to enter Eretz Yisrael" — that is, as stated above.

 
 Siman Kuf · סימן ק'

 Inyan Ka'as — "The Matter of Anger"

segments.he: סימן קפ"ז-ולך ד' החסד
segments.en:
עִנְיַן כַּעַס · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 100

 And therefore the Torah scholars of Eretz Yisrael — their temperament and nature is to be very discreet and very good — as our Sages of blessed memory said: "what is the difference between the forceful ones of Eretz Yisrael and the pious ones of Bavel? — how much they love one another." And all of this is because they have many good deeds — through the many mitzvos that apply only in Eretz Yisrael. And also — the dwelling of Eretz Yisrael itself — our Sages of blessed memory said is equivalent to all the mitzvos. It follows that they fulfill all the mitzvos at all times — through the dwelling of Eretz Yisrael. Our Sages of blessed memory said: "for those who love Me and observe My commandments — these are those who dwell in Eretz Yisrael," etc. And because of all this — even though they are great Torah scholars — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael" — nevertheless their Torah and their righteousness both settle within them in calm and tranquility. And therefore their mind is at ease with all people.

 
 Siman Kuf-Alef · סימן ק"א

 B'Karov — "Soon / In Nearness"

segments.he: מבואר בפנים מענין א"י ומענין ולך ד' החסד כי אתה תשלם לאש כמעשיהו:
segments.en:
בְּקָרוֹב · Likutay Moharan I, Siman 101

 The primary mochin — which are the aspect of י"ה — are in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of yud-heh — specifically in the land of the living. And it is said in the Tikkunim: "the air of Eretz Yisrael makes one wise — from the side of Chochmah — which is the letter yud." And similarly it is said: ar'a d'Yisrael mosava d'as heh [Aramaic: the land of Israel is the dwelling-place of the letter heh]. And there is the primary Torah — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And there all seventy faces of Torah shine — as it is written: "when a matter is too wondrous for you," etc., "and you shall arise and go up," etc. And there is the root of all the good character traits — as it is written: "the land is very very good" [Bamidbar 14:7] — in the manner of what our Sages said: "with whatever measure He measures out to you — be grateful to Him with it."

 And similarly there is the primary subduing of all evil traits — the aspect of: "the land devours its inhabitants" — for it transforms a person from evil to complete good, etc., as is explained elsewhere. And it is written: "and you shall burn out the evil from your midst." And there they are called adam [human being — the highest designation] — the aspect of: "the earth He gave to human beings [livnay adam]" — as stated above in Siman 6. And it is written: "I have made the earth — and I created man [adam] upon it." And this is what is written: "to thrust out all your enemies from before you [mipanecha]" [Devarim 9:4] — and similarly: "and He drove out the enemy before you [mipanecha]" [Devarim 33:27] — and many like these — specifically mipanecha [from before your face]. For the enemies who grip the darkened face [anpin chashochin] — they fall and are nullified — in the aspect of: "my enemies and my foes — they stumbled and fell" [Tehillim 27:2] — through Israel nullifying all the evil traits. And they merit to attain the Torah — in the aspect of the radiant face [anpin nehirin] — which is the aspect of י"ה — on whose account they are called adam, as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: סימן קפ"ח-לנסוע להצדיק
segments.en:
Note: This siman continues with a second section, as follows:

 The primary perfection of da'as and mochin is in Eretz Yisrael — and there is the primary perfection of Torah and the primary perfection of teshuvah [repentance]. And through this, compassion is drawn — until through this the aspect of the prayer of Hashem is awakened — which is also in Eretz Yisrael — in the aspect of: "and I will gladden them in My house of prayer" [Yeshayahu 56:7] — said regarding the Bais HaMikdash. And from there our Sages of blessed memory derived that the Holy One Blessed be He prays. Until through this one merits great compassion, as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is the aspect of what Daniyel prayed — saying: "for not upon our righteousness," etc., "but upon Your great compassion" [Daniyel 9:18] — the aspect of the aforementioned great compassion. And this is the aspect of: "for Hashem will have compassion upon Yaakov," etc., "and will rest them upon their soil," etc. [Yeshayahu 14:1]. And: "therefore Hashem waits to show you grace — and therefore He is exalted to have compassion upon you," etc., "for the people shall dwell in Tzion, in Yerushalayim," etc. [Yeshayahu 30:18–19]. For the primary destruction — the exile of Israel from Eretz Yisrael — was because the compassion became concealed — and they were unable to awaken compassion — as it is written: "the stirring of Your innards and Your compassion — are restrained toward me" [Yeshayahu 63:15]. And it is written: "for I will no longer show compassion," etc. [Hoshea 1:6]. And there it concludes: "and I will show compassion to Lo Ruchama" [Hoshea 2:25]. For through teshuvah one merits to return and awaken compassion — the aspect of: "and he shall return to Hashem — and He will show compassion to him" [Yeshayahu 55:7]. And this is what is written: "I will return to Yerushalayim with compassion — My house shall be built within it", etc. [Zechariyah 1:16]. For the primary tikkun is through the aspect of compassion — the aspect of: "and with great compassion I will gather you" [Yeshayahu 54:7]. And this is the aspect of: "therefore my innards murmur for him — I will surely have compassion upon him" [Yirmiyahu 31:19] — these are the two types of compassion stated above. For the simple compassion awakens the great compassion.

 End of Installment Six. This completes the full, word-for-word translation of Simanim 66–95 of Likutay Kama. Every word of the Hebrew source has been rendered, including the extensive teaching of Siman 68 on strengthening oneself each time — one of the longest and most practical simanim in the entire work — and the double sections of Simanim 72 and 95.
 

 The source text continues with Simanim 96 onwards — including later Likutay Kama simanim and then Likutay Tanina and Sipuray Maasiyos. The next installment will continue with Siman 96 (Kuf-Tes) onward.

 Likutay Kama · Siman Tzadik-Vav · סימן צ"ו — זוֹמֵם

segments.he: ארץ ישראל היא בחי' ענוה כנ"ל כמה פעמים והענוה היא עם חכמה כי אוירא דא"י מחכים. וע"כ שם צריכין ליזהר ביותר מלשון הרע כי עי"ז מפריד בין ענוה לחכמה ובזה פודם בקדושת א"י. וזה שכתוב איש לשון בל יכון בארץ.וע"כ המרגלים שהוציאו דבה על א"י אמרו ונהי בעינינו כחגבים וגו' שזה בחינת ענוה פסולה. וזה שתירגם יונתן ויקרא משה להושע בן נון יהושע וכד חמי משה ענותנותו דהושע בר נון קרי לי' יהושע היינו כנ"ל כי חשש שלא יבא ע"י ענוה שלו לבחינת ענוה פסולה ח"ו שזה בחינת עצת מרגלים ע"כ התפלל עליו י"ה יושיעך מעצת מרגלים וקרא לו יהושע. וי"ל שזה בחינת י"ה דייקא יושיעך כי יו"ד היא בחינת חכמה וה"א ראשונה היא בחינת בינה שהיא בחינת ענוה כידוע. וע"כ הן תרין ריעין דלא מתפרשין כי צריכין להיות קשורין זה בזה הענוה עם החכמה כנ"ל. וזה שכתוב ויהס כלב את העם אל משה. כי משה זכה שהלשון הרע לא הי' יכול לפגום הענוה שלו כמבואר בפנים. וזה שאחז"ל בחורבן בית שני מענין בר קמצא שהלך ואכל קורצא בי מלכא היינו שדיבר לשון הרע עד ששלח המלך קרבן וכו' וסיימו ענותנותי' של ר' זכרי' החריבה וגו'. כי ע"י השנאה חנם ולה"ר שהי' אז נפגמה הענוה. וע"כ עיקר התיקון שלעתיד יהי' ג"כ ע"י שלימות העונה כמו שכתוב (ישעי' ס"א) יען משח ד' אותי לבשר ענוים וגו'. וזה שנאמר (צפני' ב') בקשו את ד' כל ענוי הארץ אשר משפטו פעלו. היינו שהענוה היא במשפט כי מקושרת לחכמה שזה בחינת כי ראו כי חכמת אלקים בקרבו לעשות משפט:
segments.en:
Zomem — "He Who Plots"

 In Eretz Yisrael — there is the primary ascent of the holy sparks — and the rectification of strange thoughts — and the perfection of prayer — as stated above many times. And one needs to explain further — how all the discourses have relevance to the matter of Eretz Yisrael.

 
 Likutay Kama · Siman Tzadik-Zayin · סימן צ"ז — אַל דֳּמִי

 Al Domi — "Give Yourself No Rest"

segments.he: סימן רט"ו פדיון.
segments.en:
In Eretz Yisrael — there is the primary humility and awe — and the perfection of prayer — and the tikkun of the aspect of the Heh [the letter Heh] — for: "ar'a de-Yisrael mautva de-os Heh" [the land of Israel is the dwelling-place of the letter Heh] — as stated above. And therefore from there is the primary flow of sustenance — the aspect of: "here is seed for you."

 
 Likutay Kama · Siman Tzadik-Ches · סימן צ"ח — נָתַן עֵינָיו בּוֹ

 Nasan Einav Bo — "He Set His Eyes Upon Him"

segments.he: עיקר בחי' התגלות הרצון הוא בארץ ישראל כמו שכתוב רצית ד' ארצך וגו'. וכתיב הטיבה ברצונך את ציון. וכתיב (יחזקאל כ') כי בהר קדשי וגו' שם יעבדוני כל בית ישראל כולו בארץ שם ארצם וגו' כריח נחוח ארצה אתכם וגו' וע"כ שם עיקר תיקון ההמתקה של הפדיון הכולל ושם עיקר ביטול העבודה זרה בחי' שבר תשבר מצבותיהם ועוד פסוקים רבים כאלה. וכן שם עיקר התקרבות הגרים בחינת חביבה ארץ ישראל שמכשרת הגרים כנ"ל כמה פעמים:
segments.en:
In Eretz Yisrael — all who dwell in it are in the aspect of righteous ones — as stated above many times. And: "the eyes of Hashem are toward the righteous" — as is explained within the ma'amar. Therefore there it is easier for a person to open his eyes — and to reflect on his ways — and to examine his deeds carefully — the aspect of: "let us search out our ways and examine them — and return to Hashem."

 
 Likutay Kama · Siman Tzadik-Tes · סימן צ"ט — וָאֶתְחַנַּן

 Va'Eschanan — "And I Pleaded"

 And therefore our Sages said: "one who prays must direct his heart toward Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim," etc. For there it is most propitious to merit a proper prayer — with true attachment — for there is the primary place of attachment and the perfection of prayer — as stated above. And through directing one's heart there — one merits even in the Diaspora to some attachment. And through this — our prayers have relevance and connection to the prayers in Eretz Yisrael — and in their ascent on high — these too ascend with them. And this is why one concludes after the prayer: "may it be His will that the Bais HaMikdash be rebuilt speedily," etc. For there the service of prayer will be in great fullness — and through this — the prayers of now will also be elevated and completed through this very thing — that even now we pray and await the building of the Bais HaMikdash.

segments.he: סימן רכ"ב-שמחה
segments.en:
And perhaps this too is included in the matter of Va'eschanan el Hashem — for Moshe Rabbainu feared that perhaps his prayer would not be received — since he was still in the Diaspora. Therefore he prayed with this argument and aspect: behold — I desire and pray to enter Eretz Yisrael — where the perfection of prayer is in great attachment as is fitting. And if so — even the prayer that I pray now — will be received through the power of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — to which I attach myself — and all my prayer is to merit to come there — as stated above. And this is what our Sages said: "Va'eschanan el Hashem — why? In order to enter Eretz Yisrael" — meaning: as stated above.

 
 Likutay Kama · Siman Kuf · סימן ק' — עִנְיַן כַּעַס

 Inyan Ka'as — "The Matter of Anger"

segments.he: אלו הזוכין לישב בא"י צריכין להזכיר את עצמם בכל עת גודל הזריחה וההארה הגדולה שהיתה בא"י בימי קדם. וכבר ידוע כי הקדושה נצחיית ואפי' בעת שמסתלקת ומתעלמת הארתה הקדושה אעפ"כ נשאר איזה רשימה קדושה בפרט שאנחנו מקוים ומייחלים בכל עת שתתחדש הארת קדושה כ"כ ביתר שאת ויתר עוז בחי' אור חדש על ציון תאיר וגו'. ע"כ צריכים גם עכשיו לחזק את לבו מאד ולהתעורר לעבודת ד' בהתעוררות גדול מאד בכל עת בכח ההתעוררות והזריחה הקדושה שהיתה שם מאז עד אשר עי"ז יעזור לנו השי"ת ויחזור ויאיר ויזרח לנו מאור קדושתה בשלימות כראוי באמת:
segments.en:
And therefore the Torah scholars of Eretz Yisrael — their temperament and nature is to be very discreet and very good — as our Sages said: "what is the difference between the powerful ones of Eretz Yisrael and the pious ones of Babylon? — how much they love one another." And all of this is through their having many good deeds — through the many mitzvos that are practiced only in Eretz Yisrael. And also dwelling in Eretz Yisrael itself — our Sages said that it is equal in weight to all the mitzvos — so it follows that they fulfill all the mitzvos at every moment through dwelling in Eretz Yisrael. Our Sages said: "'to those who love Me and keep My commandments' — these are the dwellers of Eretz Yisrael," etc. And because of all of this — even though they are deeply learned — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael" — even so their Torah and their righteousness — both of them settle within them in tranquility and composure. And therefore their mind is at ease with all people.

 
 Likutay Kama · Siman Kuf-Aleph · סימן ק"א — בְּקָרוֹב

 Be-Karov — "Imminently"

 The primary of the mochin — which are the aspect of Yud-Heh — is in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "Yud-Heh in the land of the living" — and the Tikkunim said: "avira d'Eretz Yisrael machkim — mi-sitra de-Chochmah de-ihi os Yud" [the air of Eretz Yisrael makes wise — from the side of Wisdom — which is the letter Yud]. And similarly they said: "ar'a de-Yisrael mautva de-os Heh" [the land of Israel is the dwelling-place of the letter Heh]. And there is the primary Torah — for: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And there all seventy faces of Torah shine — as it is written: "for a matter that is wondrous from you," etc., "and you shall arise and go up," etc. And there is the root of all the good traits — as it is written: "the land is very very good" — in the manner of what our Sages said: "with all your me'od [with all your might] — with every measure and measure." And similarly there is the primary subjugation of all the evil traits — the aspect of: "a land that devours its inhabitants" — that it transforms a person from evil to complete good, etc. — and as is explained elsewhere. And it is written: "and you shall eradicate the evil from your midst." And there they are called Adam [human being] — the aspect of: "and the earth He gave to the children of man" — and as stated above in Siman 6. And it is written: "I — I made the earth — and the Adam upon it I created." And this is what is written: "to thrust out all your enemies from before you" — and similarly: "and He drove out the enemy from before you" — and similar to this many times: mi-panecha [from before you] — specifically. For the enemies — whose grasping is in the aspect of the darkened faces — they fall and are nullified through the aspect of: "my enemies and my adversaries — they stumbled and fell" — when Israel nullifies all the evil traits. And they merit to attain in Torah the aspect of the illuminated faces — which are the aspect of Yud-Heh — for which reason they are called Adam — as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: סימן רכ"ה-כשהריאה בשלימות
segments.en:
The primary perfection of knowledge and the mochin is in Eretz Yisrael — and there is the primary perfection of Torah — and the perfection of teshuvah. And through this compassion is drawn — until through this the aspect of the prayer of Hashem is awakened — which too is in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "and I shall make them joyful in My house of prayer" — which is said regarding the Bais HaMikdash. And from there our Sages learned that the Holy One Blessed be He prays. Until through this one merits great compassion — as is explained within the ma'amar. And this is the aspect of what Daniel prayed and said: "for not through our righteousnesses," etc., "but through Your abundant compassion." Meaning: the aspect of the aforementioned great compassion. And this is the aspect of [Yeshayahu 14]: "for Hashem will have compassion on Yaakov," etc., "and He shall cause them to rest on their land," etc. — [Yeshayahu 30]: "therefore Hashem will wait to be gracious to you — and therefore He will be exalted to have mercy upon you," etc., "for a people in Tzion shall dwell — in Yerushalayim," etc. For the primary of the destruction — to exile Israel from Eretz Yisrael — was because the compassion was hidden — and they were unable to arouse compassion — as it is written [Yeshayahu 63]: "the stirrings of Your innards and Your compassion toward me — they have restrained themselves." And it is written [Hoshea 1]: "for I will no longer have compassion," etc. And He concluded [Hoshea 2]: "and I will have compassion upon her who had not been shown compassion." For through teshuvah one merits to return and arouse compassion — the aspect of: "and he shall return to Hashem — and He will have mercy upon him." And this is what is written [Zechariyah 1]: "I have returned to Yerushalayim with compassion — My house shall be built in it," etc. For the primary tikkun is through the aspect of compassion — the aspect of: "and with great compassion I shall gather you." And this is the aspect of: "therefore My innards yearn for him — I will surely have compassion upon him," etc. — meaning: these two types of aforementioned compassion — for the simple compassion arouses the great compassion.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Zimras HaAretz — Likutay Kama Simanim 96–101.

 Note: Simanim 102–108 do not appear in the source — the work proceeds directly from Siman 101 to Siman 109.

segments.he: עיקר השכל בשלימות הוא בא"י. כי אין חכמה כחכמת א"י. ועי"ז זוכין שם לשלימות הבטחון בחינת וישבתם לבטח בארצכם וכתיב והחוסה בי ינחל ארץ וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. וע"כ שם עיקר שלימות הצדקה כמו שכתוב וצדקה בכרמל תשב. וזה שכ' בטח בד' ועשה טוב שכן ארץ וגו' וע"כ שם עיקר שלימות דיבור שהוא גדר האדם כנ"ל כמה פעמים עד שזוכים לשמוע דיבורים מקול הכינור. שזה בחינת השיר שהיו הלוים אומרים בבית המקדש עלי עשור ועלי נבל עלי הגיון בכנור. הגיון הוא לשון דיבור לפעמים כידוע.והנה בפנים מבואר שכל זה תלוי בשלימות הריאה שעל ידה מקבלין הנשימה והרוח המקרר החום שבלב. ועי"ז עיקר קיום השכל וכו'. וזה בחינת קדושת ארץ ישראל שנאמר בה ניתן נשמה לעם עליה ורוח להולכים בה:
segments.en:
Zimras HaAretz — Installment 7a: Remaining Likutay Kama (Corrected)

 Zimras HaAretz — Installment 7a
 Remaining Likutay Kama Simanim (109–282) · Complete Word-for-Word Translation · Corrected Edition

segments.he: סימן רל"ד-סיפורי מעשיות מהצדיקים
segments.en:
נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן · Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

Likutay Kama — Concluding Simanim

 
 Kama Siman 109 · סימן ק"ט

 Yesh Hevel — "There Is Breath / Vanity"

segments.he: מבואר בפנים שא"י היא כלליות הקדושה שבכל הקדושות כי שם כל העשר קדושות ושם הוא רק השגחה וזוכים לצאת מטבעיות לגמרי. ועי"ז יכולים להבדיל בין אור לחושך. ועי"ז יכולים לספר מעשיות מצדקים וגם יודעים איך לספרם עד שזוכים עי"ז לטהרת המחשבה ולמוחין דגדלות ונמתקין כל הצרות והדינים רח"ל הבאים מבחינת מוחין דקטנות:
segments.en:
יֵשׁ הֶבֶל · Likutay Moharan I:109

 In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary holy hevel [breath — the sacred, sinless breath] — as is explained in Megaleh Amukos, aspect 213. And as is explained above in Siman 37 — that the hevel of Eretz Yisrael is the holy breath that has no sin in it. And therefore there is the primary perfection of the holy anachah [sigh]. For when one sighs over one's sins — through this a new holy breath enters within him — which is also the primary thing in Eretz Yisrael. As it is written: "to you I will give the land of Kena'an — the portion [chevel] of your inheritance" [Tehillim 105:11]. And it is said: "the portions have fallen for me in pleasant places" [Tehillim 16:6] — from the aspect of the mochin of Eretz Yisrael — which are called no'am [pleasantness], as our Sages said. And this is what is written: "gaze upon Tzion — the city of our appointed time — your eyes shall see Yerushalayim — a peaceful dwelling", etc., "and all its ropes shall not be torn", etc. [Yeshayahu 33:20]. And regarding the non-Jews it is said there: "your ropes shall not hold strong," etc. And it concludes: "and the inhabitant shall not say: I am sick — the people that dwells in it, their iniquity is forgiven." For through being tied there to the holy chevel — the opposite of the chevel of the Sitra Achra — of which it is said: "and in the ropes of his sin he is held fast" [Mishlei 5:22], and: "woe to those who pull iniquity with cords of falsehood", etc. [Yeshayahu 5:18] — which are the ropes of Sheol and death — but Eretz Yisrael is the land of the living — and there one is tied to the holy chevel. And through this one merits forgiven iniquity.

 
 Kama Siman 117 · סימן קי"ז

segments.he: סימן ר"מ-כל ההשפעות וכו'
segments.en:
Motzaay Shabbos — "The Close of Shabbos"

 מוֹצָאֵי שַׁבָּת · Likutay Moharan I:117

 Those who dwell in Eretz Yisrael are called banim laMakom [children of G-d], as is brought. And see Megaleh Amukos, aspect 224. For there is the primary emes [truth], as stated above many times. And therefore it is called eretz merachakim [a land of distances] — for truth keeps its words at a distance. And this is what is brought: the final letters of "and he feared the place [vayira es hamakoM]" spell emes — and: from afar — as stated above. And therefore when one merits there to the aspect of emes — one is called banim, as is explained within the ma'amar. And also there is the primary perfection of da'as, as stated above. And therefore it is fitting to minimize sleep there. And Dovid the King, may peace be upon him — when he wanted to find the place of the Bais HaMikdash — from which is the root of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — he said: "I will not give sleep to my eyes — slumber to my eyelids — until I find a place for Hashem" [Tehillim 132:4–5]. And Yaakov our father said: "surely Hashem is in this place — and I did not know" — and Rashi explained: if I had known I would not have slept — as stated above.

 
 Kama Siman 129 · סימן קכ"ט

segments.he: כל ההשפעות באין רק מא"י כידוע. ומה שאנו רואים שע"פ רוב אנשי א"יּ פרנסתם מצומצמת זה מחמת שכשבאים לא"י אע"ג דאיהו לא חזי מזלי' חזי. ונפשם יודעת מאדורואים ומשיגים גודל קדושת ההפשעה הרוחנית השופעת בא"י עד שהיא מעי עולם הבא ממש כמובא. ועי"ז משליכים המזל של העשירות והשפעה גשמיית כלאחר יד. ואשרי למי שזוכה ירגיש בזה שישיבת א"י יקר מכל הון ואז בודאי לא ישגיח על ממון כלל ולא ירצה שום עשירות כלל. ואז יזכה באמת לקבל שפע רוחניית של ארץ ישראל בשלימות יותר ואולי גם שפע גשמיית. כמו שאמר השי"ת לשלמה הע"ה:
segments.en:
Eretz Ocheles Yoshvehah — "A Land That Devours Its Inhabitants"

 אֶרֶץ אוֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ · Likutay Moharan I:129

 It is explained within the ma'amar that Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of emunah — and it has the power to transform the person who dwells in it to the very substance of its holiness. And therefore: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." But even so — everything depends upon the will. For if one has absolutely no will to serve Hashem, G-d forbid — then nothing will help him. For then on the contrary — the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael cannot bear him — and expels him — in the aspect of: "as it vomited out the nation", etc. [Vayikra 18:28]. But if his will is very strong to draw close to the Holy One Blessed be He and serve Him — then the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael greatly helps him for this, as stated above. Until he merits through this to break all his bodily desires — and be truly transformed to its holy substance, as stated above.

 
 Kama Siman 135 · סימן קל"ה

segments.he: סימן רמ"ב-אריך אנפין
segments.en:
Ki Ekach Mo'ed — "When I Take the Appointed Time"

 כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד · Likutay Moharan I:135

 The lower Yerushalayim is established opposite the upper Yerushalayim — which is the aspect of Binah — the supernal mother. And therefore there in Eretz Yisrael one merits humility — the aspect of: "the humble shall inherit the land" — as stated above many times. And also there is the primary root of the sanctity of the holy days — which are established only through the Great Sanhedrin of Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "which you shall proclaim" [Vayikra 23:2]. For there the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael depends upon the Tzaddikim — as it is written: "the righteous shall inherit the land" — and as is understood in the holy Zohar. And therefore — the more a person is connected to the true Tzaddikim — the more he merits to feel the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael. And similarly — through the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael one merits more fully to receive the illumination of the true Tzaddikim. And through all of this katnus [smallness of consciousness] is nullified before gadlus — and one merits true humility. And also there is the primary teshuvah — and the primary awe — and the subduing of the kingdom of Amalek — and the elevation of the holy Kingship, etc. — as stated above many times.

segments.he: קדושת א"י תלוי בשמירת הברית כמאמרם ז"ל על מנת ואתה את בריתי תשמור. ע"כ צריכים שם להרבות בצדקה כל אחד כפי יכלתו כי ע"י צדקה ניצול מהרהורי ניאוף שהם בחינת מת וזוכה לקדוש' א"י שנקראת ארץ החיים (ועי' לקמן סי' רס"ד בפנים):
segments.en:
Kama Siman 142 · סימן קמ"ב

 Mi She'i Efshar Lo Lilmod — "One Who Cannot Learn"

 מִי שֶׁאִי אֶפְשַׁר לוֹ לִלְמוֹד · Likutay Moharan I:142

 It is brought above in Siman 20, in the ma'amar of Tisha Tikkunin, that the supernal heart is called Yerushalayim — the aspect of: "speak to the heart of Yerushalayim" — and there all the words of Torah are written — the aspect of: "write them on the tablet of your heart." And this is the aspect of: "for from Tzion shall go forth Torah — and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim." And it is explained within the ma'amar that the cheshek [longing / desire] a person has for learning or for a matter of a mitzvah — he receives that longing from the supernal heart itself — and he is like one actually learning from a book. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said: "one who was born in her — and one who looks forward to seeing her" — for the longing he has — looking forward to seeing her — he receives from her herself. And therefore he too is named after her as though he were born in her. And this is what they said there: "and one of ours is equivalent to two of theirs."

segments.he: סימן ר"נ-דע שכל מיני צער
segments.en:
For since one who is not there — who only longs to be there — receives and learns from there — all the more so one who merited to actually be there — certainly he receives an even greater illumination. And this is: "one of ours who goes up there is equivalent to two of theirs." For since the longing burned so greatly in his heart — until he merited to overcome all the compulsions and obstacles and come there — therefore certainly through this he has an even greater connection to the supernal heart — until he receives from there an extra and abundant illumination — until he is equivalent to two of theirs. And therefore the Holy One Blessed be He said to Avraham our father, may peace be upon him: "go for yourself", etc., "to the land that I will show you" — and Rashi explained: He did not reveal it to him immediately — in order to make it dear to him, etc. Similarly: "on one of the mountains that I will tell you", etc. [Bereishis 22:2]. For since He did not reveal it to him at once — the longing burned very greatly in Avraham's heart — that he merit to know the land and come there — and similarly with the mountain of Moriyah. And through this longing he already received a great illumination from there. And also — through this — when he came there afterwards — he received a still greater illumination, as stated above.

 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory said: the Holy One Blessed be He told Avraham our father to go to Eretz Yisrael — see it — and return. And afterwards He did not give him permission to return there for five years. And those five years Avraham yearned to return to Eretz Yisrael. And this is the verse: "who will give me wings like a dove — I will fly and come to rest", etc. — as stated above. For through this longing and desire — he subsequently merited to receive the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael even more greatly. And this is: "You will arise and have compassion upon Tzion — for it is the time to show her grace", etc. [Tehillim 102:14], "for Your servants cherish her stones", etc. — meaning: they have desires and longings and very powerful yearnings toward her — and through this they truly receive an illumination from her — until it is considered as though they are actually there. And from this it is fitting and proper to have compassion on Tzion — and to return the scattered of Israel there in actual practice. And therefore the primary drawing close of converts is from there. As it is written: "peoples shall call to the mountain" — and our Sages said: "beloved is Eretz Yisrael, for it renders converts fit." For the converts are noble of heart. And all their longing and generosity of heart — they receive from Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim — which are the aspect of the aforementioned supernal heart.

 
 Kama Siman 152 · סימן קנ"ב

segments.he: עיקר אור ההשגחה מאיר בא"י כמו שכתוב תמיד עיני ד' אלקיך בה וכו'. גם שם עיקר אור הדעת כנ"ל. וע"כ צריכים להתאבל ולבכות מאד על חורבנה כי עכשיו קדושתה נעלמת והיא בבחי' הסתרת פנים בחינת הסתרת אור ההשגחה בחי' אעלים עיני מכם. וע"י הבכי' חוזרין וממשיכים אור ההשגחה כמבואר בפנים. וע"כ כשפגמו ישראל בקדושת א"י ע"י המרגלים ואמר להם משה לא תעלו ולא תלחמו וגו'. נאמר שם ותשבו ותבכו לפני ד' (כי סברו שבזה יתתקן הפגם) וולא שמע ד' בקולכם וגו'. כי פגמו כ"כ בבכייתם שבכו ע"י המרגלים כמ"ש ויבכו העם בלילה וגו'. עד שלא הועיל להם הבכי' אח"כ לבטל הגזירה לגמרי. וזה שנאמר כשהגיד להם הנביא שלא יגרש ד' את העמים מא"י וכו'. (שופטים ב') וישאו העם את קול ויבכו ויקראו שם המקום ההוא בוכים. וסמוך לו תיכף כתיב וישלח יהושע וגו' לרשת את הארץ עי' רש"י לרמז כי גם עני הבכי' הנ"ל שייך לירושת א"י. וזה בכה תבכה בלילה וגו' וכן על נהרות בבל וגו' גם בכינו. וכן הלוך ילך ובכה וגו' בא יבא ברנה וגו'. היינו שהכתוב מבטיח שע"י הבכי' יחזרו וימשיכו אור ההשגחה עד שתחזור קדושת א"י על מכונה. וזה שנאמר (ירמי' ל"א) הנני מביא אותם מארץ צפון וקבצתים מירכתי ארץ וגו' בבכי יבואו וגו'. ושם מנעו קולך מבכי וגו' ושבו בנים לגבולם. וזה שנאמר (ישעי' ל') כי עם בציון ישב בירושלים כה לא תבכה וגו'. והכלל כי צריכים להתחזק מאד באמונה ההשגחה עד שיזכה לדעת כזה שלא ירגיש שום צער ויסורים כלל בפרט אלו הזוכים לישב בא"י ששם מאיר אור ההשגחה והדעת והאמונה והיא אחת מהג' דברים שנתנו ע"י יסורים. ובאמת אלו היסורים הן של אהבה כמ"ש וידעת עם לבבך כי כאשר ייסר איש את בנו וגו'. וע"כ צריכים להתחזק מאד לקבל היסורים באהבה בכדי שיהי' מזבח כפרה ולזכות לקבל קדושת א"י עי"ז. ועכ"פ צריכים שם להתחזק הרבה בתפלה שעיקר מקומה הוא בא"י כמאמרם ז"ל ולבכות הרבה לפני השי"ת. עד שעי"ז יזכה להמשיך התגלות אור השגחתו ית'. ועי"ז ממילא ינצל מכל מיני צער ויסורין ויזכה לקבל קדושת א"י בשלימות:
segments.en:
K'sheBa Neshamah — "When the Soul Comes"

 כְּשֶׁבָּא נְשָׁמָה · Likutay Moharan I:152

 It is explained within the ma'amar — regarding the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — in the name of the holy Zohar: it is written: "this is Yerushalayim — I have placed her in the midst of the nations", etc. [Yechezkel 5:5]. And behold — because the klippos surround the holiness — in the aspect of: "the wicked walk all around", etc. [Tehillim 12:9] — it was not possible to enter the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael. But a gateway was left opposite faith — in the aspect of: "open the gates — the righteous nation that guards faith may enter" [Yeshayahu 26:2]. And this is: "dwell in the land and tend to faithfulness." But sometimes the blemishes overpower so greatly that they push one away and block before him the gateway of faith. And sometimes they station at that gateway some G-d-fearing person who stands guard that none enter there. And from this flows what sometimes happens — that even some worthy and G-d-fearing person prevents a person from travelling to Eretz Yisrael. But if his will is strong in this matter — he must know that all of this is only for the sake of his trial — and he must strengthen himself and overpower everything — in the aspect of actual mesiras nefesh. And through this he merits to pass over everything and enter Eretz Yisrael. But even afterwards — when he comes there — he must greatly overpower himself with mercy and supplication before the Holy One Blessed be He — that he merit to receive the illumination of the holy wisdom and mochin of Eretz Yisrael.

 
 Kama Siman 155 · סימן קנ"ה

segments.he: סימן רנ"א-דע שע"י מלחמות וכו'
segments.en:
Arichas Apayim — "Long-suffering / Patience"

 אֲרִיכַת אַפַּיִם · Likutay Moharan I:155

 It is explained within the ma'amar that the primary work of every Jew is attained through Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of emunah — the aspect of arichas apayim [long-suffering — literally: length of the nose / face] — the aspect of the power of growth and all that sprouts. Through this one merits to strengthen oneself in the service of Hashem — and not to look at any obstacle, impediment, or confusion, etc. And this was the great magnitude of Moshe Rabbainu's longing — that he yearned and was inflamed for Eretz Yisrael so greatly. And also — Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of emes. And every person must ask the Holy One Blessed be He that he have longings and yearnings for Eretz Yisrael. And also that there should be yearnings for all the Tzaddikim for Eretz Yisrael. And it is a remedy against anger and sadness — for all who are angry are as though they served idolatry, etc. And through asking and yearning for Eretz Yisrael one merits emunah, etc.

segments.he: בארץ ישראל שם עיקר האמת כמו שכתוב אמת מארץ תצמח וכתיב ונקרה ירושלים עיר האמת. וע"כ שם עיקר שלימות הצדקה כמ"ש וצדקה בכרמל תשב. וזה שנסמך פסוק וצדקה תהי' לנו וגו' (המבואר בפנים) לענין ירושת א"י כמו שכתוב ואותנו הוציא משם וגו'לתת לנו את הארץ וגו' ויצונו ד' וגו' וצדקה תהי' לנו כי נשמור וגו'. וסמוך לו גם אח"כ תיכף כי יביאך ד' אלקיך אל הארץ וגו'. ומה שצדקה נמשכת לאמת הוא מחמת שאמת הוא אחד וכו' כמבואר בפנים. וזה שכתיב אחד הי' אברהם ויירש את הארץ וכתיב ומי כעמך ישראל גוי אחד בארץ דייקא. וע"י כל הנ"ל נתבטלין כל המחשבות זרות של כפירות וע"ז רח"ל. וזה זוכין בשלמות בא"י. כי שם עיקר זיכוך המחשבה וביטול הכפירות וע"ז וזוכין לאמונה שלימה כנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם שם נתבטלין כל מיני מחלוקות וזוכין לשלום כמו שכתוב השם גבולך שלום:
segments.en:
Kama Siman 156 · סימן קנ"ו

 Lev Tahor — "A Pure Heart"

 לֵב טָהוֹר · Likutay Moharan I:156

 Our Sages of blessed memory said that the primary prophecy and Ruach HaKodesh is in Eretz Yisrael. And therefore there it is easier to merit to speak new words before the Holy One Blessed be He — with mercy and supplication — until they are in the aspect of Ruach HaKodesh. And also — Eretz Yisrael and in particular Yerushalayim are the aspect of the heart. And there is the primary light of holy hispa'alus [blazing enthusiasm] — as it is written: "an utterance of Hashem — whose fire is in Tzion — and whose furnace is in Yerushalayim" [Yeshayahu 31:9]. And there is the primary purification of the heart — as it is written: "and Hashem your G-d will bring you to the land", etc., "and Hashem your G-d will circumcise your heart", etc. [Devarim 30:5–6]. And also because Avira d'Eretz Yisrael machkim — and one merits to attain new intellectual insights each time — and through the movements of the intellect a blazing is born in the heart — and it burns toward the Holy One Blessed be He — and through this one merits purification of the heart. And also — Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of those who justify the masses — for all who dwell in it are called Tzaddikim, as stated above. And it is written: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." And: "those who justify the masses — like the stars." And through this one receives from above warmth and blazing enthusiasm of holiness, as is explained within the ma'amar.

segments.he: סימן רע"ז-צדיק כתמר יפרח
segments.en:
Kama Siman 159 · סימן קנ"ט

 Da She'Yesh Emtza'i — "Know That There Is an Intermediary"

 דַּע שֶׁיֵּשׁ אֶמְצָעִי · Likutay Moharan I:159

 Eretz Yisrael is the dwelling-place of the Shechinah, as it were — as is known. And there is the primary perfection of Torah study — the aspect of: "and all your children shall be disciples of Hashem" — and: "there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And there it is easier for the study to ascend to the Shechinah — and for it to produce spiritual abundance and material abundance — the aspect of length of days and wealth and honor — which one merits in fullness in Eretz Yisrael, as stated above. And even from such study that does not ascend immediately to the Shechinah — there flows from it the tal Torah [dew of Torah] — a dew of blessing and life — the aspect of: "for the dew of lights is Your dew" [Yeshayahu 26:19] — said of Eretz Yisrael. And this is what is written: "and Israel dwelt securely — alone", etc., "to a land", etc., "his heavens also drip dew" [Devarim 33:28]. And it is said: "like the dew of Chermon that descends on the mountains of Tzion — for there Hashem commanded the blessing — life" [Tehillim 133:3].

segments.he: מבואר בפנים כי כל הרפואות באים מן הארץ וכו'. והעיקר הוא א"י כי כל הארצות מקבלין מתמצית א"י. וא"י יש לה שתי בחינות. לפעמים נקראת ארץ כנען ולפעמים נקראת ארץ סתם. היינו כשיש מחלוקת. ומחלוקת אחת דוחה ק' פרנסתו ואזי נקראת ארץ כנען בחינת כאן עני כמו שדרשו רז"ל על פסוק ולא יהי' עוד כנעני וגו'. אבל כשיש שלום אזי נקראת בחינת ארץ סתם ואזי היא בחינת ארץ נתנה יבולה שנותנת כחותיה לכל יבול הארץ.ואזי יש כח לכל הרפואות וכו':
segments.en:
Kama Siman 175 · סימן קע"ה

 Bechiyah Mitoch Simchah — "Weeping Within Joy"

 בְּכִיָּה מִתּוֹךְ שִׂמְחָה · Likutay Moharan I:175

segments.he: סימן ר"פ-מי שצריך לדון בד"ת וכו'
segments.en:
It is explained in Megaleh Amukos, aspect 213, that the sustenance of Eretz Yisrael draws from the first heh of the Name — from which the Name of Samech-Gimel spreads, etc. And it is explained here within the ma'amar that weeping is awakened from the Name Samech-Gimel, etc. Therefore in Eretz Yisrael it is easier to merit weeping within joy — as is explained within the ma'amar.

 
 Kama Siman 177 · סימן קע"ז

 Salachti Kidvarecha — "I Have Forgiven According to Your Word"

 סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ · Likutay Moharan I:177

segments.he: עיקר בירור הניצוצות הקדושים מן הקליפות הוא ע"י אמונה ועיקר שלימות האמונה הוא בא"י כמו שכתוב שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה. וירושלים נקראת קרי' נאמנה. אך מחמת שאפשר שיתאחזו בה חס ושלום. ע"כ צריכים לקשר פנימיות המחשבה בכל עשיותיו אל התורה הק' ועי"ז מקבלת האמונה כח לברר הניצוצות מן הקליפות ולעלות מהם. ומזה מובן ממילא כמה צריכים להתחזק בא"י בלימוד התורה הקדושה. ושתהי' המחשבה קשורה בהתורה תמיד אפי' בעשיותיו הגשמיים כגון אכילה ושתיה ומו"מ וכיוצא. כי הכל רק בשביל לברר הניצוצות הק' שעיקר הבירור ע"י האמונה הקדושה שעיקר שלימותה הוא בא"י. והכל ע"י שמקבלת כח מהתורה הקדושה כנ"ל. וזה ששואלין: נשאת ונתת באמונה. קבעת עתים לתורה.כי עיקר תיקון המו"מ באמונה הוא בכח התורה הק'. ע"כ מלבד מה שצריך בשעת עשיית המשא ומתן שתהיה' מחשבתו קשורה בהתורה ושיעשה הכל רק ע"פ דת תורתינו הק' ועם כל זה העבודה הזאת היא בבחינת צאתך בחינת כי תצא למלחמה וגו' כמבואר בפנים. ע"כ צריך לקבוע עתים לתורה שאז יעסוק בתורה בפועל ממש שהיא בחינת עבודה פניימית למעלה מעבודת המו"מ בחי' ויששכר באהלך. בחינת ד' מי יגור באהלך מי ישכון בהר קדשך וגו'. וע"י שיושבי חו"ל מחזיקים אותם בממונם והם יושבים בקביעות על התורה ועבודת ד'. עי"ז יש כח גם ליושבי חו"ל לברר הניצוצות הק' ע"י משא ומתן באמונה וכיוצא. בפרט כי שם בא"י עיקר שלימות לימוד התורה כי אין תורה כתורת א"י. וכשעושה מו"מ באמונה ומכוון במחשבתו כדי להרויח ממון ולהחזיק התלמידי חכמים שבא"י זה ג"כ בחי' חב"ד דעשי' העולה ליצירה. כי א"י היא בחינת יצירה כמבואר בהקדמה לפרי ע"ח. וכבר מבואר לעיל בסימן ר"ד בפנים שהממון שנותנים לת"ח היא בחי' תורה ממש:
segments.en:
In Eretz Yisrael there is the primary wisdom, as stated above — and: "a wise man appeases it" [Mishlei 16:14]. And therefore: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." And also there is the primary illumination of the Name yud-heh — which are the mochin — the aspect of: yud-heh — specifically in the land of the living. And it is written: "for there the tribes ascended — the tribes of Hashem [yud-heh]." And there is the primary tikkun ha-bris. And there is the primary revelation of Malchus — which is the aspect of His glory, blessed be He — and it is the aspect of will — the aspect of: "You desired, Hashem, Your land."

 
 Kama Siman 178 · סימן קע"ח

 Vidduy Devarim — "Verbal Confession"

segments.he: סימן רפ"ב-אזמרה וכו'
segments.en:
וִידּוּי דְּבָרִים · Likutay Moharan I:178

 Our Sages of blessed memory said: "the dwelling of Eretz Yisrael is equivalent to all the mitzvos." And behold — the root-point of all the mitzvos is joy. And from this we can understand the great magnitude of the joy that one has — to rejoice — when one merits to dwell in Eretz Yisrael — and to fulfill at every moment such a mitzvah — which is equivalent to all the mitzvos — whose root-point is joy. And this is: "for Hashem has comforted Tzion", etc. [Yeshayahu 51:3], "joy and gladness shall be found in it — thanksgiving and the sound of song." For all of this matter in its fullness — as is explained within the ma'amar — is there in Eretz Yisrael — in particular in Tzion and Yerushalayim — where is the source of joy — the aspect of: "strength and joy are in His place" [Divray HaYomim I 16:27]. And it is written: "Har Tzion shall rejoice," etc.

 
 Kama Siman 179 · סימן קע"ט

 Inyan Ta'anis — "The Matter of Fasting"

segments.he: עיקר הזמירות והניגונים שהם בחינת בירור הנקודות טובות שיש בכל אחד שזה בחינת בירור הרוח טובה מן הרוח רעה הוא בארץ ישראל. בחינת מכנף הארץ זמירות שמענו בחינת רוחך טובה תנחני בארץ מישור שהוא בחינת א"י כנ"ל בסי' נ"ד. וזה בחי' השיר היו הלוים אומרים בביהמ"ק כי לשם נתכנסין כל הנקודות טובות שבישראל. כי מקדש אקרי משכן כמו שאמרו רז"ל. שזה בחינת המשכן שעושה הרועה נאמן שבכל דור ע"י הנקודות טובות שמקבץ מכל ישראל כמובן בפנים וכמבואר בלקוטי הלכות כי ירושלים נקראת טוב שנאמר ההר הטוב הזה וגו'. וכלל א"י נקראת ארץ טובה כי שם שורש כל הטוב. ויש שם הבחי' של הש"ץ ההגון שעי"ז כל הנקודות טובות תאבות להכלל שם. שזה בחי' ארץ חמדה טובה וגו'. וזה בחי' עת הזמיר הגיע בחי' הזמירות והניגונים הנ"ל שהיא בחינת קיבוץ הנקודות ובות שמהם נבנה המשכן שמשם מקבלין התינוקות של בית רבן הבל פיהם שאין בו חטא. וזה שסיים וקול התור נשמע בארצנו ופירש בזוהר דא קלא דינוקי דרביי דלעאין באורייתא. וזה בארצנו דייקא היינו כנ"ל. וזה שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה בחינת הרעיא מהימנא הנ"ל.וזה שנסמך הפסוק ועוד מעט ואין רשע שזה בחי' הדרך של אזמרה לאלקי בעודי בחי' בירור וקיבוץ הנקודות טובות הנ"ל לענין ירושת א"י. כמוט שכתוב וקוי ד' המה יירשו ארץ ועוד מעט ואין רשע וגו' וענוים יירשו ארץ וגו'. היינו שמתחלה מדבר לענין מה שצריך האדם לחזק את עצמו בעצמו ע"י הנקודות טובות ולקוות לד' שיזכה עי"ז לתשובה שלימה ולכל טוב הכלול בקדושת א"י. וזה וקוי ד' יירשו ארץ. ואח"כ ביאר הדבר ועוד מעט ואין רשע וגו'. היינו שגם נגד אחרים ע"י שדנין אותם לכף זכות ע"י הנקודות טובות שמוצא בהם עי"ז מכניס אותם באמת לכף זכות בבחינת והתבוננת על מקומו ואיננו. וזה שסיים וענוים יירשו ארץ. כי אלו שדנין בני אדם לכ"ז הם נקראים ענוים כי זה ממדת ענותנין. וע"ד שאמרו ז"ל יכול אפי' הגיס דעתו ת"ל משרים תשפטו בני אדם היינו כנ"ל. וזה וענוים יירשו ארץ והתענגו על רוב שלום. כי עי"ז שדנין בני אדם לכף זכות עי"ז רוב שלום. וזה שנאמר גם לענין א"י ונתתי שלום בארץ וכתיב השם גבולך שלום. וזה שנאמר גם לענין א"י ונתתי שלום בארץ וכתיב השם גבולך שלום. ונאמר וכל ניך למודי ד' בחי' תשב"ר הנ"ל ורב שלום בניך בחי' שלום הנ"ל. ועי' בפנים לעיל בסי' ל"ז שא"י היא בחינת הבל שאין בו חטא:
segments.en:
עִנְיַן תַּעֲנִית · Likutay Moharan I:179

 The primary perfection of shalom is in Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "and I will place peace in the land" — and it is written: "who makes your borders peace." For there is the primary perfection of tzedakah — as it is written: "and righteousness shall dwell in the orchard." For there one merits in fullness to humble oneself — to come and to cleave the desire of one's heart to the Holy One Blessed be He [in the Aramaic of the source: l'iskane'a l'va u'l'addabka re'uta d'liba b'Kudsha Brich Hu]. For there is the primary devekus and the nullification of all desires before His will, blessed be He. And therefore His will, blessed be He, is also bound and attached there — as it is written: "the land that Hashem your G-d seeks out always." And it is written: "You desired, Hashem, Your land." And therefore it is in the aspect of Yom Kippur — for: "the people that dwells in it — their iniquity is forgiven." And this is what is written: "You desired, Hashem", etc., "You forgave the iniquity of Your people", etc. [Tehillim 85:2–3]. And therefore after the destruction of Yerushalayim — fasting and affliction were decreed. For then they are needed. But in the time of the settlement of Eretz Yisrael — there is no need to fast — on the contrary: joy and gladness. For there is the source of joy and vitality — and therefore it is called Eretz HaChayyim.

 
 Kama Siman 187 · סימן קפ"ז

 U'Lecha Hashem HaChesed — "And to You, Hashem, Belongs Lovingkindness"
